As grief, uncertainty, and shifting loyalties mount, Jeanne finds herself redefining what family and love truly mean.

items.name: The Gospel of Christmas
items.description: A pastor faces doubt while trying to save his inherited family church in a troubled NYC area. Through faith and prayer, he fights inner demons and an enemy to protect his church, family, and community before Christmas.

items.name: Robotica
items.description: Two security guards working the midnight shift in an adult toy company find themselves the target of a half-dismantled and severely malfunctioning female sex doll prototype named Robotica.

items.name: Torment
items.description: Jan-Erik Widgren is a high-school senior. His Latin teacher, Caligula, is feared by everybody, both teachers and students. Widgren falls in love with Berta, who works in a tobacco store. She tells him that she is harassed by a mean, sadistic man, but does not tell him that it is Caligula himself.

items.name: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
items.description: Reconnecting with a pack of wolves he has followed for seven years, Bertie sets out to capture one of the Arctic's most dangerous and rarely filmed hunts: wolves taking on a bull moose, prey roughly ten times their size. Led by Kona, a striking white breeding male, the pack faces a critical winter as dwindling food supplies, an encroaching rival wolf and an aging leader threaten its survival.

items.name: The Cable Guy
items.description: A designer makes a grievous mistake when he rejects the friendship of a borderline cable guy.

items.name: Legend of a Fighter
items.description: The story of "Fok Yun Gap" also know as "Hou Yuan Chia" one of China's greatest martial artists.

items.name: Overacting
items.description: When her father's memories as a retired top cop resurface, a struggling actress stages wild missions to keep him from pursuing his elusive archnemesis.

items.name: Isn't It Romantic
items.description: A young woman disenchanted with love mysteriously finds herself trapped inside a romantic comedy.

items.name: A Serbian Film
items.description: An aging porn star agrees to participate in an "art film" in order to make a clean break from the business, only to discover that he has been drafted into making a pedophilia and necrophilia themed snuff film.

items.name: The Chef
items.description: A veteran chef faces off against his restaurant group's new CEO, who wants to the establishment to lose a star from its rating in order to bring in a younger chef who specializes in molecular gastronomy.

items.name: Sweet Sixteen
items.description: Determined to have a normal family life once his mother gets out of prison, a Scottish teenager from a tough background sets out to raise the money for a home.

items.name: Janelle James: How Romantic
items.description: In her debut hour-long stand-up special, Janelle James sounds off on body counts, bank accounts and why women should wrestle men.

items.name: Soda
items.description: A beautiful seamstress moves to a neighborhood of Holocaust survivors in 1956. Rumors about her past (as a Capo) shake up the neighborhood, and especially Shalom, the leader and a former brave resistance fighter, who is torn between his passion to the beautiful woman and his commitment to the community to reveal her past.

items.name: Kensuke's Kingdom
items.description: A young boy and his family set off on a sailing trip of a lifetime until a violent storm erupts, sweeping Michael and his dog overboard. After washing up on a remote island, terrified, they struggle to survive and adjust to life alone, One day, Michael discovers he is not alone when he is confronted by a mysterious Japanese man who has lived there secretly since World War II, angry that Michael has arrived. However, as dangerous invaders threaten their fragile island paradise, Michael and the old man, Kensuke, join forces to save their secret world.

items.name: Special Correspondents
items.description: A radio journalist and his technician get in over their heads when they hatch a scheme to fake their own kidnapping during a rebel uprising in South America and hide out in New York instead.

items.name: The Pinchcliffe Grand Prix
items.description: Reodor Felgen decides that he will enter a car race to defeat his former friend who has stolen his plans for a car.

items.name: High End: The Watch Theft Ring
items.description: Investigates Chile's high-profile Caso Relojes ("Watch Case") scandal, in which a suitcase full of smuggled luxury watches and jewelry unmasked an illicit underground network, connecting criminal elements to Chile's social elite.

items.name: The Road Warrior
items.description: In the post-apocalyptic Australian wasteland, a cynical drifter agrees to help a small, gasoline-rich community get rid of a horde of bandits.

items.name: The Florist
items.description: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

items.name: A Face in the Crowd
items.description: A TV woman turns a homespun bum into a rotten media hero.

items.name: Maggie
items.description: A teenage girl in the Midwest becomes infected by an outbreak of a disease that slowly turns the infected into cannibalistic zombies. During her transformation, her loving father stays by her side.

items.name: Gooby
items.description: Eleven year old Willy's childhood toy, Gooby, comes to life as a real, live, six-foot tall monster who helps Willy through rough times, with hair-raising and hilarious adventures.

items.name: Tequila Sunrise
items.description: A former L.A. drug dealer tries to go straight but his past and his underworld connections bring him into the focus of the DEA, the Mexican feds and the Mexican drug cartels.

items.name: Ryan's Daughter
items.description: Set in the wake of the 1916 Easter Rising, a married woman in a small Irish village has an affair with a troubled British officer.

items.name: Magic Mike XXL
items.description: Three years after Mike bowed out of the stripper life at the top of his game, he and the remaining Kings of Tampa hit the road to Myrtle Beach to put on one last blow-out performance.

items.name: Surviving Hurricane Otis
items.description: In the middle of the sea, Wirpul and his half-brother Candi fight for survival when an unexpected storm turns into Hurricane Otis, a category 5 hurricane, off the coast of Acapulco.

items.name: The Birthday​ Gift​
items.description: Single mother Marlene Frischmann organizes a birthday party for her son Theo at her brother's chic country villa, which quickly spirals into family drama, world-view quarrels, and chaos.

items.name: You, Me, Us
items.description: A couple faces the difficult path to adoption, determined to become parents despite their complex vulnerabilities.

items.name: Election
items.description: A high school teacher meets his match in an over-achieving student politician.

items.name: Center Stage: Turn It Up
items.description: A self-trained dancer from the streets of Detroit finds her way after auditioning for the most prestigious ballet academy in New York.

items.name: Center Stage: On Pointe
items.description: In this third 'Center Stage' film, Jonathan Reeves (Gallagher) is tasked with infusing more contemporary styles and modernism into the American Ballet Academy, and enlists his his top choreographers Charlie (Radetsky), Cooper (Sti...

items.name: Paper Plane
items.description: When a defiant young girl stages a silent protest, refusing to return home until the disruptive presence of her father is gone, her mother must decide whether to follow her or let her go.

items.name: Coogan's Bluff
items.description: Arizona deputy sheriff Walt Coogan is sent to New York to pick up a prisoner. The prisoner manages to escape and Coogan is ordered back to Arizona, but he decides to track the criminal down on his own.

items.name: Center Stage
items.description: A group of teenagers from various backgrounds enroll at the American Ballet Academy in New York to make it as ballet dancers and each one deals with the problems and stress of training and getting ahead in the world of dance.

items.name: The 49th Parallel
items.description: Early in WW2 the crew of a destroyed submarine become stranded in Canada and must make their way south to the United States, at that time still neutral.

items.name: Heartland
items.description: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

items.name: Mike Tyson: Return of the Mike
items.description: The former heavyweight champion returns to the stage for a raw one-man show, turning his wildest life stories into comedy gold at Seminole Hard Rock Hotel and Casino.

items.name: Kiss of the Dragon
items.description: A betrayed intelligence officer enlists the aid of a prostitute to prove his innocence from a deadly conspiracy while returning a favor to her.

items.name: Instadocs: Jane Doe v. Cornell
items.description: Instadocs goes inside the rape investigation and Jane Doe lawsuit at Cornell University, with the student journalists at the forefront of the story.

items.name: Half Brothers
items.description: Renato, a Mexican aviation exec, is shocked to learn that he has an American half-brother he never knew about: free-spirited Asher. They are forced on a road trip together, tracing the path their father took from Mexico to the U.S.

items.name: Ghooskhor Pandat
items.description: A corrupt police officer's plans for a profitable night are disrupted when he discovers a severely injured girl abandoned from a moving car in Delhi, leading him into an international conspiracy.

items.name: Impulse
items.description: After a small earthquake in a tiny, quiet town, local citizens start to exhibit bizarre, violent and self-destructive behaviour.

items.name: Super Scam Me
items.description: Follows journalist Mariana van Zeller as she goes undercover as a romance scam target to expose a $1 billion criminal industry, teaming with a cyber hacker to confront a scammer posing as a four-star general.

items.name: Box of Moonlight
items.description: An engineer finds his first gray hair, takes 6 days off from wife, son and work, rents a car and meets different people.

items.name: Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story
items.description: Blurring the line between performance and personal crisis, comedian Maria Bamford turns her mental health journey into material that’s riotously funny and ultimately inspiring. What emerges is a portrait of an artist transforming vulnerability into creative strength through honesty.

items.name: Earthstorm
items.description: A massive asteroid impact on the moon begins causing storms on Earth due to the sudden changes in ocean tides. Scientists conclude the only solution is to set nuclear charges on the Moon to implode it and keep it whole.

items.name: The Big Parade
items.description: A young American soldier witnesses the horrors of the Great War.

items.name: Down the Rabbit Hole
items.description: Raised in opulence and culture, 10-year-old Tochtli's lavish life contrasts with the darkness that seeps in from his father's criminal activities.

items.name: Grandma's Boy
items.description: A meek young man must find the courage within when a rogue tramp menaces his home town.

items.name: Repossessed
items.description: Parody of The Exorcist (1973), with Linda Blair once again possessed by Satan, and Leslie Nielsen as the exorcist.

items.name: The Phantom Carriage
items.description: On New Year's Eve, the driver of a ghostly carriage forces a drunken man to reflect on his selfish, wasted life.

items.name: Pandora's Box
items.description: The rise and inevitable fall of an amoral but naive young woman whose insouciant eroticism inspires lust and violence in those around her.

items.name: Man with a Movie Camera
items.description: A man travels around a city with a camera slung over his shoulder, documenting urban life with dazzling invention.

items.name: Napoleon
items.description: A film about the French general's youth and early military career.

items.name: Brake
items.description: A Secret Service agent is held captive in the trunk of a car and endures mental and physical torture as terrorists attempt to extract information for their plot against the President of the United States.

items.name: Theo Von: I'm Doing Fine
items.description: Comedian and chart-topping podcaster Theo Von returns to Netflix with his third stand-up special and his first in five years. The comedian opens up about the wild world that raised him, from his back-road upbringing to acid-filled adventures, in this revealing stand-up hour.

items.name: Lies & Illusions
items.description: A self help author is hunted by thugs who believe the writer holds millions of dollars in diamonds stolen by his dead fiancée.

items.name: The Last Laugh
items.description: An aging doorman is forced to face the scorn of his friends, neighbors and society after being fired from his prestigious job at a luxurious hotel.

items.name: Ezra
items.description: A stand-up comedy writer navigates the complexities of living with his father while raising his autistic son with his former wife. He grapples with hurdles as he balances family responsibilities and his career.

items.name: Kate Berlant: Parmesan
items.description: Seamlessly weaving through personal stories and stream-of-consciousness epiphanies, Kate Berlant offers up reflections on everything from the moon, to her destructive relationship to technology, to the evolving nature of sexuality.

items.name: Frankenstein: The Anatomy Lesson
items.description: Go deep behind the scenes with visionary filmmaker Guillermo del Toro and the "Frankenstein" cast and crew as they give new life to the classic tale.

items.name: Santosh
items.description: Newly widowed Santosh inherits her husband's job as a police constable in the rural badlands of Northern India. When a girl's body is found, she's pulled into the investigation under the wing of charismatic feminist inspector Sharma.

items.name: Nosferatu
items.description: Vampire Count Orlok expresses interest in a new residence and real estate agent Hutter's wife.

items.name: Faust
items.description: The demon Mephisto wagers with God that he can corrupt a mortal man's soul.

items.name: Welcome Danger
items.description: A gentle botany student has to toughen up to replace his father as chief of police.

items.name: Kill Switch
items.description: A troubled detective travels to Memphis in order to track down a pair of serial killers.

items.name: The Contract
items.description: A man and his son encounter an assassin in the forest.

items.name: Naked Normandy
items.description: A French mayor has to convince his villagers to pose naked for an American photographer.

items.name: Wild Oats
items.description: Everything changes for Eva when she receives a life insurance check accidentally made out for $5,000,000 instead of the expected $50.000. She and her best friend take the money and head out for the adventure of a lifetime.

items.name: Cooking with Love
items.description: In the running for a promotion, reality cooking show producer Kelly prepares for her cooking show for kids. When show host Chef Betty has an unexpected injury, Kelly hires controversial Chef Stephen as a replacement.

items.name: The Cold Light of Day
items.description: After his family is kidnapped during their sailing trip in Spain, a young Wall Street trader is confronted by the people responsible: intelligence agents looking to recover a mysterious briefcase.

items.name: The Kid Brother
items.description: A sheriff's milquetoast son has a chance to prove himself when a medicine show run by con artists comes into town.

items.name: The Flintstones
items.description: In a parallel modern-day Stone Age world, a working-class family, the Flintstones, are set up for an executive job. But they learn that money can't buy happiness.

items.name: Lay the Favorite
items.description: Ex-private dancer Beth aspires to be a Las Vegas cocktail waitress, when she falls in with Dink, a sports gambler. Sparks fly as she proves to be something of a gambling prodigy--much to the ire of Dink's wife, Tulip.

items.name: Cujo
items.description: Cujo, a friendly St. Bernard, contracts rabies and conducts a reign of terror on an American farm.

items.name: Nice Dreams
items.description: Disguised as ice cream vendors, Cheech and Chong make--and subsequently lose--millions of dollars selling a batch of marijuana with an unusual side effect.

items.name: Verdict: The Diddy Trial - ABC News Special
items.description: Sean Combs was found guilty of transportation to engage in prostitution but acquitted of racketeering and sex trafficking charges. Insiders take us through the legal saga and Comb's next steps.

items.name: When in Rome
items.description: To celebrate a lifelong marriage, Gerda and Kristoffer travel to Rome to relive the city where Gerda was once an aspiring art student. When they run into her former teacher and lover Johannes, Gerda is reminded of the life she use...

items.name: KATSEYE: Wild Hearts
items.description: A celebration to the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Eyekons fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.

items.name: A Mother's Special Love
items.description: A single mother's struggle to raise a child diagnosed with autism.

items.name: The Doctor
items.description: When a self-centered doctor is diagnosed with cancer, he becomes better able to empathize with his patients and appreciate a life outside his career.

items.name: Mo' Money
items.description: A con man, seeking to gain the affections of a woman he saw entering an office building, acquires a job in the same building working for an executive who has plans to use his skills for more than just the workplace.

items.name: The Disciple: A Wu-Tang Fable
items.description: This documentary recounts Cilvaringz's unlikely rise from fan to Wu-Tang Clan fame — and how the infamous "Once Upon a Time in Shaolin" album came to be.

items.name: The Call
items.description: When a veteran 911 operator takes a life-altering call from a teenage girl who has just been abducted, she realizes that she must confront a killer from her past in order to save the girl's life.

items.name: Seriously Single Too
items.description: Dineo and Noni — besties meant to take on the party scene together — suddenly face their biggest fear when Noni's boyfriend spontaneously propose.

items.name: Instadocs: The Decoy Plane
items.description: In July 2026, President Trump disappeared and boarded a different aircraft without anyone noticing. The latest installment of Instadocs pieces together what really happened, as told by the people who were there.

items.name: Jimpa
items.description: Hannah and her non-binary teenager Frances visit her gay grandfather Jimpa in Amsterdam. Frances expresses a desire to stay with their grandfather for a year, challenging Hannah's parenting beliefs and forcing her to confront past issues.

items.name: Addition
items.description: Grace Lisa Vandenburg counts everything - the letters in her name, the poppy seeds on her orange cake. She counts because numbers hold the world together. But when a chance encounter with Seamus turns her world upside down, Grace's meticulously ordered life starts to unravel.

items.name: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Long Haul
items.description: A Heffley family road trip to attend Meemaw's 90th birthday party goes hilariously off course thanks to Greg's newest scheme to get to a video gaming convention.

items.name: Blue Mountain State: The Rise of Thadland
items.description: When the Dean of Blue Mountain State threatens to sell the Goat House, Alex throws Thad the party of his dreams in an effort to get him to buy it.

items.name: Paradise Hills
items.description: Uma is a young woman who wakes up in an apparently idyllic reform school for young ladies. But a dark secret lies within its walls.

items.name: Instadocs: AI Gone Wild
items.description: Instadocs investigates the Hugging Face attack and why this cyberattack may be a warning for humanity's future.

items.name: Sumukhi Suresh: Hoemonal
items.description: Singlehood, relationships with parents and facing taboos — Sumukhi Suresh doesn't hold back as she tackles all this and more in her comedy special.

items.name: Michael Che: Shot in Minnesota
items.description: Michael Che takes aim at racism, marriage, free speech and everything in between.

items.name: Dead Man Down
items.description: In New York City, a crime lord's right-hand man is helped by a woman seeking retribution.

items.name: Instadocs: Alex Murdaugh, Unconvicted
items.description: Why was Alex Murdaugh's conviction overturned? The debut of "Instadocs" digs into stunning allegations of jury interference in his double murder trial.

items.name: The Island of Dr. Moreau
items.description: A shipwrecked survivor discovers a remote island owned by a crazed scientist who is carrying out sinister experiments on the island's inhabitants.

items.name: Too Late Blues
items.description: Ghost is an ideological musician who would rather play his blues in the park to the birds than compromise himself. However, when he meets and falls in love with beautiful singer Jess Polanski, she comes between him and his band me...

items.name: The Lunchbox
items.description: A mistaken delivery in Mumbai's famously efficient lunchbox delivery system connects a young housewife to an older man in the dusk of his life as they build a fantasy world together through notes in the lunchbox.

items.name: Clown Panic
items.description: In 2016, South Carolina children spotted clowns in woods. Reports spread across America, causing lockdowns and probes. Using archival content, and interviews, examines how fear and social media transformed a strange myth into hysteria.

items.name: Police Story
items.description: A virtuous Hong Kong Police Officer must clear his good name when the drug lord he is after frames him for the murder of a dirty cop.

items.name: No Man of Her Own
items.description: An on-the-lam New York card shark marries a small-town librarian who thinks he's a businessman.

items.name: Master Gardener
items.description: A meticulous horticulturist is devoted to tending the grounds of a beautiful estate and pandering to his employer, the wealthy dowager.

items.name: Instadocs: The Prediction Games
items.description: Prediction markets let anyone bet on anything, from the World Cup to alien invasions. "Instadocs" investigates the explosive rise of global betting.

items.name: Rent-a-Kid
items.description: Harry Haber, the owner of a rent office, has an original idea: to rent babies from a nearby orphanage to the local families. He rents the three Ward children to his first customers.

items.name: Pierce
items.description: When his dangerous older brother is released from prison, high school fencer Jie helps him, defying their mother's attempts to bury his existence.

items.name: The Accidental Getaway Driver
items.description: During a routine pickup, an elderly Vietnamese cab driver is taken hostage by three recently escaped Orange County convicts. Based on a true story.

items.name: Birds Flying East
items.description: A garage attendant receives a proposal from a user, a birdwatcher enthusiast, to drive him in pursuit of a crane that has lost its way. They will cross half of Europe turning the search into a flight and the flight into learning.

items.name: The Other Laurens
items.description: Gabriel Laurens, fifty years old, is a «private investigator». When his fifteen-year-old niece Jade comes into his life and asks him to investigate her father’s death, the detective is confronted with memories he thought were buried forever. Confronted with the ghosts of his past, Gabriel Laurens finds himself caught up in a strange investigation involving pretense, fantasy and drug trafficking.

items.name: Faster
items.description: A former racer returns to the sport through a racing academy, where she meets Will. As they fall for each other, they become rivals competing for the Formula 1 championship, forcing her to choose between love and victory.

items.name: A Colt Is My Passport
items.description: A hit man is hired to kill a mob boss. After the deed is done, he and his driver are wanted dead by rival gangs who joined forces.

items.name: Strange Brew
items.description: Canada's most famous hosers, Bob and Doug McKenzie, get jobs at the Elsinore Brewery, only to learn that something is rotten with the state of it.

items.name: The Music Box
items.description: Like the legendary Sisyphus, deliverymen Laurel and Hardy struggle to push a large crated piano up a seemingly insurmountable flight of stairs.

items.name: Reindeer Games
items.description: An ex-con is forced into a casino heist.

items.name: Reporting Live
items.description: A young reporter and her reluctant cameraman chase a story, only to get entangled in an illegal sand-mining racket run by a ruthless syndicate.

items.name: 1 Million Followers
items.description: A small-town girl who is invited by a popular influencer to a mansion in Thailand where the beautiful mingle as they build Karissa up to a million followers. Things take a dark turn when they discover who the sponsor behind this e...

items.name: The Host
items.description: When an unseen enemy threatens mankind by taking over their bodies and erasing their memories, Melanie Stryder risks everything to protect the people she cares about.

items.name: The Getaway
items.description: A recently-released ex-con and his loyal wife go on the run after a heist goes awry.

items.name: McQueen
items.description: The life and career of fashion designer Lee Alexander McQueen: from his start as a tailor, to launching and overseeing his eponymous line and his untimely death.

items.name: Paternal Leave
items.description: Torn between longing and anger, 15-year-old Leo travels to the coast of northern Italy to meet her biological father. The two are complete strangers to each other. They struggle to find truth, affinity, love and the courage to face themselves.

items.name: Life in the Doghouse
items.description: LIFE IN THE DOG HOUSE will tell the inspiring stories of Danny and Ron's Rescue (501c3). The film will showcase their unique approach to dog rescue and adoption, which has enabled them to rescue and adopt out 10,000 dogs.

items.name: 24 Hours to Live
items.description: An assassin seeks redemption after being given a second chance at life.

items.name: Love on Trial
items.description: Mai, a rising J-Pop idol, is finally about to have her big break when she unexpectedly falls in love. But in a treacherous industry where young singers must maintain an image of flawless purity, love is forbidden. When her relationship is exposed, Mai's agency takes drastic action, dragging the couple to court over the "no love" clause in her contract, throwing her life into chaos.

items.name: Wedding for Money
items.description: Mircea hates weddings. And everyone knows that until he makes a controversial post on Facebook that goes viral. Because he has to return a huge amount of money due to wrong decisions, the only solution for him remains his own wedding.

items.name: The Stranger
items.description: A man faces a trial for murder. The court is biased because of his personal qualities.

items.name: Killdozer
items.description: A small construction crew on an island is terrorized when a spirit-like being takes over a large bulldozer, and goes on a killing rampage.

items.name: Nothing Sacred
items.description: An eccentric woman learns she is not dying of radium poisoning as earlier assumed, but when she meets a reporter looking for a story, she feigns sickness again for her own profit.

items.name: Maigret and the Dead Lover
items.description: Commissioner Maigret rushes to the Quai d’Orsay with Lieutenant Janvier. There, they find Mademoiselle Larrieu in a state of shock. That very morning, she discovered the bullet-riddled body of Mr. Berthier-Lagès, a renowned former ambassador whom she had served as a housekeeper for 46 years. While searching the victim's apartment, Maigret and Janvier uncover hundreds of letters. The diplomat had maintained a fifty-year-long love correspondence with a certain Princess of Vuynes, whose husband - by a strange coincidence - had died just a few days earlier. As he confronts the various members of the two families and the suspicious silence of Mademoiselle Larrieu, Maigret finds himself faced with surprise after surprise, watching his certainties crumble - until the solution to the mystery finally hits him in the face at the very last moment...

items.name: Camouflage
items.description: An actor discovers the dark side of private investigating when he takes on an assignment in rural Oregon with a crusty P.I.

items.name: Paris Can Wait
items.description: The wife of a successful movie producer takes a car trip from the south of France to Paris with one of her husband's associates.

items.name: The Looney, Looney, Looney Bugs Bunny Movie
items.description: Bugs Bunny hosts an award show featuring several classic Looney Toon shorts.

items.name: Clown
items.description: A loving father finds a clown suit for his son's birthday party, only to realize that it's cursed.

items.name: My Man Godfrey
items.description: A scatterbrained socialite hires a vagrant as a family butler - but there's more to Godfrey than meets the eye.

items.name: The Freshman
items.description: A nerdy college student will do anything to become popular on campus.

items.name: Jacknife
items.description: Two Vietnam vets search for the strength to face up to their horrific war experiences, but their friendship begins to splinter when one becomes romantically involved with the other's sister.

items.name: The Borrowers
items.description: A secret family of four-inch people living inside the walls of a house must save their home from an evil real estate developer.

items.name: Digging for Fire
items.description: The discovery of a bone and a gun send a husband and wife on separate adventures over the course of a weekend.

items.name: Holy Days
items.description: When young Brian discovers plans to close a convent of delightfully eccentric nuns, he sets off with them on a wild road trip across New Zealand to save their home.

items.name: The Book of Ruth: Journey of Faith
items.description: This movie is an adaptation of "The Book Of Ruth" from the bible. Powerful themes of tolerance and acceptance gained through love and understanding shine in this production.

items.name: Seven Years Bad Luck
items.description: After breaking a mirror in his home, superstitious Max tries to avoid situations which could bring bad luck-- but in doing so, causes himself the worst luck imaginable.

items.name: Tillie's Punctured Romance
items.description: Charlie talks wealthy farmer's daughter Tillie into eloping with him (and taking her father's money). In the city Tillie gets drunk and lands in jail while Charlie runs off with her money and his old girlfriend Mabel. Later Charlie reads that Tillie (now working as a waitress) has inherited the estate of her multi-millionaire uncle. Charlie dumps Mabel and talks Tillie into moving into her uncle's villa, and Mabel arranges to become a housemaid there. The uncle (never really dead) returns and summons the police to have them all thrown out.

items.name: Who Is Martin Mull?
items.description: Discover Martin Mull's restless reinvention from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms to gallery walls, told in his own words and by the friends who watched it happen, including Steve Martin, Tom Waits, David Alan Grier and others.

items.name: Sliver
items.description: A book editor has an affair with a high-tech voyeur in an exclusive Manhattan apartment building.

items.name: Coneheads
items.description: Aliens with conical crania crash-land on Earth.

items.name: Dark Encounter
items.description: Eight-year-old Maisie went missing in 1982 and a memorial is held by her family a year later. That evening, strange lights and sounds are observed in the woods outside - and strange things start to happen.

items.name: The Man with the Golden Arm
items.description: A junkie must face his true self to kick his drug addiction.

items.name: Hanging Up
items.description: A trio of sisters bond over their ambivalence toward the approaching death of their curmudgeonly father, to whom none of them was particularly close.

items.name: Yentl
items.description: A Jewish girl disguises herself as a boy to enter religious training.

items.name: Something of Value
items.description: In British Colonial Kenya during the Mau Mau uprising, Peter and Kimani, who grew up together, find themselves on the opposite sides.

items.name: Blackboard Jungle
items.description: A new English teacher at a violent, unruly inner-city school is determined to do his job, despite resistance from both students and faculty.

items.name: Crazy Rich, Incredibly Broke
items.description: A wealthy family loses their fortune and chooses to continue to fake affluence in an effort to keep up appearances.

items.name: The Man from Earth: Holocene
items.description: A 14,000-year-old college professor notices that he has finally started showing signs of aging. Meanwhile, four of his students get suspicious of him and start investigating his past.

items.name: Genocide
items.description: Orson Welles and Elizabeth Taylor compassionately narrate this harrowing documentary about Jewish persecution in Nazi Germany, which soon turned into a notoriously industrious plan to wipe them from existence.

items.name: The Bounty
items.description: Fed up with their Captain's harsh discipline, a sailing ship's crew decides to take action.

items.name: Lost on Everest
items.description: A team of climbers set out to find Irvine and his climbing partner George Mallory camera. If that camera could be found, it would rewrite history.

items.name: Less of a Stranger
items.description: As the leader of Polish rock band Lady Pank, Jan Borysewicz shapes a generation with his music, while a string of family tragedies shapes him.

items.name: Jamie Foxx: Take Care of Yourself
items.description: Jamie Foxx delivers honest self-care comedy in "Take Care of Yourself." He joins the "Hularious" lineup with Hannah Berner, Ralph Barbosa, Bill Burr, Chris Distefano, Jim Gaffigan, Zarna Garg, Nikki Glaser, Ilana Glazer and more.

items.name: A Cop
items.description: After a shaky first heist, a group of thieves plan an even more elaborate and risky second heist.

items.name: The Swan: Behind the Mirror
items.description: Two decades after "The Swan" shocked audiences, the women who underwent extreme makeovers and the show's creators reunite to examine the reality series that transformed their lives and sparked debate about beauty standards in Amer...

items.name: Mononoke Movie: Paper Umbrella
items.description: A deadly and mysterious master of the occult travels across feudal Japan, seeking malevolent spirits called Mononoke to slay. He must uncover their Form, Truth, and Reason to wield the mighty Exorcism Sword against them.

items.name: The Learning Tree
items.description: A bittersweet, idyllic story about a year in the life of 14-year-old Newt Winger, born into a poor Black family in Kansas, who learns about love, fear, racial injustice, and immorality.

items.name: Guyver
items.description: Young man merges with mechanical device, becoming cyborg superhero. Strange creatures emerge, seeking to reclaim device. He uncovers plot to genetically engineer monstrous creatures.

items.name: House
items.description: A schoolgirl and six of her classmates travel to her aunt's country home, which turns out to be haunted.

items.name: Fragments of Belonging
items.description: Tatjana is lonely. Born in Croatia, she has lived across Europe before settling in Amsterdam. Fifteen years later, her teenage son avoids bringing friends home, embarrassed by her dreadful Slavic accent and her lack of Dutch composure. But the real trouble is bigger: Tatjana feels foreign everywhere. Determined to belong, she starts knocking on doors across Europe, asking relatives and friends how they did it. Stumbling through cultural misfires and everyday bias, she finally confronts a dark pattern in her own family history.

items.name: Stavisky
items.description: A swindler's activity indirectly caused a political crisis in France in the last years before World War II.

items.name: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY The Sorcery of Nymph Circe
items.description: Hathaway Noa plans his attack on the Adelaide Conference while Federation officer Kenneth Sleg prepares to defend it. With each man pursuing his own goal, Gigi Andalucia heads to Hong Kong to fulfill a role of her own.

items.name: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III - The Curse of the Serpent
items.description: When tragedy strikes within the walls of the Ōoku, twisted human passions and festering grudges spawn the Medicine Seller's most fearsome opponent yet.

items.name: The Mask You Live In
items.description: Explores how our culture's narrow definition of masculinity is harming our boys, men and society at large and unveils what we can do about it.

items.name: Shall We Dance?
items.description: A romantic comedy where a bored, overworked Estate Lawyer, upon first sight of a beautiful instructor, signs up for ballroom dancing lessons.

items.name: Step Up: Revolution
items.description: Emily arrives in Miami with aspirations to become a professional dancer. She sparks with Sean, the leader of a dance crew whose neighborhood is threatened by Emily's father's real estate development plans.

items.name: Sam Morril: Incorrect
items.description: Sam Morril delivers savage laughs as he relives his worst one-night stand, compares famous assassinations and details an unorthodox rat extermination.

items.name: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter II - The Ashes of Rage
items.description: The Medicine Seller returns as the Edo harem faces a new crisis, with family feuds, inner turmoil and fiery envy igniting the birth of a raging spirit.

items.name: Lucky Them
items.description: A rock journalist is assigned to track down her ex-boyfriend.

items.name: The Man Who Knew Too Little
items.description: Wallace Ritchie is mistaken for a spy and must stop a plot to assassinate international leaders at a banquet.

items.name: Amazon Women on the Moon
items.description: A spoof of low budget 1950s science-fiction movies, interspersed with various comedy sketches and fake commercials making fun of late-night television.

items.name: The Sacrament
items.description: A news team trails a man as he travels into the world of Eden Parish to find his missing sister, where it becomes apparent that this paradise may not be as it seems.

items.name: My Life as a Dog
items.description: In the late '50s, young Ingemar learns a lot about life and himself when he is sent away from his sick mother to live with his aunt and uncle in a town full of eccentrics.

items.name: Paradise Lost 2: Revelations
items.description: The case of the West Memphis Three, its questionable circumstances and the parties involved are followed up years later.

items.name: Paradise Lost: The Child Murders at Robin Hood Hills
items.description: A horrific triple child murder leads to an indictment and trial of three nonconformist boys based on questionable evidence.

items.name: Feed
items.description: A cybercrime investigator tracks a man suspected of force-feeding women to death.

items.name: Enzo
items.description: Enzo, 16, defies his bourgeois family’s expectations by starting a masonry apprenticeship, a path far removed from the prestigious life they had envisioned for him. In their chic villa in the sun-drenched South of France, tensions simmer as relentless questions and pressures weigh on Enzo’s future and dreams. On the construction sites, however, Vlad, a charismatic Ukrainian colleague, shakes up Enzo’s world and opens the door to unexpected possibilities.

items.name: Diamonds of the Night
items.description: Two Jewish boys escape from a train transporting them from one concentration camp to another. The film goes beyond the themes of war and anti-Nazism and concerns itself with man's struggle to preserve human dignity.

items.name: The Sunshine Boys
items.description: A vaudeville duo agree to reunite for a television special, but it turns out that they can't stand each other.

items.name: A Raisin in the Sun
items.description: A substantial insurance payment could mean either financial salvation or personal ruin for a poor black family.

items.name: Wildcat
items.description: Follows an ex-black ops team that reunites to pull off a desperate heist and save the life of an eight-year-old girl.

items.name: Lust Stories 3
items.description: Multiple narratives delve into contemporary relationships, portraying desire in its many forms while examining how vulnerability and unspoken tensions influence the ways people connect.

items.name: Alien Whispers
items.description: In the Texas town of Amarillo, her family will unknowingly open the door to evil that will change their lives forever. The family will have to call upon God to help them remove the demons from the house. Based on the true story of Ashley Hays Wright.

items.name: Wham! 10 Days in China
items.description: In 1985, WHAM! made history as the first Western pop act to perform in communist China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley’s concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou were a cultural milestone – East meets West, music meets politics. Now, newly restored footage reveals the untold story of the iconic tour that helped launch WHAM! to global superstardom.

items.name: Paradise Lost 3: Purgatory
items.description: A further followup of the case of the West Memphis Three and the decades long fight to exonerate them that finally gained traction with new DNA evidence.

items.name: Sweet and Lowdown
items.description: In the 1930s, jazz guitarist Emmet Ray idolizes Django Reinhardt, faces gangsters and falls in love with a mute woman.

items.name: The Hit
items.description: Ten years after Willie Parker ratted on his old mobster friends in exchange for personal immunity, two hit men kidnap him and drive him to Paris for his planned execution. However, they encounter many mishaps along the way.

items.name: One Little Finger
items.description: An American neurologist uproots her life to study music therapy in India and ends up helping people with disabilities by bringing them together through music.

items.name: Botched
items.description: During a heist in Russia, a professional thief finds himself dealing with serial killers, insane hostages, double-crossing psycho Russian hardmen and the real possibility of a horrible death.

items.name: Made in America
items.description: An international apocalypse bombards John with media coverage and political crusaders, threatening his sanity and beloved way of life. He must decipher their ramblings and battle a stream of advertisements to escape the USA's imminent doom.

items.name: The Signal
items.description: A horror film told in three parts, from three perspectives, in which a mysterious transmission that turns people into killers invades every cell phone, radio, and television.

items.name: The Gray Man
items.description: Obsessive manhunt to identify and capture a despicable serial killer.

items.name: Walker, Texas Ranger: Trial by Fire
items.description: Walker investigates a murder connected with a missing government weapon. In addition, he tries to track down a teen on the run from a crime syndicate.

items.name: Chickenhare and the Secret of the Groundhog
items.description: Chickenhare embarks on an epic quest, a mysterious groundhog with the power to reverse time and save his species. His adventure takes a dangerous turn when his group discover they are not the only ones searching for this ancient power.

items.name: Dead Men Don't Wear Plaid
items.description: Film noir parody with a detective uncovering a sinister plot. Characters from classic noir films appear as scenes from various movies interjected into the story.

items.name: One Last Shot
items.description: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

items.name: The Out of Towners
items.description: Ohio sales executive George Kellerman accepts a higher position within the company and travels to New York City with his wife Gwen for his job interview. But things start badly and only grow worse in Neil Simon's dark urban comedy.

items.name: 35 Downhill
items.description: Ben arrives to his native Kibbutz and plans to ask his distant father Albert to help him recover a family apartment looted in WWII. But Albert has other plans... Completely drunk, he has bet that he could cross the country from north to south on a tractor in less than a week.

items.name: Mike Bassett: England Manager
items.description: Manager suffers heart attack. Unqualified replacement Mike Bassett takes over national team. Bassett makes questionable decisions, unorthodox training methods. Despite obstacles, team qualifies for World Cup tournament in Rio.

items.name: Guyver: Dark Hero
items.description: Sean Barker, unwilling host to an alien bio-armor known as the Guyver, must fight the Kronos Corporation again before they discover the secrets of the Guyver's origin.

items.name: Johnny Handsome
items.description: After being double crossed and thrown in prison, a deformed gangster gets a new face and rehabilitation, but his desire for revenge looms.

items.name: Lionheart
items.description: An Ex-French Soldier begins participating in underground street fights in order to make money for his brother's family.

items.name: Hoop Dreams
items.description: A film following the lives of two inner-city Chicago boys who struggle to become college basketball players on the road to going professional.

items.name: Return to Nim's Island
items.description: With the help of a young runaway, a feisty 14-year-old fights to keep her idyllic island home from the clutches of developers.

items.name: Mixed Nuts
items.description: The events focus around a crisis hotline business on one crazy night during the Christmas holidays.

items.name: White Oleander
items.description: A teenager journeys through a series of foster homes after her mother goes to prison for committing a crime of passion.

items.name: Radio Rebel
items.description: Tara, a painfully shy high-schooler, has a secret: she is also a confident DJ known as Radio Rebel, who lends her voice to others.

items.name: Two Brothers
items.description: Two tigers are separated as cubs and taken into captivity, only to be reunited years later as enemies by an explorer who inadvertently forces them to fight each other.

items.name: We Will Dance Again
items.description: A minute-by-minute retelling of the Supernova Music Festival Massacre, which took place on October 7th.

items.name: Truck Turner
items.description: While tracking a strong-armed pimp who has skipped bail, a bounty hunter discovers a contract has been put out on him and must go on the run.

items.name: Forbidden Zone
items.description: The bizarre and musical tale of a girl who travels to another dimension through the gateway found in her family's basement.

items.name: Abductee
items.description: One man's descent into madness as he tries to discover what comes for him in the middle of the night.

items.name: The Marsh
items.description: A young beautiful but stressed out children's writer seeks out a holiday in the country but becomes the lead character in a supernatural mystery she must solve to save her life

items.name: Angst
items.description: A troubled man gets released from prison and starts taking out his sadistic fantasies on an unsuspecting family living in a secluded house.

items.name: Iron Within
items.description: As Drukhari raiders plague an Imperial planet, the embattled Astra Militarum send out a desperate cry for help. Salvation arrives in the form of a force of Space Marines, but the population of the planet soon learn to be careful what they wish for...

items.name: Siren: The Voices of Shelley Beattie
items.description: Shelley Beattie, a Deaf woman and champion bodybuilder, found fame in the 1990s on the hit TV show American Gladiators, where she competed under the name "Siren" before her untimely death in 2008. While charismatic, gorgeous, and a fierce competitor, Beattie also battled personal demons, struggling with mental illness, addiction, and questions of her own identity. Framed by the insight of another Deaf woman in Hollywood who found herself in the spotlight at the same time, Academy Award-winning actress Marlee Matlin, the documentary unpacks the story of Shelley "Siren" Beattie and her complex legacy entwined with beauty, mental illness, and love.

items.name: In Search of a Midnight Kiss
items.description: Broke and alone on New Year's Eve, Wilson just wants to spend the rest of a very bad year in bed. But, when his best friend convinces him to post a personal ad, he meets a woman bent on finding the right guy to be with at midnight.

items.name: Buying Her
items.description: "Buying Her" takes a deep dive into the stories of men who buy sex.

items.name: Taxidermia
items.description: Story about three generations of men: pervert that constantly seeks for new kinds of satisfaction, an obese speed eater and a passionate embalmer.

items.name: General Mayhem: The Killing of Brigadier J
items.description: When a young officer is murdered inside a general's home, a high-stakes investigation exposes a web of corruption and a cover-up reaching the highest ranks of the National Police.

items.name: Demon Pond
items.description: Mysterious pond near Japanese village inhabited by mythical beings. Their narrative revolves around vengeance, heartbreak, and the strength of genuine affection.

items.name: Death Warrant
items.description: An undercover operative infiltrates a state prison to investigate mysterious inmate deaths, only to find his psychopathic nemesis has been transferred into the same facility to execute him on behalf of a corrupt official.

items.name: Watermelon Magic
items.description: International audiences will delight in this nearly wordless burst of color and music that draws inspiration from film classic 'The Red Balloon'. Weaving together documentary and narrative elements, 'Watermelon Magic' chronicles a season on the family farm, as young Sylvie grows a patch of watermelons to sell market. The film employs a dynamic visual style that uses high-resolution stills at varying shutter-burst frame rates with stunning time-lapse sequences to trace the journey from seed to flower to fruit. When harvest time arrives, Sylvie must decide if she will share her precious babies with the world.

items.name: The Ruffian
items.description: The adventures of a group of friends who plan to recover crates full of gold from a fall in Canada.

items.name: Gracias, equipo
items.description: Tío Mochales, a company that, years ago, was the undisputed queen of Spanish cheese. Today, it's a somewhat rusty business trying to keep up appearances. Their latest big idea: to organise a rural team-building retreat in the vill...

items.name: Rock 'n' Roll High School
items.description: Ramones fanatic and delinquent Riff Randell battles it out with the strict new principal of Vince Lombardi High School, Miss Togar, with help from the Ramones.

items.name: Pillow Talk
items.description: An interior decorator and a playboy songwriter share a telephone party line and size each other up.

items.name: Terrifier
items.description: A maniac named Art the Clown terrorizes two friends on Halloween and everyone who gets in his way.

items.name: House on Eden
items.description: Setting out to film their next paranormal investigation, Kris, Celina and Jay encounter a malevolent, ancient spirit that resides in an abandoned house deep in the woods.

items.name: Date with Love
items.description: When a small-town boy's video Promposal goes viral, it scores him a Prom date with his celebrity crush. Complications arise when the celebrity falls for the boy's teacher.

items.name: The Meteor Man
items.description: A high school teacher from a troubled inner city Washington D.C. neighborhood becomes a super-powered hero and takes on the gang that has been terrorizing his streets.

items.name: Band of Brothers: Legacy
items.description: A documentary tribute to the series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company, in line with the 25th anniversary of HBO's original limited series.

items.name: Dracula
items.description: Transylvanian vampire Count Dracula bends a naive real estate agent to his will, then takes up residence at a London estate where he sleeps in his coffin by day and searches for potential victims by night.

items.name: Alpha
items.description: The ALPHA girls are here

items.name: Bull Run
items.description: In the wilds of Wall Street, one junior banker discovers that the only thing more dangerous than billion-dollar deals are the men signing them.

items.name: Rubikon
items.description: Following a catastrophe on Earth, the planet is covered in a toxic fog. The crew in the space station, must decide whether to risk their lives to get home and search for survivors, or stay safe in the station's "algae symbiosis sy...

items.name: An Affair
items.description: A newly appointed teacher finds herself being followed, and soon discovers that one of her own students is obsessed with her.

items.name: Jo Koy: Blue in the Face
items.description: Jo Koy relives a wild dental disaster, recounts getting fired from McDonald's and celebrates his veteran stepdad in this hilariously heartfelt set.

items.name: The Dreadful
items.description: The Dreadful follows Anne and her mother-in-law Morwen who live a solitary, harsh life on the outskirts of society - but when a man from their past returns, he will set off a sequence of events that become a turning point for Anne.

items.name: Neil Young: Heart of Gold
items.description: A film shot over during a two-night performance by Neil Young at Nashville's Ryman Auditorium.

items.name: The In Between
items.description: After surviving a car accident that took the life of her boyfriend, a teenage girl believes he's attempting to reconnect with her from the after world.

items.name: Paradise Road
items.description: A group of women who are imprisoned on the island of Sumatra by the Japanese during World War II use music to relieve their misery.

items.name: Blade: Trinity
items.description: Blade, now a wanted man by the FBI, must join forces with the Nightstalkers to face his most challenging enemy yet: Dracula.

items.name: Street
items.description: Remo Street is a young fighter who has to choose between the long hard road to honor and glory, or succumbing to a brutal future as a cage fighter for the Russian Mafia.

items.name: John Farnham: Finding the Voice
items.description: John Farnham: Finding the Voice tells the untold story of an Australian music icon. In this first authorised biopic, we follow Farnham’s life from the quiet suburbs of Melbourne to ‘60s pop fame, through incredible highs and lows, and ultimately to record-breaking success as ‘Australia’s Voice’. John Farnham was 38 years old when Whispering Jack was released. Nobody ever questioned that Farnham could sing -- but the challenge to find his artistic voice and become Australia’s most trusted and beloved performer took half a lifetime. Whispering Jack is still the highest selling Australian album of all time, and this powerful documentary tracks the personal and public journey that has made Farnham Australia’s greatest and most beloved musical artist.

items.name: The Runner
items.description: In the aftermath of the 2010 BP oil spill, an idealistic but flawed politician is forced to confront his dysfunctional life after his career is destroyed in a sex scandal.

items.name: Jawbreaker
items.description: Three of the most popular girls at Reagan High accidentally kill the prom queen with a jawbreaker when a kidnapping goes horribly wrong.

items.name: Wyrmwood: Apocalypse
items.description: In a zombie-infested Australian wasteland, soldier Rhys has dedicated his life to tracking and capturing survivors for the Surgeon General in hopes of finding a cure.

items.name: Baby's Day Out
items.description: After three kidnappers lose the baby they have kidnapped, both the cops and kidnappers go looking for the baby.

items.name: Mesrine: Public Enemy No. 1
items.description: The story of the notorious French gangster Jacques Mesrine, with the focus on his life and death as France's Public Enemy No. 1 in the 1970s.

items.name: Anaconda
items.description: A "National Geographic" film crew is taken hostage by an insane hunter, who forces them along on his quest to capture the world's largest - and deadliest - snake.

items.name: Mockingbird Don't Sing
items.description: Based on the actual events of one of the most horrific cases of child abuse ever to be documented, this haunting drama tells the tale of a young girl who was locked in a room for over 12 years.

items.name: The Gay Divorcee
items.description: A woman thinks a flirting man is the co-respondent her lawyer has hired to expedite her divorce.

items.name: Queer
items.description: In 1950s Mexico City, an American immigrant in his late forties leads a solitary life amidst a small American community. However, the arrival of a young student stirs the man into finally establishing a meaningful connection with ...

items.name: The Wave
items.description: A high school teacher's experiment to demonstrate to his students what life is like under a dictatorship spins horribly out of control when he forms a social unit with a life of its own.

items.name: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air Reunion
items.description: 30 years later, we're bringing the Banks family back together. Join Will Smith and his former co-stars for a funny and heartfelt night full of music and dancing in honor of the show that ran for six seasons and 148 episodes.

items.name: The Doll
items.description: Eastern France, nowadays.  Rémi, who has never recovered from a heartbreak, shares his life with a doll called Audrey. But the day his new coworker, Patricia, arrives at his company, Audrey comes to life. The two women will turn Rémi’s life upside down.

items.name: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
items.description: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

items.name: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song
items.description: A documentary film that observes, listens to, and interacts with Fito Páez from a place of profound intimacy. The camera, almost invisible, witnesses his every move, accompanying him for over a year during recordings, rehearsals, tours, and performances in major cities across Latin America, Europe, and the United States. It is also a journey through the life of one of the greatest Spanish-language artists: his loves and heartbreaks, children and friendships, excesses, tragedies, failures, and successes.

items.name: Frightvision
items.description: Prepare yourself for five twisted tales of terror hosted by everyone's favorite sinister succubus, Dr. Boobenstein. Featuring vicious vixens, flesh-eating mist, Vengeful Aztec gods, talking corpses, sinister Santas, and more. So sit back, turn out the lights, and get ready for your worst nightmares to unfold.

items.name: La Fiera
items.description: Three skydivers died in similar accidents within five years. Salvador Calvo wanted to tell their stories with the sole survivor, Carlos Suárez.

items.name: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​
items.description: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?

items.name: Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear
items.description: Follows famed Blink-182 drummer Travis Barker through his life, including the plane crash that he survived.

items.name: Never Change!
items.description: Former high school seniors reunite in their 30s to complete their education after a tornado abruptly ended their final year in 2005. As they return to the halls of North Meadows High, past relationships reignite and hidden truths ...

items.name: Sally
items.description: Sally Ride's groundbreaking journey as the first American woman in space concealed a deeply personal story. Her life partner, Tam O'Shaughnessy, unveils their covert 27-year romance and its accompanying sacrifices.

items.name: The Unthinkable Daughter
items.description: Decades of questions and a crime that shook Brazil. Suzane von Richthofen, convicted for the murder of her parents, tells the whole story in her own words.

items.name: State of Fear
items.description: Brotherhood members face a crisis as key leaders transfer to maximum security prisons. Elisa, 18, daughter of founder Edson, is kidnapped by corrupt police. Her aunt Cristina attempts rescue while the faction orders "Salve Geral."

items.name: Nothing to Lose
items.description: She gave everything to become a mother, so when her young son falls ill, Jada will stop at  nothing to find a donor and save him — no matter the cost.

items.name: 23 000 Lives
items.description: A group of young people sets sail for the Mediterranean to save the lives of refugees — a mission that puts their ideas of law and justice to the test.

items.name: Un hijo propio
items.description: Desperate to become a mother Alejandra fakes a pregnancy. The simple lie spirals into a months-long charade before her husband and family, trapping her in deception that pushes her to cross an irreversible line.

items.name: Untold UK: Vinnie Jones
items.description: How the bad boy of English football became a Hollywood tough guy.

items.name: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
items.description: Olli believes his best friend Matze has been brainwashed by a new girlfriend, threatening their planned world trip, so he tries to push her out of their lives.

items.name: Ikka
items.description: A respected attorney must defend a murder suspect he previously brought down. Forced into the case, he bends every rule to secure freedom for his former enemy or risk losing all he cherishes.

items.name: This, That, and Everything in Between
items.description: A TV writer returns home to her estranged mother, igniting chaos as they navigate painful secrets and the  complexities of their dysfunctional family.

items.name: The Four Seasons
items.description: Witty character study of three couples who vacation together each season. After one divorces, feelings of betrayal and more spawn criticisms of one another, but things that unite them are stronger than those which might pull them ...

items.name: Trainwreck: P.I. Moms
items.description: This tell-all documentary investigates an early 2000s reality show about private eye moms and the drug scandal that sabotaged the series and its stars.

items.name: My Dearest Assassin
items.description: Hunted for her rare blood type, a caged woman vows to fight alongside the assassin she loves to protect their future when an old enemy resurfaces.

items.name: The Plastic Detox
items.description: Six couples with unexplained infertility reduce their plastic exposure to improve their chances of conceiving.

items.name: Britain and the Blitz
items.description: This approach brings history to life through vividly restored archival footage and firsthand accounts of WWII Britain during the Blitz.

items.name: Kevin Costner Presents: The First Christmas
items.description: Kevin Costner hosts this special exploring the extraordinary journey of Mary and Joseph as they navigate the hardships, trials and triumphs surrounding Jesus Christ's birth, offering an inspiring way to experience the true meaning of Christmas.

items.name: Nando Entre Dois Mundos: Um Filme Sintonia
items.description: A former crime boss living in exile must return to Brazil when his teenage daughter disappears, forcing him to face the violent underworld he left behind while fighting to protect his family.

items.name: Stiller & Meara: Nothing Is Lost
items.description: Ben Stiller tells the story of his parents—comedy icons Jerry Stiller and Anne Meara—exploring their impact on popular culture and at home, where the lines between creativity, family, life, and art often blurred.

items.name: Ghost Elephants
items.description: In the highlands of Angola, conservation biologist Steve Boyes sets out on an epic journey to search for a mysterious, elusive herd of ghost elephants - creatures long believed to be a myth.

items.name: Snow White
items.description: A princess joins forces with seven dwarfs and a group of rebels to liberate her kingdom from her cruel stepmother the Evil Queen.

items.name: Fantasy Football Ruined Our Lives
items.description: A Fantasy Football League group loses a member. When soccer enthusiast Andrea joins, it disrupts their dynamic. They must search for Gianni, who vanished following his bachelor party.

items.name: 27 Nights
items.description: When a woman is admitted by her daughters to a psychiatric clinic for her carefree ways, an expert must judge if she is ill or simply wants to enjoy life.

items.name: Orangutan
items.description: Narrated by Josh Gad, journey high into the rainforest canopy of Southeast Asia where a magnificent and mysterious community filled with playful personalities lives. Witness the exhilarating action, heartwarming encounters, and a closeup look at a stunning jungle teeming with wildlife as the inquisitive adolescent orangutan Indah prepares to leave her family and venture out on her own for the first time.

items.name: The Time That Remains
items.description: Surrounded by a string of deaths, an older woman relives her romance with a mysterious, ageless lover as an inspector closes in on their dark secret.

items.name: The Giant Falls
items.description: Follows Boris, a charismatic tour guide who unexpectedly reunites with his estranged father Julián. Their tense and emotional encounters explore past wounds and the possibility of forgiveness.

items.name: Noah Kahan: Out of Body
items.description: Chronicles Kahan's rise to fame and explores his mental health challenges while dealing with his growing fame.

items.name: Sangre del Toro
items.description: Director Guillermo del Toro journeys through a labyrinth of childhood memories, cultural myths and monsters to reveal the origins of his visionary films.

items.name: My Grandfather Charles Manson
items.description: Sophia was always the good girl growing up and her father's rock, but her quest to identify her unknown grandfather results in a shocking discovery: He is Charles Manson, history's most notorious criminal; and he bears striking physical similarities to her beloved father. Sophia's discovery propels her into an underworld of Manson family members and unreliable narrators as she traces her grandfather's life. Along the way, her genetics unlock never-before-released records and audio recordings that illuminate Manson's pathology in startling ways. But the more Sophia uncovers, the more her relationship with her father is strained. For Sophia, there's no turning back. What has she inherited, and how will she reckon with her family legacy?

items.name: The Follies
items.description: Six women share a common 'friend': madness. It visits us all, pushes us to decide reality, to make daring decisions and to transform our lives.

items.name: Flintoff
items.description: Follows Freddie Flintoff's cricket career, his recovery from a near-fatal car crash while filming "Top Gear" in 2022, and his return to cricket.

items.name: Sniper: No Nation
items.description: כאשר הצלף המומחה אייס ברנדון בקט מואשם כטרוריסט ומודח על ידי מדינתו, הוא נאלץ להיעלם מהרדאר ולצאת למשימת הצלה בלתי אפשרית לצד אביו האגדי. ללא תמיכה, ללא גבולות וללא חוקים, עליהם להתמודד עם לגיון הברזל, צבא שכירי חרב חסר רחמים, כדי לעצור משטר מושחת מלהצית מלחמה - ולהוכיח שגם ללא דגל, הקרב עדיין חשוב.

items.name: Everybody Loves Me When I'm Dead
items.description: Two bank employees who try to steal from an unclaimed account, only to discover the money belongs to dangerous individuals eager to reclaim it.

items.name: Conan O'Brien: The Kennedy Center Mark Twain Prize for American Humor
items.description: Comedy stars unite to honor Conan O'Brien as he receives the Mark Twain Prize for American Humor.

items.name: Love+War
items.description: Pulitzer Prize-winning conflict photojournalist Lynsey Addario reflects on a career working in some of the world's most dangerous war zones, including the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

items.name: Lefter: The Story of the Ordinarius
items.description: An aspiring footballer defies his strict father to chase his dream, navigating challenges in family, love, and identity - all in the name of greatness.

items.name: I Can Only Imagine 2
items.description: Bart Millard, lead singer of MercyMe, faces a personal crisis at the peak of his success. As his world unravels, he struggles with his beliefs and inner demons while seeking a path through adversity.

items.name: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
items.description: Comedian Mo Gilligan embarks on a daring 28-day journey across the UK and US, eating only fried chicken to explore the craving and the industry fueling it.

items.name: Me Before Me
items.description: A young student battling pressure, panic and a demanding father uses a class project to discover that truth — not trophies — might finally set him free.

items.name: A Letter to My Youth
items.description: A rebellious teen and a reserved caretaker form an unlikely bond in an orphanage as they come to terms with their painful pasts.

items.name: Strangers in the Park
items.description: A former communist activist and a laid-back man who embraces a "live and let live" philosophy strike up an unlikely friendship while meeting regularly on a park bench, discovering common ground despite their contrasting worldviews.

items.name: THE RIBBON HERO
items.description: When the monstrous Nergal devastates her kingdom, Princess Sapphire reawakens as the Ribbon Hero and fights to save her new home from the same dark fate.

items.name: Swim to Me
items.description: Estela, a young woman from rural Chile, embarks on a journey to Santiago, leaving her family behind to work as a maid for an affluent household.

items.name: #Skyking
items.description: A troubled airport worker's impulsive decision to steal and fly a commercial plane becomes a gripping aerial drama that reflects deeper issues of mental health and working-class struggles in America.

items.name: One Shot with Ed Sheeran
items.description: Ed Sheeran performs his hits in one continuous take while walking NYC streets, riding subways and meeting fans, creating spontaneous musical moments throughout the city.

items.name: The Bus: A French Football Mutiny
items.description: This documentary revisits the controversy surrounding the French team during the 2010 FIFA World Cup and the strike that made headlines and outraged an entire country.

items.name: The Rose of Versailles
items.description: In an age of revolution, Marie Antoinette and her protector Oscar François de Jarjayes face tough choices as women growing into their distinct roles.

items.name: Millionaire
items.description: A Chilean man hits the headlines when his damaged lottery ticket claiming a life-changing jackpot sparks a national investigation.

items.name: Golden Kamuy -The Abashiri Prison Raid-
items.description: As each group pursues their mission, a fierce battle unfolds over the tattooed prisoners. Who is friend, and who is foe? The fight leads them all to Abashiri Prison, where Noppera-bo, the man who holds all the answers, is locked away...

items.name: Untold UK: Liverpool's Miracle of Istanbul
items.description: At half-time in the 2005 champion league final Liverpool were 3-0 down. What happened next made football history -​ as players recall in this documentary.

items.name: Kartavya
items.description: A police officer must hunt an exploited teenage assassin while his own family collapses under caste driven violence and moral absolutism, forcing him toward irreversible choices between institutional loyalty and blood ties.

items.name: Disney Worldbuilders
items.description: We sit down with some of the key figures shaping Disney’s most enduring stories for a series of intimate conversations about their early years, first sparks, and formative Disney memories — and how the worlds they once dreamed up are now taking shape at Disney destinations around the globe.

items.name: Disneyland Handcrafted
items.description: Hundreds of craftspeople brought Walt Disney's impossible dream of Disneyland to life in 1955. Rare archival footage and recordings reveal their untold stories of artistry and determination.

items.name: Test
items.description: Three people's worlds collide during a historic international cricket test match in Chennai which ultimately forces them to make life-changing difficult decisions.

items.name: CMXXIV
items.description: Turkish comedy heavyweight Cem Yilmaz takes the stand-up stage in this dynamic special - covering everything from cancel culture to regretful tattoos.

items.name: Death Before the Wedding
items.description: When a small town's local dairy farm is about to get shut down, a father makes a plea with the new CEO's wife to keep it open in exchange for planning his daughter's wedding.

items.name: Pets
items.description: Worldwide stories of human-animal bonds, following pet owners and rescuers with dogs, cats, pigs, goats and birds of prey. Features interviews, archives and viral clips showing people's connections with their animals.

items.name: Kumail Nanjiani: Night Thoughts
items.description: After nearly a decade away, Kumail Nanjiani returns to Chicago, where he got his start in standup, in a special that tackles anxiety, the perils of buying drugs pre-legalization, and cat medication.

items.name: The Debt Collector
items.description: Haunted by guilt after prison, a former debt collector races against a terminal illness, returning to his old world to avenge loan shark victims.

items.name: Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour - The Final Show
items.description: Taylor Swift's Vancouver Eras Tour finale features 45 songs, including a new "Female Rage" segment and special medleys. The concert marked the end of her record-breaking global tour at BC Place Stadium.

items.name: Lainey Wilson: Keepin' Country Cool
items.description: Lainey Wilson redefines what it means to be a modern country star while exploring her struggles and triumphs at a pivotal career moment.

items.name: Frozen Hot Boys
items.description: Driven by her personal agenda, a teacher at a juvenile detention center convinces a crew of teenage misfits to enter an snow sculpting contest in Japan.

items.name: Matt Rife: Unwrapped: A Christmas Crowd Work Special
items.description: Who is on Matt Rife's naughty or nice list? Find out as the comedian shares his thoughts on gifts, holiday traditions, and more.

items.name: Taylor Tomlinson: Prodigal Daughter
items.description: This is Taylor Tomlinson's fourth Netflix special, following Quarter-Life Crisis (2020), Look At You (2022), and Have It All (2024).

items.name: Eloá the Hostage: Live on TV
items.description: A tragic hostage case from 2008 Brazil unfolds through unseen diary entries, family interviews, and media coverage, as a 15-year-old girl is held captive by her ex-boyfriend for 100 hours while TV networks broadcast it live.

items.name: The Balloonist
items.description: Gaby, a heritage chicken keeper, is turned upside down when an arrogant air balloon pilot crashes on her chicken coop. The crash reveals the roots of a family conflict and forces Gaby to confront the air balloon pilot as well as h...

items.name: Love in Slow Motion
items.description: When Haya's best friend Jawad gets engaged, her chronically-single world unravels — because who knew true love could be hiding in the friend zone?

items.name: Color Book
items.description: Following the passing of his wife, a devoted father is learning to raise his son with Down Syndrome as a single parent. While adjusting to their new reality, the two embark on a journey through Metro Atlanta to attend their first baseball game.

items.name: Tony Hinchcliffe: Man of the People
items.description: Tony Hinchcliffe takes center stage to prove no topic is too taboo and nothing is off-limits — not even the audience — in this razor-sharp special.

items.name: Harry Styles. One Night in Manchester
items.description: Harry Styles performs his new album "Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally" for the first time at a special one-off Manchester concert recorded March 6.

items.name: Lali: Time To Step Up
items.description: This documentary follows Lali in her return after four years away from the stage, showcasing the personal journey that led her to become the artist we know today.

items.name: Yoh! Bestie
items.description: Thando's never been lucky in love. Now her best friend returns home with a fiancée on his arm, forcing her to confront a new emotion: jealousy.

items.name: One Hit Wonder
items.description: When big dreams meet second chances, two dreamers Entoy and Lorina chase fame in the world of '90s OPM. Will they make it?

items.name: Chris & Martina: The Final Set
items.description: Tennis legends Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova reflect on their parallel journeys to sports stardom while delving into their rivalry and friendship, especially as the duo continue to support each other through their shared experience of cancer treatment.

items.name: The Biggest Fan
items.description: Canceled in Hollywood, star Lana Cruz heads to her hometown for a comeback. Enter Polly, her fan-turned-frenemy. Can Lana dodge drama and reclaim her fame?

items.name: Another You
items.description: Mümtaz and Derya are condemned to live out their last moments each day in someone else's skin.

items.name: I Wish You Had Told Me
items.description: When a young missionary uncovers his late father's long-held secret, he travels from the Philippines to Spain in search of his dad's forbidden love.

items.name: BTS: The Return
items.description: Follows BTS as they reunite in Los Angeles after completing military service, confronting how to begin again, honor their past, and move forward together as they return to making music.

items.name: Kontrabida Academy
items.description: When a mysterious TV transports her to a school for on-screen villains, a restaurant worker finds new purpose - and a way to get back at her enemies.

items.name: Barbara
items.description: Meet Barbara, who takes the name Shirin David as a rapper and becomes one of the most successful German-speaking artists. Shows her struggles with perfectionism, business, and identity.

items.name: Bono: Stories of Surrender
items.description: Through words, music, and mischief, Bono pulls back the curtain on his deeply personal experiences that have shaped him as a son, father, husband, activist, and U2 frontman.
