items.name: Tom Segura: Teacher
items.description: Parenting fails. Blackout bar stories. Career regrets. Tom Segura explores the darkly funny side of life's most unpredictable lessons.

items.name: Off Track 2
items.description: Siblings Lisa and Daniel gear up for the Vätternrundan cycling race, where unexpected detours, old flames and marriage problems test their resolve.

items.name: Jeff Ross: Take a Banana for the Ride
items.description: Making his Broadway debut, legendary comic Jeff Ross turns the spotlight on himself in a one-man show that is as heartfelt as it is hilarious.

items.name: An Honest Life
items.description: Simon's law school dreams fade as he meets Max during a protest. Her anarchist lifestyle of excess and deception entraps him before he can recognize the destructive path he is on.

items.name: Sly Lives! (aka the Burden of Black Genius)
items.description: It focuses on the life and legacy of Sly and the Family Stone, telling the story behind the rise, reign and fadeout of one of pop music's most influential artists.

items.name: They Fight
items.description: Reformed ex-convict Walt Manigan returns home to rebuild his family with the love of his life, Ketta. His path leads him to a boxing gym inside a D.C. youth recreation center about to be closed. There, he works under the wise coach Slim to mentor a group of boys to train for the junior national boxing tournament, all leading to a showdown between best friends Quincey and Peanut as they battle for a spot on the U.S. Junior Olympic Team.

items.name: Toaster
items.description: Murder and chaos erupt when a miser becomes obsessed with a toaster he gave as a wedding gift.

items.name: Pangolin: Kulu's Journey
items.description: Rescued from poachers, an endangered baby pangolin embarks on a journey back to the wild with help from a devoted human guardian in this documentary.

items.name: Yiya Murano: Death at Tea Time
items.description: Yiya Murano poisoned her friends to cover up scams in 1970s Argentina and became a dark figure in popular culture. Freed in the 1990s, she reappeared as a pop icon. Today, her son Martín seeks to reveal her true face.

items.name: Same Day with Someone
items.description: Trapped in a time loop, a picture-perfect museum curator relives her worst day ever and must figure out how to break free from the vicious cycle.

items.name: Tee Yai: Born to Be Bad
items.description: Two outlaws whose relationship is put to the test by a detective set on tracking down a infamous gang of robbers in 1980s Bangkok.

items.name: Untitled
items.description: The plot is currently under wraps.

items.name: Promised Hearts
items.description: A young woman's future is jeopardized by a secret arrangement that throws her life into chaos — but it may be the only way to save her family.

items.name: Clika
items.description: Aspiring small-town musician Chito is determined to make it big. When a clip of him performing one of his songs goes viral, he seizes the opportunity and pushes to carve out a place for himself in the new wave of Mexican-American music... and ultimately gets caught in a game more dangerous than anticipated.

items.name: Lost in the Spotlight
items.description: Just as he lands a prestigious role, a famous actor mysteriously loses his ability to act, sparking a journey of self-discovery amid public pressure.

items.name: Bert Kreischer: Lucky
items.description: Comedian Bert Kreischer's fourth Netflix special covers his weight loss journey, family stories, and advice from Snoop Dogg, while reflecting on his lucky life experiences.

items.name: Semi-Soeter
items.description: Power couple Jaci and JP find themselves in a bumpy predicament when a new work pitch for a baby brand forces them to play the perfect pretend parents.

items.name: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
items.description: When Snoopy's beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.

items.name: Chelsea Handler: The Feeling
items.description: From ruining Thanksgiving to a wild summer fling, Chelsea Handler recounts coming of age, unexpected encounters and that time she met Bill Cosby.

items.name: Stay
items.description: A couple near the end of their marriage begin to encounter supernatural forces that cause them to fight for their lives.

items.name: Cheer to Life
items.description: Jéssica is a simple young woman, dedicated to her job at an antique shop in Rio de Janeiro, but she feels her life lacks purpose. Everything changes when she finds a mysterious locket identical to an item she inherited from her late mother. Driven by the desire to understand the connection between the locket and her family history, Jéssica teams up with Gabriel, a distant relative who appears unexpectedly.

items.name: The Stringer: The Man Who Took the Photo
items.description: A two-year investigation uncovers a scandal behind the making of one of the most recognized photographs of the 20th century. Five decades of secrets are unraveled in the search for justice for a man known only as  "the stringer."

items.name: The Fakenapping
items.description: Failed entrepreneur and struggling dad Sattam finds himself tangled in a madcap scheme when he decides to repay his debts — by kidnapping his own father.

items.name: Bride of the Year
items.description: When Lienkie's dream of budding a family of her own come crashing down, she hatches a devious plan to win "Bride of the Year" and get back at her ex.

items.name: WHO
items.description: In a high-stakes world where time is scarce and every choice matters, diverse characters face a merciless system where one wrong move means death. Amid intense pressure, they confront moral quandaries and seek truth while testing limits.

items.name: This Is I
items.description: Bullied for wanting to be an idol, Kenji finds belonging in a cabaret and help from a trailblazing doctor, emerging onstage as her true self, Ai Haruna.

items.name: Room to Move
items.description: Choreographer and performer Jenn Freeman has always possessed the gift of movement. From a very early age, she simply had to dance… all the time. But with that ever-present need to jump, leap, shake and squirm came a struggle to exist harmoniously in a world that seemed to assault her senses and sense of equilibrium at every turn.

items.name: Aap Jaisa Koi
items.description: Lives of two unique individuals, Shrirenu Tripathi and Madhu Bose. Embark on a journey full of unexpected twists, heartfelt moments and plenty of fun.

items.name: The Most Beautiful Girl in the World
Trevor Noah: Joy in the Trenches
items.description: From unexpected social media beef to a therapist's truth bomb, Trevor Noah turns chaos into comedy in this hilariously sharp, playful stand-up set.

items.name: Vir Das: Fool Volume
items.description: Whether it's the police, the evil eye or a badly timed lost voice, comedian Vir Das explores how embracing foolishness has led him to shared happiness.

items.name: Sebastian Maniscalco: It Ain't Right
items.description: Sebastian Maniscalco's newest comedy special tackles modern life's absurdities, will be filmed during his record-setting "It Ain't Right" tour.

items.name: Last Take: Rust and the Story of Halyna
items.description: A personal look at the life, work and untimely death of celebrated indie cinematographer Halyna Hutchins, who was shot and killed in a tragic accident on the set of the film Rust in 2021.

items.name: Planet Single: Greek Adventure
items.description: A Greek getaway for five friends turns into a hilarious detective story when suspicions rise around one of their partners — who may be a famous con-man.

items.name: Jessica Kirson: I'm the Man
items.description: Jessica Kirson shares her searing perspective on everything from TikTok girls to her bizarre time at a trauma center.

items.name: Sheng Wang: Purple
items.description: Sheng Wang shares his thoughts on edible bras, braving the ghosts in your house and guarding expensive berries from your friends' kids.

items.name: Umami
items.description: Umami' tells the story of chef Sina Bora's extraordinary night, as he struggles with the pressures of running a successful and luxurious restaurant in Istanbul, while also having to cope with his personal life and the demands of h...

items.name: A Magnificent Life
items.description: In 1955, 60-year-old Marcel Pagnol is a well-known and acclaimed playwright and filmmaker. When the editor-in-chief of ELLE magazine commissions a weekly column about Pagnol's childhood, he sees this as a great opportunity to go back to his artistic roots: writing. Realizing his memory is failing him and deeply affected by the disappointing results of his last two plays, Pagnol starts doubting his ability to pursue his work. That is until Little Marcel - the young boy he used to be - appears to him as if by magic. Together, they will explore Marcel Pagnol's incredible life and bring back to life his most cherished encounters and memories...

items.name: Deaf President Now!
items.description: Discover the story of the greatest civil rights movement most people have never heard about. During eight tumultuous days in 1988 at the world's only Deaf university, four students must find a way to lead a revolution—and change the course of history.

items.name: Elmo and Mark Rober's Merry Giftmas
items.description: Elmo and his Sesame Street friends work with former NASA engineer turned YouTube star Mark Rober to make special presents for a Merry Giftmas exchange.

items.name: It Takes a Village
items.description: When financial trouble forces Halina to call off her wedding, her friends and family decide to hatch a wild plan to bring in tourist money.

items.name: A Bright Lawyer
items.description: In the film, actor Leandro Hassum plays lawyer Michelle Barbieri, known as Mike. The company where he works is bought by an office that decides to keep only women in its positions. However, the character is not fired, since, due to her name, the HR department believes that she is a woman. The character then starts dressing in women's clothing to stay in his job.

items.name: Jaras Enzar 2
items.description: This is the sequel of the 2024 film From the Ashes. Inspired by true events, it tells the story of girls high school students who experience a devastating tragedy while at school.

items.name: Abandoned Man
items.description: After years behind bars, a tormented man tries to rebuild his life, but an unexpected bond unveils a shocking truth that could change his life forever.

items.name: Earthquake: Joke Telling Business
items.description: From unpacking celebrity scandals to hot takes on love, legendary comic Earthquake shakes things up in this explosive stand-up set.

items.name: Sosyal Climbers
items.description: Stuck with a massive debt after falling for a scam, two wannabe socialites create elaborate fake identities to swindle the rich out of their money.

items.name: Zarna Garg: Practical People Win
items.description: Zarna Garg is bringing the heat (and the guilt trips) in her laugh-out-loud Hulu debut, taking aim at husbands, kids, in-laws, and anyone who dares question an Indian mom's wisdom.

items.name: (MAD)²
items.description: After his wedding turns into a disaster, Laddu and his pals — Manoj, Ashok and Damodar — find themselves traveling to Goa for another wild adventure.

items.name: Pita Hall
items.description: Kalender runs a small restaurant, inherited from his father. Ten years ago, after the death of his wife, he became increasingly withdrawn. He's averse to innovation and averse to taking risks, and his shop is struggling. The recent opening of a new-generation restaurant, Pidburger, only makes things worse. However, with the arrival of Öcü, a transformation begins, and they embark on numerous adventures to save the shop.

items.name: Lisa Ann Walter: It Was an Accident
items.description: Lisa Ann Walter's long-awaited debut comedy special takes on feral Gen-Xers, self-loathing, and navigating a backsliding America, via the no-filter lens of a grown-ass woman who has been paying attention.

items.name: Groom & Two Brides
items.description: Adam hilariously juggles marrying his boss's daughter and rekindling with an old flame, leading to chaotic realizations about love

items.name: Frozen: The Hit Broadway Musical
items.description: Queen Elsa's hidden powers plunge Arendelle into an eternal winter and her sister Anna sets out to find her and save the kingdom. As the storm rages on, both sisters must learn that only an act of true love can thaw a frozen heart.

items.name: Meet the Khumalos
items.description: Two moms — once best friends, now arch-enemies — start a neighborhood war against each other when they find out their kids are head-over-heels in love.

items.name: Poldi
items.description: Footballer, entrepreneur, fan favorite and true community hero — Lukas Podolski reflects on his journey and what comes next in this intimate documentary.

items.name: Air Force Elite: Thunderbirds
items.description: The inside look at the U.S. Air Force's Thunderbirds flight squadron.

items.name: Gabriel Iglesias: Legend of Fluffy
items.description: From breaking stereotypes to home break-ins, Gabriel Iglesias brings comedy to life's unexpected twists in this stand-up special.

items.name: In Waves and War
items.description: Three Navy SEALs leave their tours of duty in Iraq and Afghanistan with treatment-resistant, unrelenting psychological pain. They find themselves at the cutting edge of a different frontline: a lifesaving psychedelic therapy that brings healing to a community in urgent need.

items.name: 18th Rose
items.description: A spirited teen dreaming of the perfect debut makes a deal with a lonely newcomer, but unexpected feelings and revelations may shatter their plans.

items.name: Darius Rucker: They Called Me Hootie
items.description: Darius Rucker gets deeply personal about the cost of stardom, revealing his struggles with drugs and alcohol, the breakdown of his marriage and brushes with death. Through candid interviews with collaborators, friends and family, new footage from the road and in the studio as he records his forthcoming album and never-before-seen tape dating back to the start of Hootie & the Blowfish, this documentary traces the full journey of his extraordinary career, revealing a deeply personal story of ambition, resilience and reinvention.

items.name: Jackhammer
items.description: A shy struggling actor is dragged into the world of professional male stripping by his egotistical brother.

items.name: The First Snow of Fraggle Rock
items.description: Follows the Fraggles as they eagerly await the first snow of the season. When only a single snowflake arrives and Gobo can't write the yearly holiday song everyone is expecting, the season is thrown off course.

items.name: Ralph Barbosa: Planet Bosa
items.description: Ralph Barbosa shares his adventures in dating, controlling his temper, working on cars, and his views on current events.

items.name: 9/11: United We Stand -- 25 Years Later
items.description: Explore how sports, music, Broadway and comedy helped Americans rediscover joy and begin to heal in the wake of the 9/11 attacks.

items.name: Who Killed the Montreal Expos?
items.description: An investigation into the downfall of the Montreal Expos, Canada's first Major League Baseball team — and who was ultimately responsible.

items.name: The Dad Quest
items.description: When a father-son duo learns that they might not be related biologically, they embark on a wild adventure through Mexico to find the truth.

items.name: Snoopy Presents: A Summer Musical
items.description: Music and glee fill the air as Charlie Brown and the gang head off to summer camp. First-timer Sally doesn't get what all the hype is about. But when the camp may be forced to close, they team up to save it so more kids can make their own special memories.

items.name: Son-in-Law
items.description: José Sánchez has big ambitions, terrible instincts, and a mustache to match. After a string of bad deals, he accidentally bluffs his way into becoming El Serpiente, a political boss feared for all the wrong reasons. Now he must pull off one final deal to stay alive — a deal far beyond anything he can fake.

items.name: Katt Williams: The Last Report
items.description: Katt Williams delivers his famously bold takes on conspiracies, celebrities, and the world at large in this electrifying stand up special.

items.name: Dhoom Dhaam
items.description: Veer Poddar and Koyal Chadda are a mismatched couple, who get into an arranged marriage. A case of mistaken identity forces this newly married couple to go on the run on their wedding night and search for the mysterious "Charlie".

items.name: A Normal Woman
items.description: Believing she's contracted a mysterious illness, a socialite begins sabotaging her own life in the face of rejection from her own body and her family.

items.name: Banger
items.description: When an intelligence agent offers a washed-up DJ the opportunity to take down his young rival, he sees it as a chance to return to the top with a banger.

items.name: Sea Lions of the Galapagos
items.description: Follow Leo, a handsome sea lion pup who's learning how to navigate life alongside his mother, Luna.

items.name: Guardians of the Galapagos
items.description: Go behind the scenes with the crew of Sea Lions of the Galapagos to showcase not just the production of a film, but the world that inspired it.

items.name: Roy Wood Jr.: Lonely Flowers
items.description: In this stand-up special, Roy Wood Jr explores how lack of connection has sent society spiraling into a culture full of guns, rude employees, self-checkout lanes, and why some of us would rather be alone rather than be connected.

items.name: Sarah Silverman: PostMortem
items.description: After losing both parents, Sarah Silverman turns grief into comedy, finding humor in funeral planning and final moments with her mother while maintaining her characteristic wit.

items.name: Gold Rush Gang
items.description: At the tail end of World War II, a bandit leader and his crew go up against his sworn enemy and the Japanese army to rob a train full of gold.

items.name: Jewel Thief: The Heist Begins
items.description: A master thief accepts a mission to steal the legendary African Red Sun diamond. What begins as a meticulously planned heist spirals into a dangerous game of double-crosses and shifting loyalties.

items.name: Corazón delator
items.description: מנואל עובר השתלת לב ומרגיש שמשהו באישיות שלו השתנה. כשהוא מתחיל להתעניין בחייו של התורם, הוא פוגש את ואלה האלמנה ואת הקהילה שמקיפה אותה.

items.name: The Wrong Track
items.description: A struggling divorced mom must learn to ski and complete a grueling 54km race to stay at her brother's place. As she trains for the impossible challenge, she discovers inner strength she never knew she had.

items.name: Lucca's World
items.description: Determined to help her son, who has cerebral palsy, Bárbara takes her family to India for an experimental treatment.

items.name: Almost Family
items.description: A Brazilian father finds a worthy opponent when he meets his daughter's Argentine in-laws, and a trip to Bariloche becomes the stage for a fun international rivalry.

items.name: Dr. Seuss's the Sneetches
items.description: An unexpected friendship forms between two young Sneetches on an island.

items.name: Mike Epps: Delusional
items.description: Follows comedian Mike Epps as he discusses how a little delusion and a lot of hustle made him a star.

items.name: Sarah Millican: Late Bloomer
items.description: When Sarah Millican was a bairn, she wouldn't say boo to a goose. Quiet at school, not many friends, no boobs 'til she was 16. Now? NOW she is loud, with good friends, a cracking rack and goose booing all over the shop. In Sarah's seventh stand-up special, she explores how one became the other. Plus, lots of stuff about dinners and lady gardens.

items.name: The Lion King at the Hollywood Bowl
items.description: Join original film and Broadway stars at the Hollywood Bowl for The Lion King's 30th Anniversary concert. Lebo M, Jeremy Irons, Nathan Lane and more reunite with special guests North West and Jennifer Hudson.

items.name: Larissa: The Other Side of Anitta
items.description: Behind global star Anitta is Larissa, known only to her inner circle. Through an old flame's perspective, we see her true self emerge as she navigates personal challenges that reshape her life's direction.

items.name: Lulu Is a Rhinoceros
items.description: On a quest to spread kindness, fun-loving Lulu embarks on the adventure of a lifetime, powered by new friends, courage, and catchy songs!

items.name: Umjolo: There Is No Cure
