items.description: Documentary-style series about the era of the dinosaurs, mixing real locations and CGI.

items.name: American Gothic
items.description: A quiet, seemingly-quaint small town is ruled over by its charming yet evil sheriff who uses his demonic powers to remove anyone who dares to stand in his way. The only one he fears is a young boy he fathered through rape.

items.name: Dream On
items.description: Martin Tupper's a recently divorced book editor in Manhattan. Martin's life is filled with fantasies and sexual thoughts, many times coming in the form of black-and-white shots from old TV shows and films.

items.name: The Maxx
items.description: Confused hulking homeless superhero The Maxx tries to protect his social worker and friend Julie from the omniscient serial killer Mr. Gone both in the real world, which may or may not actually be real, and the subconscious fantas...

items.name: The Flash
items.description: A police forensic scientist, Barry Allen, battles crimes as the super-fast superhero "The Flash."

items.name: Thunderbirds
items.description: In 2065, the Tracy family secretly run International Rescue, whose mission is to save people trapped in extraordinarily dangerous situations using their advanced Thunderbird machines.
Three intertwined timelines follow the planning and execution of a daring heist in Zurich and its aftermath as an FBI agent pursues a master criminal across Europe.

items.name: All's Fair
items.description: Follows a successful divorce lawyer and the owner of an all-female law firm in Los Angeles.

items.name: The Altruists
items.description: Follows the tumultuous romance between FTX co-founder Sam Bankman-Fried and his girlfriend Caroline Ellison. It depicts their ambitious attempts to revolutionize the financial system, leading to a $36 billion fraud.

items.name: Prawo bestii
items.description: Inspired by true events that shocked the nation and ultimately led to the creation of Poland's controversial Beast Law

items.name: Money Trap
items.description: When a mythical map falls into the hands of a legendary scam artist, he decides to pull one last con before leaving it all behind for good.

items.name: Gordon
items.description: Aníbal Gordon rises from a small-time thief to a convicted murderer in Argentina during the '70s.

items.name: Outside
items.description: Internet icons the Sidemen drop content creators into the great outdoors to battle through challenges, temptations and scheming for a share of £1 million.

items.name: Balaraw: Blood Island
items.description: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.

items.name: Minerva Academy
items.description: At Minerva Military High School, teens navigate discipline, rivalry and family pressure as a young cadet searches for answers about his missing friend.

items.name: The Mob
items.description: Celebrities compete in mob-themed challenges at an Italian villa for $250,000. They elect a don who controls eliminations and prize money. As power demands loyalty, contestants must decide whether to support the don or overthrow them.

items.name: Valentina and the 12 Signs
items.description: Valentina is a young woman who, after being betrayed by her boyfriend—and blaming astrology for the end of their relationship—decides to take revenge in an unusual way: she sets out on a mission to hook up with a guy from every sign of the zodiac. Her plan is to document all these encounters and experiences in a videocast, but things get complicated when she falls for a guy who has "no sign."

items.name: City of Blood
items.description: Berlin — a city-state on the brink. While a privileged few live beneath a climate-controlled dome, those outside struggle to survive in a world ravaged by heat, corruption, and crime. After years apart, sisters Bea and Phoebe are reunited and uncover a dark secret: Vampires are determined to seize political power — and blood has become the city's new currency.

items.name: Physical Italia: da 100 a 1
items.description: מאה ספורטאים איטלקים עומדים בפני אתגרים פיזיים מפרכים, וכל אחד מהם נאבק כדי לגבור על השאר ולזכות בתהילה ובתואר האלוף האמיתי היחיד.

items.name: The Gift of Deceit
items.description: Desperate to find a cure for the unknown illness affecting her daughter, art collector Lúcia Rossetti turns to a spiritual healer. When Lúcia falls victim to a scam, a series of secrets is revealed, intertwining two families marked by love, control, resentment, and guilt.

items.name: Get Huge: Looksmaxxing to Death
items.description: An unflinching portrait of masculinity in the influencer age, where extreme biohacking, online performance and a series of suspicious deaths converge.

items.name: Stolen Heartbeats
items.description: After an attack leaves a woman named Anabel comatose, she and Rafael—a nurse who has the unique ability to hear the dead—must work together to keep her alive while hiding from her enemies.

items.name: Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook
items.description: Hollywood actor and comedian Nora Lum (a.k.a. Awkwafina) is the descendant of restaurant royalty...but she can't cook. Join the star on an inspiring culinary road trip as she learns the craft and attempts to revive her family's beloved Chinese eatery.

items.name: The Apartment Job
items.description: Depicts the story of former gangster Hae Gang, who runs for apartment residents' association president to get his hands on the building's hidden money, only to unintentionally uncover corruption within the complex.

items.name: All the Truth in My Lies
items.description: Coco and Marín travel in campers to celebrate Blanca's bachelorette party. What was supposed to be an adventure turns into a time bomb when a few secrets between them come to light.

items.name: Merry Berry Love
items.description: When star Korean spatial designer Lee Yubin loses everything, he heads off to a Japanese island. There, he meets Karin, a resilient strawberry farmer. Hailing from different worlds, their lives collide in a big misunderstanding. Buckle up for "Merry Berry Love," a sweet and sour Korea-Japan rom-com.

items.name: Alicia's Law
items.description: When her carefully built life comes undone, Alicia returns to practicing law and discovers that rebuilding her career also means redefining herself.

items.name: Akka
items.description: In a kingdom ruled by women, matriarch Bhavani faces her biggest threat in Rudra, a ruthless rebel eyeing her land and legacy.

items.name: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
items.description: קבוצה של אימהות צעירות ודינמיות מאורנג' קאונטי מעוררת סערה בקהילה שבה האמונה היא הזהות עצמה. חלקן נלחמות לשמר את המסורת, אחרות מאמצות את המודרנה ויוצאות לזעזע את המוסכמות. סודות ייחשפו, חזותות יתנפצו וחברויות יועמדו למבחן כשקבוצת המשפיעניות פורצות הדרך הזאת מתאחדת כדי ליצור את התשובה שלהן ל-#MomTok.

items.name: The New Stanford Prison Experiment
items.description: Thirty volunteers enter a real prison facility and are randomly assigned roles as guards or prisoners to test whether ordinary people conform to assigned power dynamics or maintain their empathy and individuality.

items.name: Vienna Game
items.description: While Napoleon Bonaparte is exiled on Elba, kings and crown princes, ministers and spies, noblewomen and mistresses, adventurers, inventors, artists, and concubines gather in Vienna to celebrate and negotiate. Here, the fate of Europe is decided on the dance floor and in the boudoir.

items.name: Musafir Cafe
items.description: Chander feels an undeniable connection with Sudha. Years later, he builds a new life in the hills with Preeti, but memories of the past linger.

items.name: Strip Law
items.description: Uptight lawyer Lincoln Gumb, who is too boring to win cases in Vegas, teams up with local magician/hedonist Sheila Flambé to bring some flash and pizzazz to the stupidest cases the city can throw at them.

items.name: Shaque: Trust No One
items.description: A mother receives yearly photos of her missing child. After nine years of searching, she discovers the truth about the abduction lies not far away, but hidden among her closest circle.

items.name: The Town
items.description: Two estranged brothers and a friend find a stolen fortune, sparking a risky game where loyalty and survival clash as they chase life - changing dreams.

items.name: Medusa
items.description: Somebody wants to kill CEO Bárbara Hidalgo. Can she find the culprit as her family schemes ruthlessly for control of their Colombian business empire?

items.name: Road
items.description: Two detectives pursue a killer leaving mutilated bodies and cryptic messages across Japan and Korea. Korean text appears with Tokyo victims, Japanese with Korean victims, leading to an international manhunt.

items.name: I'm Not Afraid
items.description: 10-year-old Miguel stumbles upon a terrifying secret involving a boy trapped in a hole near his home.

items.name: 9/11: Reunited
items.description: The story of September 11 through the eyes of survivors who experienced life-or-death moments with strangers that day and now want to meet again.

items.name: Inside the Circle
items.description: Four lifelong friends are caught in a web of blackmail when a leaked video threatens to expose the secrets that could destroy their friendship.

items.name: Crap Happens
items.description: Rapper Toni returns to his hometown for his mother's funeral and suddenly finds himself juggling career dreams and surprise fatherhood to a teenage son.

items.name: The Evil Lawyer
items.description: When a young attorney is accused of murdering a police officer's son, he teams up with the "Evil Lawyer" to exploit loopholes and prove his innocence.

items.name: Real Men
items.description: Four old friends, Massimo, Mattia, Luigi and Riccardo, juggle relationships, careers and dating in a modern world set on giving masculinity a hard time.

items.name: Dudes
items.description: In the midst of a masculinity crisis, four friends in their forties are losing their throne, privileges and identity; years ago, they would have been alpha males in charge of their lives, but they have had to live in the era of equality.

items.name: Miracles of the ER
items.description: A bold decision brings an average med student to an elite ER team, where he encounters medical crises, ethical dilemmas, and personal growth.

items.name: Public Disorder
items.description: An incident sparks internal conflict as members of a riot squad juggle personal worries with the daily tension of police work on the streets.

items.name: The Resurrected
items.description: Follows the journey of two desperate mothers as they resurrect a deceased ringleader of a telecommunication fraud scheme to avenge their kidnapped daughters.

items.name: Somebody Knows Something
items.description: Follow true crime influencer Kara Chamberlain as she investigates unsolved murders and missing persons cases that have stumped law enforcement and haunted internet sleuths for decades.

items.name: Delusion
items.description: When her father's worsening dementia makes him a prime suspect in a murder case, a small-town school teacher races to uncover the truth amid dark rumors.

items.name: The Dream Life of Mr. Kim
items.description: Kim Nak-su is a middle-aged man who loses everything he once considered valuable in an instant. After a long journey, he finally discovers his true self, beyond his role as a department manager at a large corporation.

items.name: Motorvalley
items.description: Desperate to gain control of her family's racing empire, an heiress hires a reckless driver and a troubled coach to compete in the Italian Gran Turismo.

items.name: Lucky Luke
items.description: Lucky Luke must help Louise find her mother, who mysteriously disappeared, while foiling a plot that could change the course of American history.

items.name: Rotten Legacy
items.description: Federico Seligman retires to recover from illness, but upon return finds his sons have changed the business direction he despises. He'll do the unimaginable to prevent them from destroying his legacy.

items.name: Moria
items.description: Moria Casán transforms her life story into a symbolic spectacle of fame, controversy and ceaseless reinvention.

items.name: Umthetho
items.description: To keep their youngest brother alive, a state prosecutor becomes a double agent in her imprisoned older brother's gang.

items.name: Call Her Alex
items.description: "Call Her Daddy" creator, host and executive producer Alex Cooper is at the top of her game, signing one of the biggest deals in podcast history. This revealing two-part series gives audiences a behind-the-scenes, intimate look at her journey and the defining moments that shaped her influential voice.

items.name: A Friend, a Murderer
items.description: A Danish town feared a serial criminal for eight years. When caught, Amanda, Nichlas and Kiri discovered the perpetrator was their close friend who'd committed assaults, kidnappings and murder while spending time with them.

items.name: Dynasty: The Murdochs
items.description: Offers an unprecedented look at one the world’s most powerful families at a crossroads, as its patriarch, Rupert Murdoch, makes one last play to ensure his legacy at all costs.

items.name: Gold Land
items.description: A young woman working as an airport security agent accidentally comes into possession of a smuggling ring’s gold bars. Caught in a chaotic whirlwind of greed and betrayal among various parties vying for the gold, she becomes consumed by the desire to claim it all for herself.

items.name: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel
items.description: How far would you go for your family? The brutal murder of a prominent law professor in Tallahassee, Florida reveals the dark secrets of a wealthy family. A series of larger-than-life suspects leads to a mind-bending story of a murder-for-hire-plot, a messy custody battle, ex-lovers – and family dentistry. With exclusive access to those at the center of this extraordinary story, many of whom have never spoken before, this is the definitive telling of a case which took 11 years to solve.

items.name: Africa Earth's Wild Home
items.description: African wildlife and landscapes is brought to the screen like never before, using the latest technology to tell the most extraordinary stories from the continent and cutting-edge CGI to unearth the deep history and forces that shaped Africa's natural worlds.

items.name: Suspicious Minds
items.description: The professional thief Amber joins a wedding in Isla Esperanza with a target to steal the 24 million euro Tiara of Santa Agueda. It gets a bit more complicated when her previous partner in crime appears with the same agenda

items.name: Tucci in Italy
items.description: Follow Stanley Tucci as he returns to Italy for more food-based adventures, seeking out the essence of each region and its people through the food they eat.

items.name: Funny AF with Kevin Hart
items.description: Kevin Hart travels the country with the help of comedy legends to find the next stand-up superstar — with the winner crowned live by your real-time vote.

items.name: Glory
items.description: In a small-town boxing hub, two brothers investigate a shocking murder while navigating a troubled reunion with their father, a renowned coach.

items.name: The Lost Station Girls
items.description: A police officer's relentless two-decade hunt for a serial killer who murdered four young women in southern France.

items.name: Superstar
items.description: Set deep in the chaos of the early 2000s, this series reimagines the life of pop icon Tamara — and her metamorphosis into Yurena — as never seen before.

items.name: The Fixers
items.description: A washed-up gangster reluctantly teams up with an arrogant political heir to become "fixers", cleaning up dangerous secrets for both sides of the law.

items.name: Pro Bono
items.description: When a respected judge's world falls apart overnight, he joins a top law firm's pro bono team — where hope and purpose wait in humble, unexpected places.

items.name: No One Saw Us Leave
items.description: Follows a mother desperately pursuing her husband who kidnapped their children, highlighting the clash between two powerful Jewish families in the 1960s.

items.name: Win the Mall
items.description: Ten teams move into a mall where they must conquer storefronts, forge alliances and outsmart rivals to win $1 million in this reality competition series.

items.name: Final Project
items.description: New school, new start — until vicious online attacks and a classmate's twisted challenge spark a dangerous bond that pushes Tamara toward transformation.

items.name: Million-Follower Detective
items.description: In this crime thriller, Detective Chen Chia-jen races to unmask Baba the Witch, the viral tarot reader who accurately predicts the deaths of influencers.

items.name: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
items.description: Historians Dan Snow and Professor Suzannah Lipscomb investigate the lives and deaths of some of Tudor England's most fascinating figures, including Anne Boleyn, Mary, Queen of Scots, and Perkin Warbeck, who claimed to be one of the famed Princes in the Tower.

items.name: Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro
items.description: Follows 12 up-and-coming dancers who move into one house and compete in a grueling audition process for a coveted pro dancer slot on Dancing with the Stars Season 35.

items.name: Take That
items.description: The story of one of the greatest boy bands in UK history. For more than 30 years, they have brought us hit after hit, 12 of which became UK number ones.

items.name: Did Someone Happen to Mention Me?
items.description: Once Japan's most renowned actor, Gen is suddenly forgotten. Fueled by a need for recognition, he claws his way back from zero in this comedy.

items.name: Disney Twisted-Wonderland: The Animation
items.description: Lost in a dark fairy tale realm, Yu enrolls at a magical academy where ghosts roam freely and students battle for supremacy in an upcoming supernatural competition.

items.name: Twisted Yoga
items.description: Ex-members of a tantric yoga school speak out about how they went from searching for wellness and community to fearing they'd joined a cult, and seeking justice for alleged abuse and manipulation at the hands of a self-styled guru.

items.name: The Scream Murder: A True Teen Horror Story
items.description: When high school student Cassie Stoddart is found stabbed to death in a house on the outskirts of Pocatello, Idaho, the community is gripped by fear that a random killer is on the loose. Police retrace Cassie's final hours and focus on three classmates that were the last people to see her alive. As the investigation narrows, detectives uncover a shocking buried video tape that reframes the case, raising the unthinkable question of whether 16-year-olds could have committed such a brutal crime.

items.name: My Daughter's Father
items.description: Follows Julieta who, during her graduation party suffers a life-threatening health crisis that forces her mother, Maca, to face secrets from the past.

items.name: Entrepreneurs
items.description: קבוצה של יזמים יוצאת בכל יום לחלל עבודה משותף בחיפוש אחר הצלחה.

items.name: Wrath
items.description: A wounded amnesiac finds refuge with an MMA coach and steps into the ring, torn between hope for a new future and a dangerous past that keeps closing in.

items.name: Carizzma
items.description: Caro Pardíaco, a sparkling influencer and full-time diva, has it all – but at thirty, in the midst of a midlife crisis, she falls into the trap of romantic love.

items.name: Being Gordon Ramsay
items.description: Follows Gordon Ramsay's journey to launch dining concepts at 22 Bishopsgate, London's second tallest building..

items.name: The TikTok Killer
items.description: When Esther vanishes without a trace, her family is able to piece together her last movements thanks to José Jurado Montilla, a traveler who journeys across Spain sharing heartfelt videos of his trips on his TikTok account. But “Dynamite” Montilla – the last person to have been with Esther – hides a dark past

items.name: The Winning Try
items.description: A disgraced former rugby star returns as a coach to his high school’s struggling team, where he reunites with his ex-girlfriend and helps the determined captain lead the team to redemption.

items.name: Agent from Above
items.description: Bound by a deity's pact, Han Chieh fights demons on Earth. When he uncovers an old enemy's plan for a second invasion, he must fight to save humanity.

items.name: Viral Hit
items.description: Bullied high school student Kota discovers fighting can be profitable when his classmate brawl is accidentally streamed and goes viral. He starts his own streaming channel and begins transforming his life.

items.name: James.
items.description: James Rodríguez, Colombia's legendary No. 10, shares details of his journey to football's elite and the game's biggest stage.

items.name: Hound's Hill
items.description: Famous writer Mikolaj returns to hometown facing blackmail over a book about a past murder. His activist father opposes local corruption. Mikolaj's journalist wife investigates, uncovering dark secrets tied to the town's tragic hi...

items.name: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
items.description: Following a mining accident in northern Chile, 33 miners are trapped deep underground. As the search for them begins, the men are fighting for their lives under extreme conditions.

items.name: Abandoned
items.description: In 1984, three children were abandoned at a Barcelona train station with no memory of their identity or past. Unclaimed, they were adopted into loving homes. As adults, they now search for their biological parents.

items.name: Norway: The Dark Horse
items.description: After 26 years of tournament drought, Norway's 2026 World Cup hopes were next to nil. But what followed rekindled belief.

items.name: Unicorn Academy: Secrets Revealed
items.description: A new mystery unfolds at Unicorn Academy as long-buried secrets begin to surface, threatening the very balance of Unicorn Island. As Sophia and her friends return for another year, they are drawn into a dangerous quest filled with hidden powers, unexpected betrayals, and dark forces growing stronger in the shadows. With every step, the stakes rise, pushing the riders to their limits. Packed with magic, suspense, and emotional twists, this chapter promises a thrilling adventure where not everything is as it seems, and every secret could change their destiny forever.

items.name: The Hooligan
items.description: When his father is released from prison, 17-year-old Kuba finds it difficult not to follow in his hooligan footsteps. After all, football is family.

items.name: Million Dollar Nannies
items.description: A young group of elite nannies heads to Ibiza to launch a new kind of agency, built by nannies, for nannies. They're promised VIP families, life-changing money, and a shot at something bigger than any of them could build alone. But fierce competition, personal drama, and a scandal from the past threaten to derail the dream before the summer sets.

items.name: David Blaine: Do Not Attempt
items.description: Magician David Blaine travels globally, connecting with masters and performers who share unique skills and secrets. His journey spans Brazil, Southeast Asia, India, the Arctic, South Africa and Japan.

items.name: Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time
items.description: Offers the most intimate and profound exploration into the wide-ranging impacts of the Hurricane Katrina disaster to date. Weaving together critical moments of the crisis and the past events that precipitated it, the series delivers an unparalleled, emotionally raw examination of the storm’s personal, political and societal fallout.

items.name: Badly in Love
items.description: In Japan's first dating show for rebellious yankiis, 11 singles butt heads, forge bonds and live together for 14 days as they go all out to find the one.

items.name: Death in Apartment 603: What Happened to Ellen Greenberg?
items.description: Explores the death of Ellen Greenberg, initially ruled a suicide, her family insists she was murdered.

items.name: Stars and Vows: Anele & Buzza
items.description: Follow media darling Anele Mdoda and her royal fiance Buzza James from pre-wedding celebrations and tense family moments to their long-awaited "I do."

items.name: The Fox Hollow Murders: Playground of a Serial Killer
items.description: Hamilton County coroner Jeff Jellison launches a new investigation into Herb Baumeister decades after thousands of bones were found in the woods behind Fox Hollow Farms, Baumeister's stately home. Using new DNA technology, Jellison and his team work to identify the human remains, bringing long-deferred closure to victims' families and unearthing unsettling questions about potential accomplices, missing evidence, and a key witness whose story keeps changing.

items.name: Government Cheese
items.description: Hampton Chambers a newly released ex-convict striving to leave his criminal history behind and reunite with his family. Amidst this struggle, he grapples with frequent inexplicable moments of divine intervention.

items.name: Bandi
items.description: Following the death of their mother, their pillar of strength and their anchor, eleven siblings aged 7 to 23 try to stay united in the face of adversity. But for some of them, drug trafficking seems to be the only way to survive. A decision far from being unanimously accepted, and one that severely tests the strength of their family bonds.

items.name: Fate
items.description: Taxi driver David becomes the chauffeur for a famous bullfighter known as El Maestro, who is attempting a comeback after years away from the ring. El Maestro's perspective changes, and he starts seeing David as a good luck charm.

items.name: Delirium
items.description: When his wife Agustina falls into delirium, a professor delves into her dark past to piece together her story and uncover the cause of her madness.

items.name: Necaxa
items.description: Beloved Mexican soccer team Club Necaxa strives to reclaim their place as one of Mexico's top teams, while their Mexican-American owner Eva Longoria tries to breathe new life into the team by enlisting the help of her high-profile friends including new co-owners Rob Mac and Ryan Reynolds.

items.name: Betrayal: Secrets & Lies
items.description: Explores lives undone by unthinkable betrayals and the courage it takes to survive scandalous confessions, secret lives, terrifying acts of violence, financial ruin and more, showing that when loyalty turns to lies, the truth does more than break hearts - it changes everything.

items.name: My Family
items.description: A terminally ill father prepares his chaotic family to care for his two young kids and face life without him — but they must put old quarrels to rest.

items.name: Just Alice
items.description: Torn between two loves, Alicia secretly marries both a famous writer and a former priest. How long can she juggle love, lies and her double life?

items.name: The Girls: A Khloé Kardashian Project
items.description: They're building empires. They're building families. They're always unfiltered. Welcome to The Girls, where Khloé Kardashian's inner circle of real-life besties are raising babies, running businesses, and surviving brutally honest group chats. From surprise proposals to solo parenting, glam getaways to growing pains, this is the new era of reality TV where the chaos is couture — and the bonds are unbreakable.

items.name: Call My Agent Berlin
items.description: Welcome to Stern Talent Agency, where stars, drama, and intrigue are part of daily life. After the founder’s death, the agency faces collapse. Only by discovering new talent, keeping old stars, and securing smart deals can it survive. Behind the scenes, the agents fight with passion — for their clients and for their own future.

items.name: A Tragedy Foretold: Flight 3054
items.description: The untold stories and human tragedy behind Latin America's deadliest air disaster are investigated in this three-part documentary series.

items.name: Members Only: Palm Beach
items.description: Within the exclusive enclaves of Palm Beach County, follow a group of women navigating the unspoken rules, inherited traditions and high-stakes hierarchies of America's most rarefied social circles. In this manicured world of privilege and private clubs, reputations are built over brunch, alliances shift over champagne, and while wealth is ubiquitous, power, influence and access are the true currency.

items.name: Diddy on Trial: As It Happened
items.description: The trial of Sean "Diddy" Combs has begun, and prosecutors allege he engaged in an extensive list of criminal activities, including federal racketeering, sex trafficking and more. Combs denies all accusations, maintaining his innocence. In this new weekly series, viewers can witness it all unfold in real time.

items.name: Santita
items.description: Left in a wheelchair after a crash, Santita leaves the love of her life at the altar. Twenty years later, he returns with a request that changes everything.

items.name: Between Father and Son
items.description: In just a few suspenseful minutes, a lawyer's world tilts as her visit to her fiancé's family estate ignites an irresistible bond with her future stepson.

items.name: Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai
items.description: Baki and the strongest Underground Arena fighters face a threat of historical proportions: the resurrected Musashi Miyamoto, Japan's greatest samurai.

items.name: Gold & Greed: The Hunt for Fenn's Treasure
items.description: An eccentric man named Forrest Fenn sets off a real-life treasure hunt when he hides a chest of gold in the Rockies — and leaves clues in a cryptic poem.

items.name: Fire and Water: Making the Avatar Films
items.description: This two-part documentary provides a fascinating glimpse into the making of the Oscar-winning box office phenomenon "Avatar: The Way of Water" and features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, concept art, and interviews with cast and filmmakers.

items.name: Istanbul Encyclopedia
items.description: A young student moves in with an estranged family friend in Istanbul, trading her humble hometown for a city that tests her identity — and convictions.

items.name: The Real Rooneys
items.description: A candid glimpse into the Rooneys' world as soccer legend Wayne juggles dad duties and former England captain's wife Coleen balances motherhood with business ambitions.

items.name: Sneaker Wars: Adidas V. Puma
items.description: Through unprecedented access to both companies, uncover the tale of two feuding brothers, Adi and Rudi Dassler, whose multi-decade rivalry and competition helped shape the modern sportswear industry.

items.name: Berlin ER
items.description: After her private life falls apart, a young doctor seeking a fresh start takes over the emergency room in Berlin's toughest, most chaotic hospital. Battling staff resistance and a run-down system, she must unite her maverick team to save lives.

items.name: Esa Noche
items.description: Three sisters face a moral crisis when the youngest hits a man with her car in the Dominican Republic. They must decide how far they'll go to keep her out of jail and prevent her child from losing a mother.

items.name: The Best Heart Attack of My Life
items.description: A ghostwriter's life-threatening heart attack in a foreign country forces him to rely on strangers for help. This unexpected crisis becomes a transformative experience, reshaping his perspective and impacting those around him.

items.name: Asura
items.description: Four sisters face turbulence when their father's affair is exposed. Embodying the tumultuous "asura" demigods, they clash over differing outlooks on love yet find moments of connection amid conflict and growth.

items.name: Girl from Nowhere: The Reset
items.description: "If everything stayed the same, it wouldn't be called karma, right?" When the world as it is still seems to need Nanno to shake things up.

items.name: Hostage
items.description: When the PM's husband is kidnapped and the visiting French President is blackmailed, the two political leaders face unimaginable choices. Forced into a fierce rivalry can they work together to uncover the plot that threatens them ...

items.name: The Guest
items.description: A seemingly perfect household unravels when an unexpected visitor arrives, exposing hidden tensions and political aspirations that threaten to tear the family apart.

items.name: All the Sharks
items.description: Four teams of shark experts and enthusiasts travel the globe trying to find the most elusive shark species in this fin-tastic reality competition.

items.name: Forget You Not
items.description: An aspiring stand-up comedian turns her struggles into heartfelt humor as she balances work and relationships while caring for her aging father.

items.name: Simon Cowell: The Next Act
items.description: Simon Cowell is looking for the next hit boy band. And he's risking it all to find them. Will these young singers prove he's still got the Midas touch?

items.name: Son of a Donkey
items.description: Theo comes up with chaotic schemes to save his impounded car. Meanwhile, his dying dad will stop at nothing to find himself a new kidney.

items.name: My Brother the Minotaur
items.description: When a minotaur raised by humans starts dreaming of his mythical past, he sets out on a wild adventure—with help from his brother and friends—to understand who he really is.

items.name: Black Warrant
items.description: A newly appointed jailer at Tihar Prison confronts widespread corruption and injustice within its walls, forcing him to choose between maintaining the status quo or fighting for reform.

items.name: Unconditional
items.description: A mother-daughter vacation abroad takes a devastating turn when Gali is arrested for drug possession. Refusing to accept the charges, her mother Orna risks everything on a quest for freedom—only to get entangled in a web of Gali's secrets.

items.name: Single Papa
items.description: When Gaurav finds a baby in the back of his car, he must defy his eccentric family, the adoption agency and societal norms to become a single papa.

items.name: Is It Cake? Halloween
items.description: עוגה או זיוף? ממתק או תעלול? אופים מיומנים מכינים עוגות הלואין מציאותיות במיוחד. מהדורה חגיגית של התחרות הפופולרית.

items.name: Football Parents
items.description: When it comes to their children's amateur football careers, this group of parents has no shame, no chill — and a peculiar sense of team spirit.

items.name: Off Road
items.description: Raz and Sela, embark on a journey through Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan, exploring Central Asian landscapes while testing their friendship and personal convictions.

items.name: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies
items.description: Go inside the most dominant program in college basketball history as Geno Auriemma pushes his players to the limit to win 12 titles. Rebecca Lobo, Diana Taurasi, Paige Bueckers, and more reveal what it takes to survive UConn and build a dynasty.

items.name: The Root of the Game
items.description: Brazil lives, breathes and exports várzea. This series delves into the stories behind the beautiful game — one with the power to change lives.

items.name: Watching You
items.description: Lina is happily engaged, but a chance encounter with a stranger culminates in a one-night stand. When the affair is secretly filmed and used to blackmail her, she hunts the voyeur, only to discover the danger is far closer than she could imagine.

items.name: Lovers Anonymous
items.description: Cem, scarred by a childhood that crushed his trust in love, runs the "Love Hospital" — until Hazal, a believer in the power of love, disrupts his life.

items.name: The Murky Stream
items.description: The fates of a man with a hidden past, a wise and just woman, and an upright man intertwine.

items.name: Prison Cell 211
items.description: Follows a riot that took place at a state prison in the Mexican border town of Ciudad Juárez on Dec 31, 2022 that left several dead.

items.name: Take a Hike!
items.description: Four celebrity hiking newbies end up forming a club to tackle Korea's snow‑capped peaks. Can they figure out why on earth people go to the mountains?

items.name: Obsess
items.description: After returning home, Talal is pulled into a dark psychological journey where the lines between guilt, desire and his own disturbing impulses begin to blur. As buried feelings connected to a past love resurface, the darkness inside him grows stronger. Talal is forced to confront a terrifying question: can he free himself from his past, or will it consume him completely?

items.name: Power Moves with Shaquille O'Neal
items.description: NBA legends Shaquille O'Neal and Allen Iverson work to revive Reebok's legacy and find a rising star to rep the brand.

items.name: Reminder
items.description: Deniz, a reliable, famous architect, and Güneş, a phenomenal editor, who decided to separate six months ago while on their way to a wedding, are swept into a journey that will change their lives with a message that arrives on their phones on the evening of the day they met by chance. This new adventure will make them discover the missing pieces of their old relationship and remind them of love.

items.name: The Sisters Grimm
items.description: One year after their parents' mysterious disappearance, sisters Sabrina and Daphne move to a magical town where fairytales are real and secrets lurk behind every corner.

items.name: Love Overboard
items.description: Step aboard the ultimate luxury yacht, where sexy singles are ready to mix and mingle ... and find love. But there's a twist ... gaining access to the yacht's extravagant amenities won't be so simple. As the journey unfolds, romance ignites; alliances form; and hearts are shattered. In the end, only one couple will reign supreme. Who will rise to the top, and who will be left stranded?

items.name: Cash Queens
items.description: When life pushes them to the brink, five desperate friends decide the only way out is to form a gang, swipe some guns and start holding up banks.

items.name: Side Quest
items.description: The lives of the employees, players, and fans who are affected by the video game Mythic Quest (2020).

items.name: Unspeakable Sins
items.description: Trapped in a controlling marriage, a woman starts an affair with a younger man for comfort and revenge, but their liaison transforms into a perilous battle to stay alive.

items.name: Medalist
items.description: Tsukasa, whose dreams were crushed. Inori, left to fend for herself. These two share a dream...and their tenacity may be the only thing that sees them through. Their destination? The ice...on the world's stage.

items.name: Time Flies
items.description: Fresh out of prison and low on options, two women run a fumigation business — until a shady client pulls them back into the life they fought to escape.

items.name: Secrets of the Bees
items.description: With the expertise of entomologist and fellow National Geographic Explorer Dr. Samuel Ramsey, the series uses groundbreaking filming technology to reveal the extraordinary world of bees; and uncover their astonishing architecture and intelligence, unlocking their secrets and featuring never-before-filmed moments.

items.name: Had I Not Seen the Sun
items.description: Filmmaker Zhou Pin-yu interviews a serial killer in prison — an encounter that triggers a string of mysterious events tied to a buried past.

items.name: Sins of Kujo
items.description: From thugs to yakuza, Taiza Kujo wields the law to defend society's worst. Fellow lawyer, Karasuma doubts his ethics but joins him in facing the abyss.

items.name: Aema
items.description: In 1980s Korea, a movie star and a starlet defy male-dominated industry rules and backstage corruption while filming the provocative "Madame Aema."

items.name: Dandelion
items.description: At an afterlife agency where angels guide lingering souls, Tetsuo and Misaki take on any challenge to help the dead find peace in their own offbeat style.

items.name: I Am Ilary
items.description: Follow TV host Ilary Blasi as she defines her life post-divorce, balancing personal growth, career opportunities and a new love.

items.name: Super Subbu
items.description: An unlucky teacher is assigned to teach sex ed in a hostile village. Can he balance this secret while chasing his dreams and saving his relationship?

items.name: The Eighth Family
items.description: With their invention of bulletproof thermal underwear, the Basmacıgil Family earns the title of the Eighth Family, one of the ruling forces of the world. Yet, as six very different siblings attempt to run the family business, their well-meaning but ineffective efforts leave their father Erol convinced that “no outside enemy is necessary."

items.name: How to Win the Lottery
items.description: An ordinary man, facing financial desperation, assembles a team of underdogs to pull off a daring heist to steal the lottery jackpot on live TV.

items.name: Alkhallat+: The Series
items.description: A Saudi anthology series from the creators of the beloved AlKhallat+ universe, now streaming on Netflix. Four standalone stories drop ordinary underdogs — an anxious teen, a clueless security guard, a desperate filmmaker, and a tongue-tied poet — into absurdly chaotic desert situations. Sharp satire, dry humour, and authentic Saudi cultural identity make each episode a wildly entertaining ride.

items.name: The Wild Ones
items.description: Explore hidden corners of Earth with a trio of experts as they try to save six endangered species from extinction. With crafty camerawork and survival skills, the team race to find, record, and protect these elusive creatures before it's too late.

items.name: Caroline Flack: Search for the Truth
items.description: Follow Caroline's mother, Christine, as she investigates the truth about her daughter's final months - uncovering new shocking details, asking difficult questions, and exposing the misrepresentations, pressures, and failures from institutions and decision makers that shaped Caroline's final days.

items.name: Old Money
items.description: A bold, self-made mogul faces of with an old-money diplomat. Can love find its way amidst a power struggle, where wealth and wit collide?

items.name: MARINES
items.description: Follow the 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit as they conduct high-stakes combat exercises in the Pacific.

items.name: Her Last Broadcast: The Abduction of Jodi Huisentruit
items.description: In 1995, rising TV news anchor Jodi Huisentruit disappeared from her Iowa apartment just before dawn, leaving behind signs of a violent abduction. Her case quickly became one of the nation’s most haunting unsolved mysteries. Now, 30 years later, “Her Last Broadcast: The Abduction of Jodi Huisentruit” follows a major break that reenergized the case.

items.name: Made with Love
items.description: To save the family business, ambitious chef Luka must team up with newcomer Dennis when he joins her mother's restaurant. The only catch? She hates him.

items.name: Mark Rober's CrunchLabs
items.description: At CrunchLabs, Mark Rober transforms wild ideas into reality, blending engineering and outrageous fun for science adventures you'll never forget.

items.name: Underdogs
items.description: Follow the story of the heroic underdogs of the natural world – the good, the bad and the frankly ugly. From their hidden talents to their bold hygiene choices, unsavory courtship rituals, devious camouflage techniques and “tough love” parenting skills, Underdogs will celebrate and champion the unique and unpredictable behaviors of a little known and surprising cast of animal characters.

items.name: The Bad Guys: The Series
items.description: How did the Bad Guys break into the bad guy business in the first place? Find out in this hilarious prequel series set before the hit films.

items.name: Secrets of the Penguins
items.description: Over two extraordinary years, National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory discovered never-before-filmed secret traditions, surprising intelligence and close-knit societies of penguins. This astonishing series reveals they are more like us than we ever dreamed, from their powerful friendships to the courageous risk-takers using ingenuity and innovation in some of the world's most extreme places.

items.name: Capturing Their Killer: The Girls on the High Bridge
items.description: In the bucolic town of Delphi, Indiana, 13-year-old Abigail Williams and 14-year-old Liberty German set out for a walk on a warm February afternoon in 2017 - and never came home. Their bodies were discovered the next day in a wooded area not far from the trail, setting off a five-year-long search that gripped the nation and haunted this close-knit community.

items.name: Cat's Eye
items.description: By day, sisters Hitomi, Rui and Ai run the popular Cat's Eye Café; by night, they slip into the shadows, executing high-stakes art heists with precision and style.

items.name: How I Escaped My Cult
items.description: Go inside insidious modern-day cults through the unique lens of members who endured unspeakable trauma and the shocking investigations into these oppressive groups. With detailed, firsthand accounts from former cult members, their loved ones, and the investigators who helped bring these tormentors to justice.

items.name: Born to Be Wild
items.description: From first steps to first hunts, follow six rare baby animals as they learn survival skills and bring hope for the future of their species in the wild.

items.name: Shared Custody
items.description: Follows Cris and Diego, who have just separated and are both forced to move back into their parents' houses, but things quickly deteriorate as once divided lives become intertwined again.

items.name: Sicily Express
items.description: With Christmas around the corner, two blundering Sicilian friends working in Milan discover a dumpster that transports them to their families in seconds.

items.name: Mr. & Mrs. Murder
items.description: Four close friends' seemingly perfect lives unravel after one vanishes on a hunting trip. Nearly 20 years later, the truth emerges with devastating consequences.

items.name: Low Life
items.description: A dangerous story of rough people obsessed with shameless greed who gather together with their own greed and logic to find underwater artifacts off the coast of Shinan.

items.name: Love You to Death
items.description: Raúl's world is unraveling. Marta's unexpectedly pregnant. After a funeral meet-cute brings them together, they stumble through the chaos of life and love.

items.name: Mrs Playmen
items.description: Betrayed by her husband, a woman must step up and run an erotic magazine that becomes a symbol of empowerment in '70s Rome. Inspired by true events.

items.name: The New Force
items.description: 1958, the first Swedish female police officer graduates. A small group of pioneers are taking a big step towards gender equality, but they continue to struggle when the skirts they are forced to wear cross unthinkable limits.

items.name: Rivers of Fate
items.description: Three strangers' lives collide in the Amazon: Janalice, kidnapped by traffickers; Preá, a reluctant gang leader; Mariangel, seeking vengeance for her family's murder.

items.name: F1: The Academy
items.description: Fifteen young women break barriers in one of the world's most demanding sports as they race to get a female driver back on the Formula 1 grid.

items.name: Dirty Talk: When Daytime Talk Shows Ruled TV
items.description: A look back at the rise, fall and lasting impact of the most sensational era in TV talk show history. By exploring the psychological forces that shaped the talk TV genre, the series reveals how these shows transformed from trusted confessional spaces into lightning rods of controversy, leaving a lasting impact on culture, media and the people caught in the chaos.

items.name: Project UFO
items.description: A smug TV host and a small-town ufologist work to uncover the origins of an alleged UFO sighting, splitting the nation in a storm of doubts and beliefs.

items.name: Murder Has Two Faces
items.description: In the shadow of a highly publicized tragedy, an eerily similar crime is overlooked. GMA's Robin Roberts shines new light on the victims largely ignored.

items.name: Mob War: Philadelphia vs. The Mafia
items.description: Philadelphia is the City of Brotherly Love, but in the '90s, it was a bloodbath. Two warring mob factions battle for control in this true-crime series.

items.name: Nightmares of Nature
items.description: Chilling tales of survival unfurl in this documentary series that captures the drama, danger and dark beauty of nature from the perspective of its prey.

items.name: Maledictions
items.description: At a career-defining moment, a governor's child vanishes. Torn between ambition and family secrets, he must choose: politics or his daughter's safety.

items.name: Dabba Cartel
items.description: In VivaLife Society, men and women lead parallel lives - one caught in a pharma investigation, the other in drug peddling through a dabba delivery business.

items.name: Catalog
items.description: A recently widowed workaholic clumsily navigates life with his kids, guided by his late wife's online tips. Can he ace this crash course in parenthood?

items.name: Dr. Seuss's Horton!
items.description: Young Horton explores the Jungle of Nool with his two best friends: going on daring adventures, helping their community, and learning how to stand up for what's fair.

items.name: Unmasked
items.description: In modern-day Seoul, a crack team of investigative journalists fight for their careers after broadcasting a controversial story. With time running out, the team are given an impossible task if they want to save their jobs – solve a twenty-year-old cold case involving a famous actor who disappeared without a trace.

items.name: Crime Scene Zero
items.description: In this mystery showdown, players engage in layered scenarios as either suspects or detectives — each striving to outsmart others and uncover the truth.

items.name: Shafted
items.description: Follow Cédric, Tom, Jérémie and Tonio, four friends whose romantic and professional lives are turned upside down by the women in their lives.

items.name: Mandala Murders
items.description: In a quaint mysterious town of Charandaspur, where fate, myth, and murder entwine, detectives Rea Thomas and Vikram Singh unravel a chilling conspiracy of ritualistic killings tied to a centuries-old secret society.

items.name: Letters from the Past
items.description: When a young woman discovers a long-buried secret about her past, she must trace back a collection of letters to their writers to uncover the truth.

items.name: Love Thy Nader
items.description: Four Louisiana sisters - led by model Brooks Nader - chase their dreams in NYC's Soho, balancing fashion careers and sisterhood far from their bayou roots.

items.name: Three Idiots in Kenya
items.description: Once a far-off promise, now a reality — three buddies finally hit the road in Kenya. Get ready for adventure, banter and maybe even a giraffe selfie.

items.name: Inside: USA
items.description: Content creators scheme, sabotage and spend in wild challenges to win up to $1M in the first US series from British YouTube collective the Sidemen.

items.name: Franklin
items.description: A counterfeit artist, also a single father, is forced to work with his ex-lover to craft the perfect $100 bill — all to save his dying daughter.

items.name: Scam Goddess
items.description: As a hit podcaster, comedian Laci Mosley knows her way around a scam. Now, she's taking her expertise on the road, uncovering small-town swindles and big-city cons across the U.S.

items.name: Blippi's Job Show
items.description: Blippi and Meekah are on a mission to learn about all kinds of jobs. From driving a monster truck to making pizzas, there's no job too big or too small!

items.name: Bullet Bullet
items.description: In the near future, civilization has collapsed. Gear works in a junk shop, retrieving stolen goods alongside Qu-0213 and White Bear. After accepting a mysterious request to steal an important item, they soon find themselves hunted by deadly assassins.

items.name: RIV4LRIES
items.description: At a middle school in Pisa, no one has ever challenged the cool kids — until new girl Terry arrives with bold ideas and the rivalries begin.

items.name: THE ONE SHOT
items.description: Eight of Japan's top comedians selected by Daigo, including M-1 finalists and King of Conte champions, must each write and direct a short film with just one rule: include a single, hilarious gag. In this unprecedented competition, skilled comedians have just "one shot" to prove their true talent.

items.name: Someone Has to Know
items.description: A boy vanishes, and no one can find him. An open-and-shut case, except there are no leads. Three hundred people around him, and no one saw anything?

items.name: Hey Beautiful: Anatomy of a Romance Scam
items.description: Three women from around the world fall in love with the same handsome man, but their online boyfriend is not who he seems, and it could cost them everything.

items.name: Not Her First Rodeo
items.description: This six-part series takes viewers inside the fast-paced world of professional bull riding., following five remarkable women called the Elite Lady Bull Riders.

items.name: Yacht Deals Monaco
items.description: Ambitious sales talents compete in Monaco for a life-changing job in the world of luxury yachts. Under the guidance of yacht broker Cornelius Kistler and yacht consultant Marcela de Kern Royer, they face demanding tasks, high-end clients, and intense eliminations.

items.name: Girl on the Run: The Hunt for America's Most Wanted Woman
items.description: When convicted double murderer Sarah Pender escapes from a maximum-security prison in Indiana, a nationwide manhunt is immediately launched. Charged alongside her former boyfriend, who pled guilty, for the murder of a young couple, Pender has vanished, igniting fear, fascination, and a relentless pursuit that stretches across state lines.

items.name: Steven Universe: The Movie
items.description: Steven thinks his time defending the Earth is over, but when a new threat comes to Beach City, Steven faces his biggest challenge yet.

items.name: Bad Lieutenant: Port of Call New Orleans
items.description: Terence McDonagh is a drug- and gambling-addled detective in post-Katrina New Orleans investigating the killing of five Senegalese immigrants.

items.name: Animal Race
items.description: Inspired by the illegal universe of the Brazilian animal lottery, a fearless young man must win a deadly race to save his sister in a dystopian future where each animal in the game is now represented by a runner vying for a prize.

items.name: Fabian and the Deadly Wedding
items.description: Hapless con artist Fabian crashes a quirky winter wedding, planning to steal a valuable gift meant for the bride. But when a murder disrupts his scheme, Fabian finds himself unexpectedly drawn into solving the mystery. A thrilling murder mystery comedy packed with dark secrets.

items.name: Housefull 5
items.description: In this murder mystery comedy, several imposters claiming to be the son of a recently deceased billionaire compete for his fortune aboard a luxury cruise ship.

items.name: No Place to Be Single
items.description: In a picturesque Tuscan town, Elisa's world shifts when a childhood friend's return stirs up old emotions.

items.name: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
items.description: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

items.name: Melania
items.description: An intimate chronicle offers a rare glimpse into the life of Melania Trump, exploring her role as First Lady and her relationship with the former president.

items.name: McWalter
items.description: A madcap secret agent is faced with a series of mysteries after saving the world from a dangerous criminal.

items.name: Relationship Goals
items.description: Explores the ups and downs of modern romance.

items.name: Iki Dünya Bir Dilek
items.description: At first glance, Bilge and Jan have nothing in common: he is a world-renowned archaeologist, she is a pragmatic and successful lawyer. For the first time, fate brought them together in childhood, when an ordinary friendship turned...

items.name: Une Famille de Bâtards
items.description: Paris, 1997. After his womanizing father is shot, Mohamed discovers two unknown siblings, Maurice and Morgane. Together they must save their father's seedy bar, Chez Momo, from debt and local gangsters with help from regulars.

items.name: The Merchants of Joy
items.description: In the city that never sleeps, five families hustle each winter to turn sidewalks into holiday outposts.

items.name: Follow My Voice
items.description: After a health crisis that keeps her home, Klara does nothing but listen to her favorite radio show, Follow My Voice. But one day she wonders: is it possible to fall in love with someone she has only heard on the radio but never met? Could she really have feelings for Kang, the radio show host whose voice she has only heard once, and will she overcome her fears to step out into the world again?

items.name: War of the Worlds
items.description: A colossal invasion of Earth is coming in this off-kilter take on the legendary novel of the same name, filled with present-day themes of technology, government surveillance, and privacy.

items.name: The Last Showgirl
items.description: A seasoned showgirl must plan for her future when her show abruptly closes after a 30-year run.

items.name: Gunslingers
items.description: In a town named Redemption, reformed gunslinger Keller and mad genius Ben are guided by spiritual leader Jericho towards vindication. While confronting their violent histories, their newfound peace is challenged by violence and re...

items.name: Simple Plan: The Kids in the Crowd
items.description: A captivating and nostalgic look at one of the most popular pop-punk bands of the 2000s. Packed with never-before-seen archival footage and exclusive access to their sold-out 2024 World Tour, the members of Simple Plan and a cast of punk-rock superstars recount the highs and lows of the first 25 years of their career. Stage-dive into a story of brotherhood, fans and resilience.

items.name: Fallout: The Ghoul Log
items.description: This ain't your daddy's holiday special. Join The Ghoul, Wayne Newton, and a burning arm for the most festive 90 minutes of your life.

items.name: In Cold Light
items.description: Ava attempts to go straight after prison, but her twin is murdered and being a witness to the shooting, she is forced to run for her life.

items.name: Enemies
items.description: What would you do for your enemy? This is the story of two teenagers from the neighborhood, victim and executioner, bullied and harassed, who have grown up being irreconcilable enemies.

items.name: Tyler Perry's Finding Joy
items.description: Stranded in Colorado after a devastating holiday revelation, a talented but overlooked NYC designer finds unexpected love, transforming her life and career path.

items.name: Border Hunters
items.description: After his police officer brother is killed by a drug dealer who flees to the protection of his cartel-connected uncle in Mexico, an American man with a diverse law enforcement/military background goes south of the border to get re...

items.name: The Uninvited
items.description: Rose and Sammy enjoy an idyllic life with love, a Hollywood Hills home, and a curious son. During a party, Sammy assigns unusual significance to it, while Rose juggles preparations amid distractions.  The unexpected arrival of Helen, who claims residence there, oscillates between confusion and lucidity. Strangely, Helen possesses intimate knowledge of the house and its guests. Her revelations spark drama, unearthing hidden truths and compelling Rose to confront her past, future, and the desire for change.

items.name: Wish You Were Here
items.description: A woman searching for a spark finds a whirlwind night of romance with a man only to discover he is terminally ill and commits to helping him spend his last days living life to the fullest.

items.name: The Invisible War
items.description: An investigative documentary about the epidemic of rape of soldiers within the US military.

items.name: Superboys of Malegaon
items.description: The residents of Malegaon look to Bollywood cinema for a much-needed escape from daily drudgery. Amateur filmmaker Nasir Shaikh gets inspired to make a film for the people of Malegaon, by the people of Malegaon. He bands together his ragtag group of friends to bring his vision to life, thereby bringing a fresh lease of life into the town.

items.name: Bad Shabbos
items.description: An engaged interfaith couple are about to have their parents meet for the first time over a Shabbat dinner when an accidental death gets in the way.

items.name: Bau, Artist at War
items.description: Based on the true story of Joseph and Rebecca Bau, whose wedding took place in the Plaszow concentration camp during WW2. Using his artistic skills, Joseph stays alive and helps hundreds to escape. Miraculously, he finds love in the midst of despair. Years later, when called to be a key witness in the trial of the brutal Nazi officer who tortured him and killed his father, Joseph is thrust back into vivid memories of the Holocaust. Now, he calls upon this love and resilience of spirit to face the ultimate demon of his past.

items.name: An Endless Wedding
items.description: During a wedding in a riad on the edge of the Moroccan desert, Paul meets Louna, the bride's sister and witness. Following a paranormal event, they both find themselves trapped in the same space-time, forced to live the same day over and over again. And so begins a love story set against the backdrop of a time loop and a never-ending marriage…

items.name: Carjackers
items.description: Nora is a valet driver; with Zoé, Steve and Prestance, her colleagues and friends, she has set up the Carjackers team. By day, they serve wealthy clients in palaces, but when they're not working, they rob those whose evil deeds th...

items.name: A Line of Fire
items.description: An ex-FBI agent is pulled back into a dangerous world when his former partner's niece asks for his help.

items.name: Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass
items.description: During a chase inside a museum, Tom and Jerry find an ancient magical compass and end up being transported through time. Lost in a distant era, they will need to work together to find a way back home.

items.name: Praise This
items.description: A young woman with dreams of being a superstar joins an underdog Atlanta praise-team choir in the lead-up to the national competition

items.name: Music Box: Wizkid: Long Live Lagos
items.description: From Lagos to London, this powerful documentary follows Wizkid’s rise as a global icon reshaping how Africa is seen — and heard — around the world. Blending intimate moments, explosive performances, and cultural commentary, the film captures how Wizkid is using his platform to change perceptions, reclaim African identity, and inspire a new generation.

items.name: Schmeichel
items.description: A Goalkeeper in Danish football team that won the European Championship against all odds in 1992 and captained Manchester United in the Champions League final victory that clinched the treble in 1999.

items.name: Love & Rage: Munroe Bergdorf
items.description: Focuses on one of the most talked about and important issues of our time – how to find yourself and your truth. It follows model and transgender activist Munroe Bergdorf’s journey and provides hope for those facing similar challenges.

items.name: Bull Shark 3
items.description: The finale to the Bull Shark trilogy as a family of Bull Sharks faces off against a small Texas lake community.

items.name: Surface
items.description: A woman's quest to rebuild her life after a suicide attempt, and her struggle to understand all the things that led up to that moment.

items.name: Obliterated
items.description: A special forces team thwarts a deadly plot in Sin City and parties accordingly. But when the real threat emerges, they must sober up to save Las Vegas.

items.name: Man with a Plan
items.description: A dad finds out that parenting is harder than he thought after his wife goes back to work and he's left at home to take care of the kids.

items.name: Time Bandits
items.description: An unlikely alliance forms between a band of thieves and Kevin, an 11-year-old history buff, as they embark on a perilous mission to save Kevin's family and the world.

items.name: Supersex
items.description: Siffredi's family, his origins, his relationship and the context that led him to embark on his path in pornography and accept that the demon in his body is compatible with love.

items.name: K.C. Undercover
items.description: An outspoken and confident technology wiz and skilled black belt discovers that both her parents are spies and expect her to follow in their footsteps.

items.name: Avengers Assemble
items.description: The further adventures of the Marvel Universe's mightiest general membership superhero team.

items.name: Young & Hungry
items.description: A well-off young tech entrepreneur hires a feisty young food blogger to be his personal chef.

items.name: The Spencer Sisters
items.description: Police officer Darby Spencer and her mystery novelist mother Victoria Spencer have opposite personalities but still embark on the unlikeliest of ventures: becoming partners in a private detective agency.

items.name: Diagnosis Murder
items.description: Dr. Mark Sloan has a knack for getting into trouble, negotiating the twists and turns of mysteries and solving crimes with the help of his son, Steve, a homicide detective.

items.name: Shark

Miss Sophie challenges the bachelors to witty competitions for her heart and tries to secretly find the murderer. items.description: Mila and Kia are a pair of teenage best friends and aspiring professional footballers. When the girls get a new demanding football coach, they slowly start to drift apart.

items.name: My Tennis Maestro
items.description: Italy, 1989. After years of hard training, 13-year-old Felice, carrying his father's expectations on his shoulders, finally sets out to compete in the national tennis tournaments. While dreaming of a simple summer vacation, he's instead placed under the wing of ex tennis champion Raul, an unconventional coach hired by his father. Match after match, the two embark on a journey that will lead Felice to discover the taste of freedom, and Raul to glimpse the possibility of a fresh start. As they travel along the Italian coast, an unexpected, deep, and sincere bond between them develops.

items.name: Mark Cavendish: Never Enough
items.description: An intimate and captivating documentary follows pro cyclist Mark Cavendish's fast road to the top, tragic setback and incredible comeback.

items.name: Race to the Summit
items.description: Fearless alpine climbers Ueli Steck and Dani Arnold enter into a death-defying rivalry to set speed records on the Swiss Alps' great north faces.

items.name: Higuita: The Way of the Scorpion
items.description: From humble origins to soccer legend, this documentary captures the rise of Colombia’s René Higuita, from iconic career to personal controversies.

items.name: Giannis: The Marvelous Journey
items.description: A documentary that chronicles the extraordinary odyssey of NBA mega-star Giannis Antetokounmpo from an impoverished childhood in Greece as the son of Nigerian immigrants to the very top of the basketball world.

items.name: The Big Red One
items.description: A hardened sergeant and the four core members of his infantry unit try to survive World War II as they move from battle to battle throughout Europe.

items.name: Catch-22
items.description: A military pilot makes a valiant effort to be certified insane during World War II so that he can be excused from flying missions. But there's a catch.

items.name: Force 10 from Navarone
items.description: During World War II, several oddly assorted military experts are teamed in a mission to raid and destroy a bridge vital to enemy strategy.

items.name: Buffalo Soldiers
items.description: A criminal subculture operates among U.S. soldiers stationed in West Germany just before the fall of the Berlin wall.

items.name: Twice Born
items.description: A mother brings her teenage son to Sarajevo, where his father died in the Bosnian conflict years ago.

items.name: Birdy
items.description: After two friends return home from the Vietnam War one becomes mentally unstable and obsesses with becoming a bird.

items.name: The Duellists
items.description: France, 1801. Due to a minor perceived slight, mild-mannered Lieutenant d'Hubert is forced into a duel with the hot-headed and irrational, Lieutenant Feraud; their disagreement ultimately resulting in scores of duels spanning seve...

items.name: The Quiet American
items.description: A veteran English journalist and a young man vie for the affection of a beautiful Vietnamese woman in the 1950s.

items.name: Southern Comfort
items.description: During a routine exercise, a team of National Guardsmen are threatened by angry and violent locals.

items.name: Billy Two Hats
items.description: After a bank robbery, runaway Scottish outlaw Arch Deans and his young half breed Kiowa partner Billy Two Hats develop a father-son relationship but Sheriff Henry Gifford is determined to capture or kill them.

items.name: High Noon
items.description: A town Marshal, despite the disagreements of his newlywed bride and the townspeople around him, must face a gang of deadly killers alone at "high noon" when the gang leader, an outlaw he "sent up" years ago, arrives on the noon tr...

items.name: The Wild Bunch
items.description: An aging group of outlaws in 1913 Texas look for one last big score, selling stolen Army rifles to a rogue Mexican general during that country's revolution, as the traditional American West is disappearing around them.

items.name: Rio Bravo
items.description: A small-town sheriff in the American West enlists the help of a disabled man, a drunk, and a young gunfighter in his efforts to hold in jail the brother of the local bad guy.

items.name: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
items.description: A senator returns to a Western town for the funeral of an old friend and tells the story of his origins.

items.name: Hang 'Em High
items.description: When an innocent man barely survives being lynched by a mob of vigilantes seeking justice for a rancher who was murdered, he returns as a lawman determined to bring the errant vigilantes to justice.

items.name: True Grit
items.description: A drunken, hard-nosed U.S. Marshal and a Texas Ranger help a stubborn teenager track down her father's murderer in the old American West.

items.name: Django
items.description: A coffin-dragging gunslinger and a prostitute become embroiled in a bitter feud between a Klan of Southern racists and a band of Mexican Revolutionaries.

items.name: Stagecoach
items.description: A group of people traveling on a stagecoach find their journey complicated by the threat of Geronimo and learn something about each other in the process.

items.name: Seven Brides for Seven Brothers
items.description: When a backwoodsman in 1850s Oregon brings a wife home to his farm, his six brothers decide that they want to get married too, whether the women are willing or not.

items.name: El Dorado
items.description: Cole Thornton, a gunfighter for hire, joins forces with old friend, Sheriff J.P. Harrah. Together with an old Indian fighter and a gambler, they help a rancher and his family fight a rival rancher who's trying to steal their water.

items.name: Old Yeller
items.description: In 1860s Texas, a stray yellow dog proves his worth to a frontier family, especially bonding with their teenage son who must help manage their homestead while his father works a cattle drive.

items.name: Bad Day at Black Rock
items.description: Following World War II, a one-armed stranger arrives in a tiny California desert town, but finds the residents hostile and protecting a terrible secret they want to keep hidden, by violent means if necessary.

items.name: The Sons of Katie Elder
items.description: Ranch owner Katie Elder's four sons determine to avenge the murder of their father and the swindling of their mother.

items.name: My Darling Clementine
items.description: After their cattle are stolen and their brother murdered, the Earp brothers have a score to settle with the Clanton family.

items.name: Hombre
items.description: John Russell, disdained by his "respectable" fellow stagecoach passengers because he was raised by Apaches becomes their only hope for survival when they are set upon by outlaws.

items.name: Support Your Local Sheriff!
items.description: In the old west, a man becomes a Sheriff just for the pay, figuring he can decamp if things get tough. In the end, he uses ingenuity instead.

items.name: Johnny Guitar
items.description: After helping a wounded gang member, a strong-willed female saloon owner is wrongly suspected of murder and bank robbery by a lynch mob.

items.name: Cat Ballou
items.description: A young schoolteacher turns into an outlaw to avenge her murdered father.

items.name: The War Wagon
items.description: The story of a man who was shot, robbed and imprisoned who returns to steal a large gold shipment from the man who wronged him. The gold is transported in an armored stage coach, the War Wagon.

items.name: Hud
items.description: Honest, hard-working Texas rancher Homer Bannon has a conflict with his unscrupulous, selfish, arrogant, egotistical son Hud, who sank into alcoholism after accidentally killing his brother in a car crash.

items.name: Ride the High Country
items.description: An ex-union soldier is hired to transport gold from a mining community through dangerous territory. But what he doesn't realize is that his partner and old friend is plotting to double-cross him.

items.name: The Horse Soldiers

items.name: Nevada Smith
items.description: A half-Native American/half-Caucasian young man evolves into a hardened killer as he tracks down the men who murdered his parents.

items.name: Bend of the River

items.name: Boxer

items.name: The Final: Attack on Wembley
items.description: A dramatic England penalty defeat to Italy and chaos as thousands of un-ticketed fans attempted to storm Wembley Stadium.

items.name: Girl Climber
items.description: Professional climber Emily Harrington has summited Everest, 8000-meter peaks, and dominated the competition circuit but, her greatest challenge extends beyond the physical. To cement her legacy in the male dominated world of elite rock climbing, she sets her sights on a career-defining 24-hour ascent of Yosemite's El Capitan. Caught between the pursuit of personal ambition and the ticking biological clock of life, a near-fatal fall forces Emily to reckon with what she's willing to risk. Equal parts gripping survival story and intimate portrait, Girl Climber isn't just about breaking records, it's about breaking barriers. Amongst Yosemite's legendary boy's club, Emily isn't just proving she's the best *Girl Climber-- she's proving she is one of the best. Period.

items.name: Rescue Under Fire
items.description: In Afghanistan, a Spanish medevac is sent behind enemy/Taleban lines. Bad landing destroys the rotor. They are spotted by the Taleban. Can they and the chopper be rescued in time?

items.name: To End All Wars
items.description: During World War II, four Allied POWs endure harsh treatment from their Japanese captors while being forced to build a railroad through the Burmese jungle.

items.name: Bat*21
items.description: During the Vietnam War, Colonel Hambleton's aircraft is shot down over enemy territory and a frantic rescue operation ensues.

items.name: The Night Porter
items.description: A concentration camp survivor rekindles her sadomasochistic relationship with an ex-SS officer working as a night porter at a Vienna hotel, but his former associates begin stalking them.

items.name: 71: Into the Fire

items.description: A Soviet tank and its warring crew become separated from their patrol and lost in an Afghan valley with a group of vengeance-seeking rebels on their tracks.

items.name: Mackenna's Gold

items.description: In 1864, due to frequent Apache raids from Mexico into the U.S., a Union officer decides to illegally cross the border and destroy the Apache, using a mixed army of Union troops, Confederate POWs, civilian mercenaries, and scouts.

items.name: Love Me Tender
items.description: At the end of the Civil War, a Confederate team is ordered to rob a Union payroll train but the war ends leaving these men with their Union loot, until the Feds come looking for it.

items.name: Go West

items.name: The Pilgrim

items.name: The Scalphunters

items.description: John Halder, a German literature professor in the 1930s, is initially reluctant to accept the ideas of the Nazi Party. He is pulled in different emotional directions by his wife, his mother, his mistress, and a Jewish friend.

items.name: In Enemy Hands
items.description: When American submarine Swordfish is torpedoed the survivors are picked up by a passing German U-boat but an outbreak of meningitis threatens all aboard.

items.description: 14-year-old György's life is torn apart in WWII Hungary, as he is deported first to Auschwitz and then to Buchenwald, where he is forced to become a man in the midst of hatred, and what it really means to be Jewish.

items.name: Uprising

items.description: David Berman and his friends, all Holocaust survivors, have only one purpose: to go to America as soon as possible. For this they need money. Close to his aim, David is not only deprived of his savings but also overtaken by his sh...

Chosen as one of the victims, lawyer Chavel trades his place with another man in return for all his possessions. At the end of the war he returns to his house and tries to integrate himself with the family of the man who traded places with him, all the while hiding his true identity. However matters are complicated when a stranger arrives claiming to be Chavel.

items.description: After twenty-five years Silva rides a horse across the desert to visit his friend Sheriff Jake. They celebrate the meeting, but the next morning Jake tells him that reason for his trip is not to go down the memory lane of their fr...

items.name: Duck Soup
items.description: Rufus T. Firefly is named the dictator of bankrupt Freedonia and declares war on neighboring Sylvania over the love of his wealthy backer Mrs. Teasdale, contending with two inept spies who can't seem to keep straight which side th...

items.name: 36 Hours
