items.name: Hell's Angels
items.description: Brothers Monte and Roy leave Oxford to join the Royal Flying Corps. Roy loves Helen; Helen enjoys an affair with Monte; before they leave on their mission over Germany they find her in yet another man's arms.

items.name: The Secret of Santa Vittoria
items.description: During WWII in Italy, a wine-producing village hides a million bottles from the Germans

items.name: What Did You Do in the War, Daddy?
items.description: In World War II, a strategic Italian village agrees to surrender to the Allies only if it's allowed to organize a celebratory festival while giving aerial reconnaissance the false impression of fierce ground fighting.

items.name: The Cow and I
items.description: In 1942, a French prisoner of war in Germany decides to escape to France using a cow held by a lunge as a decoy. He crosses all Germany in this way.

items.name: Kings Go Forth
items.description: Toward the end of World War II, two American soldiers fighting in Southern France become romantically involved with a young, American woman. Her background will reveal more about them than her.

items.name: Gettysburg
items.description: In 1863, the Northern and Southern forces fight at Gettysburg in the decisive battle of the American Civil War.

items.name: The Keeper
items.description: The love story of a young English woman and a German PoW, who together overcome prejudice, public hostility and personal tragedy.

items.name: The Kill Team
items.description: A young American soldier in Afghanistan is disturbed by his commanding officer's behavior and is faced with a moral dilemma.

items.name: Sobibor
items.description: Soviet officer Alexander Pechersky organizes a revolt and mass escape of prisoners from Sobibór extermination camp in October 1943.

items.name: Operation Red Sea
items.description: PLA Navy Marine Corps launch a hostage rescue operation in the fictional Republic of Ihwea and undergo a fierce battle with rebellions and terrorism.

items.name: My Name Is Sara

items.name: War Machine
items.description: An idiosyncratic general confronts opposition from enemies, allies, and bureaucrats while leading a massive rebuilding operation in Afghanistan.

items.name: The Zookeeper's Wife
items.description: The Zookeeper's Wife tells the account of keepers of the Warsaw Zoo, Antonina and Jan Zabinski, who helped save hundreds of people and animals during the German invasion.

items.name: The Resistance Banker
items.description: In Nazi-occupied Amsterdam, banker brothers Walraven and Gijs van Hall face their greatest challenge yet when they decide to help fund the Dutch resistance.

items.name: Resistance
items.description: The story of mime Marcel Marceau as he works with a group of Jewish boy scouts and the French Resistance to save the lives of ten thousand orphans during World War II.

items.name: The Catcher Was a Spy
items.description: Former Major League Baseball player Moe Berg goes undercover in World War II Europe for the Office of Strategic Services.

items.name: 15 Minutes of War
items.description: In February 1976 in Djibouti, a school bus was taken hostage at the Somali border. The GIGN is sent on the spot. After 30 hours of tension, a rescue operation is organized.

items.name: Tall Tales
items.description: Shortly after the end of World War II, a con man on the run finds himself in a passionate love affair that may well cost him his life.

items.name: The Man with the Iron Heart
items.description: As Germany expands its borders, scorching Europe from end to end, two brave Czechs of the Resistance prepare to assassinate Reinhard Heydrich, the mastermind behind the hideous "Final Solution" to the "Jewish Question".

items.name: Sgt. Rock
items.description: Just after recovering from losing his entire unit in battle, Sgt. Rock leads a special army of commandos against a Nazi secret research base.

items.name: The Wall
items.description: Two American soldiers are pinned down in the Iraqi desert by a lethal sniper with only a crumbling wall between them.

items.name: T-34
items.description: An SS Panzer Division uses a T-34 manned by Soviet POWs as a training target, but the prisoners plot a daring maneuver.

items.name: The Aftermath
items.description: Post World War II, a British colonel and his wife are assigned to live in Hamburg during the post-war reconstruction, but tensions arise with the German who previously owned the house.

items.name: For Those I Loved
items.description: A story of the life of a Polish Jewish Holocaust survivor.

items.name: The Red Ghost
items.description: A detachment of Soviet soldiers, including a dangerous half-man, half-ghost, come up against an elite death squad within the Wehrmacht.

items.name: Narvik: Hitler's First Defeat
items.description: April 1940. The eyes of the world are on Narvik, a small town in northern Norway, source of the iron ore needed for Hitler's war machinery. Through two months of fierce winter warfare, Hitler is dealt his first defeat.

items.name: The Shadow in My Eye

items.name: Stars
items.description: Stationed in a secluded Bulgarian village in 1943, Walter – a German Wehrmacht sergeant and artist – lives in almost idyllic distance from the war. Then a transit camp is set up for Jews arriving from Greece. When Ruth, one of the internees, asks Walter to help a pregnant woman, the two form an unlikely bond.

items.name: Shake Hands with the Devil
items.description: The story of General Romeo Dallaire's frustrated efforts to stop the madness of the Rwandan Genocide, despite the complete indifference of his superiors.

items.name: Father Soldier Son
items.description: When Sgt. First Class Brian Eisch is critically wounded in Afghanistan, it sets him and his sons on a journey of love, loss, redemption and legacy.

items.name: Emancipation
items.description: A runaway slave forges through the swamps of Louisiana on a tortuous journey to escape plantation owners that nearly killed him.

items.name: Shoah
items.description: Claude Lanzmann's epic documentary recounts the story of the Holocaust through interviews with witnesses - perpetrators as well as survivors.

items.name: Hiroshima
items.description: Brilliant and extremely realistic retelling of the day in Hiroshima that the bomb dropped and following days.

items.name: Gods and Generals
items.description: The rise and fall of confederate general Thomas "Stonewall" Jackson, as he meets with military success against the Union from 1861 to 1863, when he is accidentally killed by his own soldiers.

items.name: Indochine
items.description: Eliane adopts Camille, whose Vietnamese parents were friends. In 1930, a French navy officer is interested in Eliane (owns 60km2 plantation) and later in Camille. There's an uprising in Vietnam against French colonial power.

items.name: The Devil's Double
items.description: A chilling vision of the house of Saddam. The world of Hussein comes to life through the eyes of the man who was given a choice; either be the double for Saddam's sadistic son, or die.

items.name: The Purple Plain
items.description: In World War II Burma, a Canadian bomber pilot becomes reckless after losing his bride in a Luftwaffe air raid.

items.name: Tigerland
items.description: A group of recruits go through Advanced Infantry Training at Fort Polk, Louisiana's infamous Tigerland, last stop before Vietnam for tens of thousands of young men in 1971.

items.name: Joyeux Noel
items.description: In December 1914, an unofficial Christmas truce on the Western Front allows soldiers from opposing sides of the First World War to gain insight into each other's way of life.

items.name: Au Revoir les Enfants
items.description: A French boarding school run by priests seems to be a haven from World War II until a new student arrives. Occupying the next bed in the dormitory to the top student in his class, the two young boys begin to form a bond.

items.name: Zulu
items.description: Outnumbered British soldiers do battle with Zulu warriors at Rorke's Drift.

items.name: The Naked and the Dead
items.description: Set during the Pacific War against the Japanese, this WW2 drama discerns between achieving one's mission at any cost versus preserving the lives under one's command and enforcing discipline through fear as opposed to mutual respect.

items.name: All Quiet on the Western Front
items.description: A German youth eagerly enters World War I, but his enthusiasm wanes as he gets a firsthand view of the horror.

items.name: Lost Command
items.description: French Army colonel Raspeguy leads his paratroopers in battle against the Communist Viet Minh in Indochina and against Algerian guerrillas during the Algerian War.

items.name: Stalingrad
items.description: The story follows a group of German soldiers, from their Italian R&R in the summer of 1942 to the frozen steppes of Soviet Russia and ending with the battle for Stalingrad.

items.name: The Garden of the Finzi-Continis
items.description: The story of the Finzi-Continis, a noble family of Ferrara, during the Jewish persecution in Italy's 1930s.

items.name: Fail Safe
items.description: A technical malfunction sends American planes to Moscow to deliver a nuclear attack. Can all-out war be averted?

items.name: Beyond Borders
items.description: The world's cruelty is confronted with the love of two different people who try to save humanity from poverty and war.

items.name: Rome, Open City
items.description: During the Nazi occupation of Rome in 1944, the Resistance leader, Giorgio Manfredi, is chased by the Nazis as he seeks refuge and a way to escape.

items.description: In the midst of the Russian Revolution of 1905, the crew of the battleship Potemkin mutiny against the brutal, tyrannical regime of the vessel's officers. The resulting street demonstration in Odessa brings on a police massacre.

items.name: The Flowers of War
items.description: An American finds refuge during the 1937 Japanese invasion of Nanking in a church with a group of women. Posing as a priest, he attempts to lead the women to safety.

items.name: Mediterraneo
items.description: In WW2, an Italian Army unit of misfits occupies an isolated non-strategic Greek island for the duration of the war.

items.name: Alexander Nevsky
items.description: The story of how a great Russian prince led a ragtag army to battle an invading force of Teutonic Knights.

items.name: The Train
items.description: In 1944, a German colonel loads a train with French art treasures to send to Germany. The Resistance must stop it without damaging the cargo.

items.name: Adam Resurrected
items.description: In the aftermath of World War II, a former circus entertainer who was spared from the gas chamber becomes the ringleader at an asylum for Holocaust survivors.

items.name: Paradise Now
items.description: Two childhood friends are recruited for a suicide bombing in Tel Aviv.

items.name: My Way
items.description: In World War II-era Korea, rival runners, one Korean (Jang Dong-gun) and one Japanese (Joe Odagiri), go to war together against the Soviets.

items.name: To Be or Not to Be
items.description: During the German occupation of Poland, an acting troupe becomes embroiled in a Polish soldier's efforts to track down a German spy.

items.name: Hamburger Hill
items.description: The story of the 101st Airborne Division in the Vietnam War and their difficult 10-day struggle to take over a strategic mountainside in South Vietnam.

items.name: The Eagle Has Landed
items.description: A German plot to kidnap Prime Minister Winston Churchill unfolds at the height of World War II.

items.name: Stripes
items.description: Two friends who are dissatisfied with their jobs decide to join the Army for a bit of fun.

items.name: Midway
items.description: A dramatization of the battle that was widely heralded as a turning point of the Pacific Theatre of World War II.

items.name: White Light/Black Rain: The Destruction of Hiroshima and Nagasaki
items.description: Using extensive interviews with survivors and archival footage, an examination reveals the aftermath of the atomic bombing of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

items.name: The Legend of Tomiris
items.description: This is the story of the life of the great queen of of the steppe - legendary Tomiris. She is destined to become a skillful warrior, survive the loss of close people and unite the Scythian/Saka tribes under her authority.

items.name: The Men Who Stare at Goats
items.description: A reporter in Iraq might just have the story of a lifetime when he meets Lyn Cassady, a guy who claims to be a former member of the U.S. Army's New Earth Army, a unit that employs paranormal powers in their missions.

items.name: Windtalkers
items.description: Two U.S. Marines in World War II are assigned to protect the Navajo Marines who use their native language as an unbreakable radio cipher.

items.name: Courage Under Fire
items.description: A U.S. Army officer, despondent about a deadly mistake he made, investigates a female chopper commander's worthiness for the Medal of Honor.

items.name: The Charge of the Light Brigade
items.description: In 1854, during the Crimean War, poor planning leads to the British Light Brigade openly charging a Russian artillery position with tragic consequences.

items.name: Rules of Engagement
items.description: A decorated career Marine stands trial for a botched mission.

items.name: War and Peace
items.description: Napoleon's tumultuous relations with Russia, including his disastrous 1812 invasion, serve as the backdrop for the tangled personal lives of two aristocratic families.

items.name: Exodus
items.description: The State of Israel is created in 1948, resulting in war with its Arab neighbors.

items.name: Kelly's Heroes
items.description: A group of U.S. soldiers sneaks across enemy lines in WWII France to get their hands on a secret stash of Nazi treasure.

items.name: A Woman in Berlin
items.description: A woman tries to survive the invasion of Berlin by the Soviet troops during the last days of World War II.

items.name: The Old Gun
items.description: During World War II, a peaceful French surgeon decides to ruthlessly exterminate an SS squad because of the atrocities they'd just committed in his countryside home and childhood village.

items.name: Sands of Iwo Jima
items.description: Haunted by personal demons, Marine Sgt. John Stryker is hated and feared by his men, who see him as a cold-hearted sadist. But when their boots hit the beaches, they begin to understand the reason for Stryker's rigid form of disci...

items.name: Fahrenheit 9/11
items.description: Michael Moore's view on what happened to the United States after 9/11 and how the Bush Administration allegedly used the tragic event to push forward its agenda for unjust wars in Afghanistan and Iraq.

items.name: The Caine Mutiny
items.description: When a U.S. Naval captain shows signs of mental instability that jeopardises the ship, the first officer is urged to consider relieving him of command.

items.name: Memphis Belle
items.description: In 1943, the crew of a B-17 based in the UK prepares for its 25th and final bombing mission over Germany before returning home to the USA.

items.name: The General
items.description: After being rejected by the Confederate military, not realizing it was due to his crucial civilian role, an engineer must single-handedly recapture his beloved locomotive after it is seized by Union spies and return it through ene...

items.name: The Age of Stupid
items.description: A future archivist looks at old footage from the year 2008 to understand why humankind failed to address climate change.

items.name: The Messenger: The Story of Joan of Arc
items.description: A young girl receives a vision that drives her to rid France of its oppressors.

items.name: Miracle at St. Anna
items.description: Set in 1944 Italy, the story of four black American soldiers who get trapped in a Tuscan village during WWII.

items.name: The Killing Fields
items.description: A journalist is trapped in Cambodia during Pol Pot's bloody Year Zero cleansing campaign.

items.name: Redacted
items.description: The devastating reconstruction of the rape and murder of a 15-year-old Iraqi girl by American soldiers in Samarra in 2006.

items.name: Rosenstrasse
items.description: After the death of her father, Hannah becomes concerned with the strange behavior of her mother. As her mother's troubled childhood is revealed, Hannah realizes how little she ever knew.

items.name: A Man Escaped
items.description: A captured French Resistance fighter during World War II engineers a daunting escape from a German prison in France.

items.name: Don't Look Now... We're Being Shot At!
items.description: Several ordinary Frenchmen go on an epic voyage through the occupied country to the free zone as they help British pilots avoid German captivity.

items.name: Zozo
items.description: A Lebanese boy gets separated from his family during the civil war and ends up in Sweden.

items.name: Stop-Loss
items.description: A veteran soldier returns from his completed tour of duty in Iraq, only to find his life turned upside down when he is arbitrarily ordered to return to field duty by the Army.

items.name: Final Account
items.description: An urgent portrait of the last living generation of Hitler's Third Reich in never-before-seen interviews raising vital questions about authority, conformity, national identity, and their own roles in the greatest human crimes in h...

items.name: The Bridge
items.description: In 1945, Germany is being overrun, and nobody is left to fight but teenagers.

items.name: A Very Long Engagement
items.description: Tells the story of a young woman's relentless search for her fiancé, who has disappeared from the trenches of the Somme during World War One.

items.name: Brothers
items.description: Two brothers must negotiate changing roles and shifting family dynamics when one is sent to war in Afghanistan.

items.name: Innocent Voices
items.description: A young boy, in an effort to have a normal childhood in 1980's El Salvador, is caught up in a dramatic fight for his life as he desperately tries to avoid the war which is raging all around him.

items.name: The Dam Busters
items.description: Drama based on the attempt by the RAF to destroy six dams in Germany during World War II.

items.name: The Dirty Dozen
items.description: During World War II, a rebellious U.S. Army Major is assigned a dozen convicted murderers to train and lead them into a mass assassination mission of German officers.

items.name: Operation Pacific
items.description: During WWII, a submarine's second in command inherits the problem of torpedoes that don't explode. When on shore, he is eager to win back his ex-wife.

items.name: The Last Metro
items.description: In occupied Paris, an actress married to a Jewish theater owner must keep him hidden from the Germans while doing both of their jobs.

items.name: Pork Chop Hill
items.description: During the Korean War peace talks in Panmunjom, U.S. troops fight and die trying to retake a worthless hill from the Communist Chinese forces.

items.description: The movie follows 3 Japanese friends from embarking on Yamato, the world's largest battleship, until it's sunk 3 1/2 years later on April 7, 1945 on it's way to Okinawa to stop American advance at the end of WWII.

items.name: Devotion
items.description: A pair of U.S. Navy fighter pilots risk their lives during the Korean War.

items.name: The Last Frontier
items.description: A film about the feat of the Podolsk cadets in October 1941 near Moscow. The cadets of the Podolsk artillery-infantry schools are ordered to take up defenses on the Ilyinsky line.

items.name: Justice Society: World War II
items.description: The Justice Society of America, a group of heroes aiding the allies in World War 2, acquire an ally from the future who sends them on an adventure that changes history.

items.name: Kandahar
items.description: A CIA operative and his translator flee from special forces in Afghanistan after exposing a covert mission.

items.name: Sometimes in April
items.description: When the Hutu nationalists raised arms against their Tutsi countrymen in Rwanda in April 1994, the violent uprising marked the beginning of one of the darkest times in African history which resulted in the deaths of almost 800,000...

items.description: A hardened mercenary in the Foreign Legion begins to find his own humanity when confronted with atrocities during the fighting in Bosnia.

items.name: Kapo
items.description: A young Jewish girl leads an escape attempt from a concentration camp.

items.name: Kokoda: 39th Battalion
items.description: A bitter battle is fought between Australian and Japanese soldiers along the Kokoda trail in New Guinea during World War II.

items.name: A Journal for Jordan
items.description: 1st Sgt. Charles Monroe King, before he is killed in action in Baghdad, authors a journal for his son intended to tell him how to live a decent life despite growing up without a father.

items.name: Harbin
items.description: Follows Korean independence activists who launched a daring attack in Harbin against the Japanese to gain their country's independence.

items.description: Arctic, 1965: Avik tells his story starting in 1931. A mapmaker flies Avik, then a preteen Eskimo boy with TB, to a hospital in Montreal where he meets Albertine. They meet again when Avik joins World War II in the UK.

items.description: Hannah and Anne, imprisoned at Bergen-Belsen during WWII's early years, share memories from their time in Amsterdam before learning they're separated by a wall on the eve of Hannah's family's exchange for German captives.

items.name: Firebird

items.name: Charlotte
items.description: An account of German-Jewish artist Charlotte Salomon's life in the south of France between 1941 and 1943, before she was sent to Auschwitz during World War II. Inspired by her memoir "Life? or Theatre?".

items.name: The Champion
items.description: The story of the pre-war boxing champion Tadeusz "Teddy" Pietrzykowski, who in 1940 arrives with the first transport of prisoners to the newly created Auschwitz concentration camp.

items.name: Mending the Line
items.description: A Marine wounded in Afghanistan is sent to a V.A. facility in Montana where he meets a Vietnam Vet who teaches him how to fly fish as a way of dealing with his emotional and physical trauma.

items.name: Image of Victory
items.description: In 1948, Hassanin joins a platoon going to Palestine to liberate farmers. While documenting their mission, Hassanin's values are tested and both sides re-evaluate what they understand about war.

items.name: Golda
items.description: Focuses on the intensely dramatic and high-stakes responsibilities and decisions that Golda Meir, also known as the 'Iron Lady of Israel,' faced during the Yom Kippur War.

items.name: Ordinary Men: The "Forgotten Holocaust"
items.description: Six million Jews died during World War II, both in the extermination camps and murdered by the mobile commandos of the Einsatzgruppen and police battalions, whose members shot men, women and children, day after day, obediently, as if it were a normal job, a fact that is hardly known today. Who were these men and how could they commit such crimes?

items.name: Forgive Us Our Trespasses
items.description: Targeted by Nazis as they hunt down and murder people with disabilities, a boy with a limb difference makes a daring decision while running for his life.

items.name: The Fox
items.description: At the dawn of WW2, a young soldier encounters a wounded fox cub and takes it with him to occupied France. The story of an unlikely friendship.

items.name: The Green Hornet
items.description: Several episodes of the 1966 TV series "The Green Hornet" edited together and released as a feature.

items.name: Meetings with Remarkable Men
items.description: G.I. Gurdjieff is a spiritual teacher and mystic who, after a lifetime study, developed a form of meditation incorporating modern dance.

items.name: Mad Bastards
items.description: TJ's quest to find the son he's never known, takes him on a journey across the remote and stunning Kimberley landscape. On the road, TJ questions his life of violence... he meets a host of amazing characters who open up a way of l...

items.name: Shadow of the Wolf
items.description: In Canada's North during the 1930s, a young Inuit kills a White trader and is pursued by the police but his father is determined to protect his fugitive son at any cost.

items.description: An epic journey of a young hero and her Spirit Guides, "Dillo" a cute and humorous armadillo and "Vaca" a goofy oversized tapir, who embark on a quest to save their home in the spectacular Amazon Rainforest.

items.name: Grand Piano
items.description: A pianist with stage fright endures a performance under the eyes of a mysterious sniper, who will shoot and kill him if a wrong note is played.

items.name: Cul-de-sac
items.description: A fugitive and his partner invade a recluse's castle.

items.name: Abandon
items.description: An investigation of a college student's missing boyfriend becomes quite strange when she begins to see him periodically.

items.name: Cops
items.description: A series of mishaps manages to make a young man get chased by a big city's entire police force.

items.name: Three Ages
items.description: The misadventures of Buster in three separate historical periods.

items.name: The Proud Princess
items.description: Time has come for young and handsome King Benjamin to marry. He is captivated by Princess Carolina's portrait, and disguised as a gardener, he infiltrates her castle to win her heart after she rejects him.

items.name: Beautiful Thing
items.description: Jamie is a shy teenager, often bullied at school. His neighbour Ste has a rough time at home, being beaten by his father and brother. This issues bring them together and they find that what they feel for each other is more than fr...

items.name: Rumble Fish
items.description: An absent-minded street thug struggles to live up to his legendary older brother's reputation and longs for the days of gang warfare.

items.name: Play It Again, Sam
items.description: A film critic obsessed with Casablanca (1942) seeks to get over his wife leaving him by dating again with the help of a married couple and his illusory idol, Humphrey Bogart.

items.name: Kina & Yuk

items.name: The Exorcism

items.name: Living It Up
items.description: An unsophisticated stationmaster from provincial New Mexico fraudulently claims that he is dying in order to get an expense-paid dream tour of New York.

items.name: Goodbye, Columbus
items.description: Young librarian Neil Klugman falls for beautiful 'nouveau riche' Radcliffe student Brenda Patimkin. His liberal sensibilities clash with the conservative values of Brenda's family creating a stressful clash of opinions on many sub...

items.name: Carmen
items.description: A group of flamenco dancers are rehearsing a very Spanish version of Bizet's dramatization of Prosper Merimee's novella Carmen. The choreographer Antonio falls in love with Carmen, the main dancer. Their story then turns similar t...

items.name: The Christmas Train
items.description: A cynical journalist decides to take a train from Washington, D.C. to Los Angeles for Christmas to get inspiration for a story in honor of his late father. He gets to know the other passengers and runs into an old flame while aboard.

items.name: Half Baked: Totally High

items.name: Little Odessa

items.name: Cold Weather

items.name: Assassination Nation

items.description: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with a man, Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.

items.name: Landship

At the start of a pivotal allied offensive to break the stalemate, the nine-man crew of a British MKIV Tank set out to destroy a series of heavily defended German bunkers.

items.name: The Party's Over!
items.description: Mehdi had planned to spend a quiet summer in his in-laws' sumptuous home. But as soon as he arrives, a conflict breaks out between his girfriend's family and the villa's janitor couple. As Mehdi comes from a modest background, he thinks he can lead the negotiations between the two parties and bring everyone back to their senses. But things start to escalate...

items.name: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers

items.name: Back to the 90s

But the ancient lizards have their own problems. After all, their world is about to be invaded by cave aliens armed with clubs.

items.name: All I Had Was Nothingness

items.name: Maidentrip
items.description: 14-year-old Laura Dekker sets out on a two-year voyage in pursuit of her dream to become the youngest person ever to sail around the world alone.

items.name: Higher Learning
items.description: People from all different walks of life, encounter racial tension, rape, responsibility, and the meaning of an education on a university campus.

items.name: National Velvet
items.description: A jaded former jockey helps a young girl prepare a wild but gifted horse for England's Grand National Sweepstakes.

items.name: Tremors: Shrieker Island
items.description: When a group of hunters genetically modify Graboid eggs, they face an all-out war against the larger, terrifyingly intelligent Graboids, and the swiftly multiplying Shriekers.

items.name: To Catch a Thief

items.name: Almost Human

Philosophers, anthropologists, archaeologists and programmers show us through their thought experiments that our relationship with technology is just as much about our relationship with ourselves.

items.name: Three Smart Girls

items.name: The Divergent Series: Allegiant
items.description: After the earth-shattering revelations of Insurgent, Tris must escape with Four beyond the wall that encircles Chicago to finally discover the shocking truth of the world outside.

items.name: The Rutles: All You Need Is Cash
items.description: Charts the adventures of the prefab four, possibly the most famous band of all time.

items.name: Vengeance

items.name: Rowdy Rathore
items.description: A con man uncovers a deadly secret and must save his lady love, the small-town locals and the little girl who insists she's his daughter, from the mob.

items.name: Desperate Living
items.description: A neurotic society woman murders her husband with her maid's help; on the lam, they escape to Mortville, a homeless community ruled by a fascist queen.

items.name: Rob Peace
items.description: Based on a true story, a brilliant young man puts his bright future at risk to help his father.

items.name: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane

items.name: Marlowe
items.description: A young woman from Kansas hires LA private investigator Philip Marlowe to find her missing brother. Matters become more complicated when her sister, a successful actress who's being blackmailed, becomes connected to the case.

items.name: The Narrow Margin
items.description: A woman planning to testify against the mob must be protected against potential assassins on the train trip from Chicago to Los Angeles.

items.name: Little Fockers
items.description: Family-patriarch Jack Byrnes wants to appoint a successor. Does his son-in-law, the male nurse Greg Focker, have what it takes?

items.name: Mortal Kombat: Annihilation
items.description: A group of martial-arts warriors must save the Earth from an extra-dimensional invasion.

items.name: Chattahoochee
items.description: In 1955 Florida, a Korean vet has a breakdown and is incarcerated in a "maximum security" mental health prison, where patients are abused.

items.name: Mortal Kombat
items.description: Smart Earthlings must win a martial-arts battle in another dimension or see their world enslaved.

items.description: Psychoanalyst Sigmund Freud invites professor C.S. Lewis to debate the existence of God, Freud's unique relationship with his daughter, and Lewis' unconventional relationship with his best friend's mother.

items.description: A love romance between older, respectable engineer that came in the industrial town to do some expert job and young hairdresser in whose house he stayed in and the consequences of that relationship, especially after young driver g...

items.description: In a blackly satirical near future, a thriving industry sells celebrity illnesses to their obsessed fans. Employee Syd March's attempts to exploit the system backfire when they involve him in a potentially deadly mystery.

items.name: Louise Violet
items.description: France. End of the 19th century. Louise Violet, a Parisian teacher, is sent on a mission to the French countryside. She has to impose the free, compulsory and secular school of the Republic.

items.name: Tess
items.description: A strong-willed young peasant girl attracts the affection of two men.

items.name: The Late Show
items.description: A grumpy semi-retired private investigator partners with a quirky female client to catch the people who murdered his partner.

items.name: Jurassic Sharks
items.description: The special takes viewers deep into prehistoric waters to explore the ancient ancestors of today's sharks. Using animation, the episode highlights some of the most feared prehistoric ocean creatures, including the Dunkleosteus, the buzzsaw shark (Helicoprion), and the scissor-toothed shark (Edestus).

items.name: Cruel Story of Youth
items.description: A harsh young man seduces a freeloading young woman and eventually takes advantage of her knack for hitch-hiking to rob middle-class men.

items.name: The Green Dinosaur
items.description: When the world around him is mysteriously erased, a little green dinosaur named Diplodocus must travel through the pages of a comic book and adventure through time to bring color back to his land. Alongside a wizard and two scientists, Diplo’s plans go awry as he learns that there may be a dimension to his world that he never considered.

items.name: The To-Do List
items.description: Feeling pressured to become more sexually experienced before she goes to college, Brandy Klark makes a list of things to accomplish before hitting campus in the fall.

items.name: The Money Pit
items.description: A young couple struggles to repair a hopelessly dilapidated house.

items.name: Wild Sing
items.description: Twenty years after a scandal tears apart a popular 2000s K‑pop trio, the three reunite for a one-off gig — if they can overcome one snag after another.

items.name: Arranged
items.description: ARRANGED centers on the friendship between an Orthodox Jewish woman and a Muslim woman who meet as first-year teachers at a public school in Brooklyn. Over the course of the year they learn they share much in common - not least of...

As a result, they move in with their estranged sister and her husband. Though the two are welcoming, they continue to struggle with anxiety further exacerbated by their parents' rejection. As such, they try to keep a low profile at school. However, after they meet a proudly bisexual classmate, their life begins to look a little more hopeful.

items.name: The Field

items.description: Veterinarian Dr. Carly Monroe (Jen Lilley) falls for Dan Landis (Jason Cermak), the owner of a dog shelter she frequently visits. Unfortunately, Dan is about to marry his glamorous girlfriend and move to New York City.

items.description: China's deadliest special forces operative settles into a quiet life on the sea. When sadistic mercenaries begin targeting nearby civilians, he must leave his newfound peace behind and return to his duties as a soldier and protector.

items.name: Last Summer
items.description: During summer vacation on Fire Island, three young people become very close. When an uncool girl tries to infiltrate the trio's newly found relationship, they construct an elaborate plot that has violent results.

items.description: A worker at a Russian nuclear facility gets exposed to a lethal dose of radiation. In order to provide for his family, he steals some plutonium and sets out to sell it on Moscow's black market with the help of an incompetent crimi...

items.description: An intimate, unconventional portrait of Marc Jacobs, crafted by Sofia Coppola to capture the genius and singular universe of the iconic American designer.

items.name: Robot Chicken: Self-Discovery Special

items.name: Little Accidents
items.description: In a small American town still living in the shadow of a terrible coal mine accident, the disappearance of a teenage boy draws together a surviving miner, the lonely wife of a mine executive, and a local boy in a web of secrets.

items.name: The Thirty Nine Steps
items.description: In March 1914, a mining engineer named Richard Hannay tries to prevent Prussian Agents from executing a political assassination designed to trigger World War I.

items.name: The Tiger's Tail
items.description: After a chance encounter, a wealthy businessman is stalked by an evil doppelganger.

items.name: A Child of My Own
items.description: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.

items.name: Edges of the Lord

items.name: Lantana

items.description: Tanguy is 28 years old and still living with his parents. They think it's time he moves out. He doesn't, so they hatch a plan...

items.description: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences.

items.description: An anthology of bizarre, fantastic and spooky tales from the past, present and future, dealing with curses, witches, perfect crime and science experiments.

items.name: Into the Blue

items.description: Queen Louise's cabinet are worried that she will become an old maid, and are delighted when she marries the rougish Count Renard. Unfortunately, he finds his position as Queen's Consort unsatisfying and without purpose, and the marriage soon runs into difficulties.

items.name: Infiltrate

He plays the role of the perfect Algerian son for his mother Fatima, while hiding his relationship with Léa and his passion for French cuisine and wine, which he pursues as a chef at the bistro where he works. Now Colin has a group of friends and a project: to go on stage to play Cyrano in front of the whole school.

The boy does not know that according to tradition, the sacred bird must be sacrificed for the prosperity of the tribe.

items.name: Private Benjamin
items.description: A sheltered young high-society woman joins the United States Army on a whim and finds herself in a trickier situation than she ever expected.

items.description: Sixteen-year-old Georgia Nolan dreams of being the world's first-ever female firefighter. When a mysterious arsonist starts burning down Broadway, New York's firemen begin vanishing. The Mayor of New York calls Georgia's father Sh...

items.description: A robot girlfriend begins to have murderous impulses when she discovers feelings of love.

The family's delicious food catches the eye of a quick-witted cheetah who will stop at nothing to revive her failing fast-food business.

items.description: Trained assassin Dominique, escaping her troubled past, crash lands her plane in a Colombian town rife with violence. Sheltered by a family, she faces attacks from police and must choose between self-preservation or defending her ...

His AA sponsor offers him refuge at his farm where Matt finds Yup'ik, a stray husky with a unique talent. Their relationship struggles at first, but with the help of their Montana community, the two strays find a connection and discover what it takes to pull thru to the finish line.

One day, his boss tells him to take care of a big, white dog, abandoned by its previous owner. Tamio begins to live with the dog, who doesn't bark and only makes a sound that sounds like "haw", and thus he names it Haw. While living together, the connection between the two deepens.

It seems to Almar that real time has also stopped when his watch did.

He impulsively steals one million euros from the company’s vault, tosses away the key to the safe and hastily flees with his fiancée Marine… Before discovering that his termination was a mistake, and he is actually being promoted! Stan has until sunrise to return the money to the vault. But having thrown away his key, and with the only spare inside the CEO’s own apartment, he must reluctantly enlist the help of Hippolyte, Paris’s most unpredictable locksmith. The night promises to be full of twists and turns!

items.description: Quique, Clara and little Lucas are vacationing in northern India. One night, sleeping outside during a storm, they are brutally attacked. Hours later, Quique is rescued by a native and taken to a remote isolated village in the mou...
