items.name: The Con Artist
items.description: An ex-con finds his plan to go straight foiled by a loan shark who manipulates his target into taking on one last heist.

items.name: A Little Daytime Drama
items.description: In order to save her daytime soap drama from cancellation, head writer Maggie must convince Darin (her real-life ex-boyfriend) to return to the show.

items.name: Sisters & Brothers
items.description: An ensemble comedy about the love and dysfunction shared among four sets of siblings.

items.name: Without Men
items.description: The women of a remote Latin American town are forced to pick up the pieces and remake their world when all the town's men are forcibly recruited by communist guerrillas.

items.name: Ghost Train
items.description: Da-kyung, a horror YouTuber desperate for views, uploads a video about the eerie urban legends surrounding Gwanglim Station—the site of the highest number of missing person cases in the country. The video goes viral overnight. Despite everyone's warnings, Da-kyung's thirst for views only grows stronger. But as she digs deeper, she uncovers a shocking secret behind the station…

items.name: Where the Wind Comes From
items.description: Alyssa, a rebellious 19 year-old girl, and her friend Mehdi — a shy and introverted 23-year-old young man — who use their imagination to escape their unpromising reality.  When they discover a contest in the south of Tunisia that may allow them to flee for real, they decide to undertake the road trip regardless of the obstacles in their way.

items.name: Girl on the Bridge
items.description: One night, a fading entertainer intervenes when a woman contemplates suicide, beginning a strange, unpredictable relationship.

items.name: The Chosen
items.description: In 1944, in Brooklyn, two Jewish kids become friends. One is from a very conservative family, and the other is more liberal. The issues of importance of tradition, parental expectations and the formation of Israel cause constant f...

items.name: Disco Pigs
items.description: Pig and Runt - born on the same day, in the same hospital, moments apart. Twins, all but by blood.

items.name: Clean, Shaven
items.description: After a man suffering from schizophrenia is released from a mental institution, he attempts to get his daughter back from her adoptive family.

items.name: Cigarettes et chocolat chaud
items.description: A single father struggles with the education of his two daughters and his two jobs until he's forced by a social investigator to attend parenting classes.

items.name: Pledge This!
items.description: At South Beach University, a beautiful sorority president takes in a group of unconventional freshman girls seeking acceptance into her house.

items.name: Little Girl
items.description: The touching portrait of eight-year-old Sasha, who questions her gender and in doing so, evokes the sometimes disturbing reactions of a society that is still invested in a biological boy-girl way of thinking.

items.name: The Final Run
items.description: Pierce Butler, a former Marine and long-retired marijuana smuggler, whose wife is suffering from a rare type of cancer, must return to his drug-running ways and make one Final Load in order to save his house, his company, and his wife.

items.name: The Train Robbers
items.description: A gunhand named Lane is hired by a widow, Mrs. Lowe, to find gold stolen by her husband so that she may return it and start fresh.

items.name: The Good Neighbor
items.description: A pair of mischievous high school kids create the illusion of a haunting on an unsuspecting elderly neighbor while keeping his every reaction under surveillance. A series of coincidences leads to tragedy.

items.name: The Snow Wolf: A Winter's Tale
items.description: A dramatized tale of how wolves recovered in Europe after almost going extinct.

items.name: Office Christmas Party
items.description: When his uptight CEO sister threatens to shut down his branch, the branch manager throws an epic Christmas party in order to land a big client and save the day, but the party gets way out of hand...

items.name: Revenge of the Ninja
items.description: After ninjas killed his family, Cho and his son Kane come to America to start a new life. He opens a doll shop but is unwittingly importing heroin in the dolls. When his friend betrays him, Cho must prepare for the ultimate battle.

items.name: Dark Breed
items.description: Captain Saxon, an agent for the top secret Omega agency, has been given the assignment of tracking down and either capturing or killing the crew members of a secret space mission who returned to Earth against orders. It seems that they were all infected with an alien parasite, and they were trying to bring its eggs back to Earth. The eggs were lost in an accident, and both Saxon and the astronauts are trying to locate them.

items.name: Ball of Fire
items.description: A group of professors working on a new encyclopedia while residing in a Manhattan mansion take in a sassy nightclub singer who the police need to help them bring down her mob-boss lover.

items.name: Junk World
items.description: 1,042 years before JUNK HEAD, a robot named Robin escorts a human commander on a mission to the underground city of Carp Bar.

items.name: The Drift
items.description: A survival drama about an ice skater stranded on an ice floe at the Arctic Sea. When the ice floe starts to float towards south and melt, the ice skater must use all means necessary to survive.

items.name: Police Academy 5: Assignment: Miami Beach
items.description: Eric Lassard is about to retire, which Harris plans to exploit to take over his position. In Miami, where Lassard is to be honored, a mix-up leads to an adventure involving diamonds, kidnapping and betrayal.

items.name: Leave One Day
items.description: Cécile is about to open her own gourmet restaurant, finally making her dream come true, when suddenly her father has a heart attack and she is called back to the village where she was born. Far from the hubbub of Paris life, she runs into her teenage crush. The memories come flooding back, destabilizing her certainties.

items.name: Buying Time
items.description: It is the year 2028 and antibiotics are no longer effective. A corporation called Lifeline has invented a health chip which everyone can get for free via the NHS.  You can buy an upgrade which is effective against more infections and diseases. In 2028 computing and processing power is restricted however for someone to have an upgrade some one has to die for the power to be transferred. People are dieing randomly. Lifeline are launching their 2nd upgrade which is expected to earn them billions along with their ministerial backer.  Daniel Avery has lost his wife and daughter in such circumstances and recent nightmares and flashbacks have instigated him to investigate.  He slowly uncovers the truth with the help of a rebel group of the pull for power and greed that goes right to the top.

items.name: On Wings of Eagles
items.description: Eric Liddell - China's first gold medalist and one of Scotland's greatest athletes - returns to war-torn China.

items.name: Mona Lisa
items.description: A man recently released from prison manages to get a job driving a call girl from customer to customer.

items.name: Leatherface
items.description: A teenage Leatherface escapes from a mental hospital with three other inmates, kidnapping a young nurse and taking her on a road trip from hell, while being pursued by a lawman out for revenge.

items.name: Doomsday
items.description: A futuristic action thriller where a team of people work to prevent a disaster threatening the future of the human race.

items.name: Raising Flagg
items.description: A comedy centered on a handyman (Arkin) and his lifelong competition with his neighbor (Pendleton.)

items.name: Turtles All the Way Down
items.description: A teenager with OCD tries to solve a mystery surrounding a fugitive billionaire.

items.name: Don't Breathe 2
items.description: A blind war veteran trains his adopted daughter to face any danger, but they are ambushed when a vengeful stranger emerges from the past.

items.name: Ginger Snaps II: Unleashed
items.description: Ginger's sister Brigitte, now a werewolf herself, must try to find a cure for her blood lust before the next full moon while hiding out in a rehab clinic from a relentless werewolf.

items.name: Ride Along 2
items.description: As his wedding day approaches, Ben heads to Miami with his soon-to-be brother-in-law James to bring down a drug dealer who's supplying the dealers of Atlanta with product.

items.name: Silver Star
items.description: When Billie learns that her estranged parents' lives are at risk, she tries to help them by robbing a bank. In her botched robbery attempt, she takes a hostage named Franny, who turns out to be a charmingly impulsive pregnant teenager with nothing left to lose. Together, Billie and Franny embark on a chase through scenic American landscapes, clashing and struggling for common ground in hopes for a brighter future.

items.name: Flatwoods
items.description: A documentary filmmaker uncovers an alien conspiracy in Flatwoods, West Virginia.

items.name: 10 to Midnight
items.description: A veteran LA detective becomes personally entangled in a serial killer case when the nude, knife-wielding suspect targets his daughter, forcing him to choose between the law and fatherly protection.

items.name: Robot Girls
items.description: When a robot girl companion fails to listen to its developer, the developer uses an advanced model to train the robot girl. But when the training turns deadly, the developer finds himself in trouble.

items.name: High School High
items.description: Richard Clark has just left the well-known Wellington Academy to teach at Marion Barry High School. Now, he will try to inspire the D-average students into making good grades and try to woo a fellow teacher.

items.name: The A List: 15 Stories from Asian and Pacific Diasporas
items.description: Sandra Oh, Sen. Tammy Duckworth, Kumail Nanjiani, Amanda Nguyen, Connie Chung, and beyond: their worlds may be disparate, but they’ve all, in their unique ways, navigated what it means to be Asian in relation to their American identities. While their success has been fraught with racism, they share their stories of losses and wins.

items.name: Game Over, Man!
items.description: Three friends are on the verge of getting their video game financed when their benefactor is taken hostage by terrorists.

items.name: Iron Man: Rise of Technovore
items.description: Iron Man is framed by a technological terrorist and breaks out to clear his name.

items.name: The Good Neighbor
items.description: The budding friendship between two very different neighbours takes a tragic turn when David runs over a young woman and causes her death.

items.name: Cinderella's Curse
items.description: Based on the same folktale that Disney updated and popularized for children, back in the 1950s.

items.name: Timerider: The Adventure of Lyle Swann
items.description: A maverick motorbike racer wanders into a top-secret time-travel research test site which unintentionally teleports him to the mid-1800s and ends up having to fight violent outlaws for his survival.

items.name: The Stalking Moon
items.description: U.S. Army soldiers round up a group of Apache, mostly women and children. Surprisingly, they find among them a white woman and her half-Apache son.

items.name: Pets on a Train
items.description: When a train unexpectedly starts up, taking only pets with it, the animals discover that Hans, a badger with a grudge is behind it all. While the crash seems inevitable, the animals can count on Falcon, a roguish Raccoon who will do anything to save them.

items.name: Super Charlie
items.description: Wille has always dreamed of becoming a superhero and fight crime alongside his father. This dream is shattered when Wille's brother, Charlie, is born. Charlie gets all the attention, and on top of that – he has superpowers. When a supervillain and an evil scientist enact a plan to overthrow the city, Wille and Charlie must put their differences aside and work together as a team. Can an infant and his envious brother save the city?

items.name: Waterloo
items.description: Facing the decline of everything he has worked to obtain, conqueror Napoleon Bonaparte and his army confront the British at the Battle of Waterloo.

items.name: Legend of the Boneknapper Dragon
items.description: Hiccup and the gang join Gobber on a quest to find a legendary boneclad Dragon.

items.name: Laboratory Conditions
items.description: A physician investigating a missing body disrupts an unlawful experiment.

items.name: Prodigies
items.description: Claire and Jeanne are twin sisters, united by the same passion: the piano. Coached by their father like athletes, they join the prestigious Karlsruhe Conservatory. They are now competing to be soloists and training for a concert that will make or break their careers. But Claire and then Jeanne discover they are suffering from a serious illness and are slowly losing the use of their hands. With the support of their family and their undying love of music, they will find a unique way to change their fate. An inspiring and moving tale, based on a true story.

items.name: Warhorse One
items.description: A gunned down Navy SEAL Master Chief must guide a child to safety through a gauntlet of hostile Taliban insurgents and survive the brutal Afghanistan wilderness.

items.name: Tabby McTat
items.description: Set in London's streets, follows a musical cat and Fred, a gifted busker, and their warm, amazing friendship.

items.name: Convict 13
items.description: Buster is playing golf with Sybil when he gets knocked out. An escaped prisoner changes clothes with him. Buster goes to prison and learns that he is to be hanged. He changes clothes with a guard just as prisoner Roberts attacks all the guards.

items.name: The Flintstones: Fred's Final Fling
items.description: Due to a mix-up at the doctor's office, Fred believes he has only 24 hours left to live.

items.name: Clouds
items.description: A single father's optimism is tested when he faces an unfortunate turn of events.

items.name: Touch Me
items.description: Two codependent best friends become addicted to the heroin-like touch of an alien narcissist who may or may not be trying to take over the world.

items.name: The Boat
items.description: Buster's handmade boat, The Damfino, is finished and is, of course, too large to get through the basement door. When he drives off with it in tow, the side of his house, then the whole thing, collapses. At the harbor he rides the boat out only to have it sink beneath him. The rest is a series of adventures he and his family have with the restored boat.

items.name: The Haunted House
items.description: Buster is a bank clerk. Overturned glue gets everything, mostly the money, stuck to everything else. When robbers show up he can't "stick 'em up" because his hands are stuck in his pockets. The robbers' hideout is a haunted house designed to scare off police.

items.name: Neighbors
items.description: The Romeo and Juliet story played out in a tenement neighborhood with Buster and Virginia's families hating each other over the fence separating their buildings.

items.name: Smugglers' Songs
items.description: Early on in this engaging historical drama, a marquis (played by the singularly droll Jacques Nolot) offers a peddler a carriage ride on a remote country road. After sizing up his benefactor, the peddler fights motion sickness to deliver his sales pitch: “I have here a few objects of wonder, pious images, pamphlets against men of the cloth, newspapers from Amsterdam and London, holy cards, quills, writing paper…”

items.name: Hard Luck
items.description: Out of work, Buster tries various ways to commit suicide. At last he tries "poison" from a bottle containing booze. The president of a sporting club speaks of the need for a sportsman to promote the club and drunken Buster gets the job for which he must learn fishing, hunting and riding.

items.name: My Wife's Relations
items.description: When a large Irish woman falsely accuses Buster of breaking a window he is hauled before a Polish judge who speaks no English and assumes they are there to be married. She takes her new husband home to meet her four gorilla-like brothers.

items.name: The Goat
items.description: Buster is inadvertently identified as the notorious outlaw Dead Shot Dan. He is pursued throughout the city by the local police chief, using disguises and quick-thinking to elude the lawman. He encounters Virginia, a young lady friend, and goes to her home to visit and hide out, only to discover that Virginia's father is the police chief.

items.name: The 'High Sign'
items.description: Buster is thrown off a train near an amusement park. There he gets a job in a shooting gallery run by the Blinking Buzzards mob. Ordered to kill a businessman, he winds up protecting the man and his daughter by outfitting their home with trick devices.

items.name: The Flintstones: Wind-Up Wilma
items.description: Wilma is a celebrity when she gets a shot at the big leagues and becomes a pitcher for the Bedrock Dodgers after nailing a couple of robbers with a melon at the grocery store; however, she and Fred argue over her ambition to pitch for the team because Fred thinks a woman's place is in the home.

items.name: Braddock: Missing in Action III
items.description: Braddock mounts a one-man assault to free his wife and son who are still being held in a Vietnam prison camp.

items.name: Shaman
items.description: A Missionary converting an Indigenous Community in a remote Ecuadorian volcano must come to terms with her own Faith when her son is possessed by dark forces.

items.name: A Man Is Dead
items.description: Pushed to the edge, a reclusive man takes vengeance on those that wronged him.

items.name: Riverdance 25th Anniversary Show
items.description: A powerful and stirring reinvention of the show, celebrated the world over for its Grammy Award-winning music and the thrilling energy and passion of its Irish and international dance.

items.name: The Living Desert
items.description: Although first glance reveals little more than stones and sand, the desert is alive. Witness moving rocks, spitting mud pots, gorgeous flowers and the never-ending battle for survival between creatures of every shape, size and des...

items.name: King Creole
items.description: A troubled youth's singing sets New Orleans rockin'. With a sweet girl to love him and nightclubbers cheering, it seems he will shake off his past and head for the top. But will a mobster and his man-trap moll snare him in a life ...

items.name: 3 Generations
items.description: After Ray decides to transition from female to male, Ray's mother Maggie must come to terms with the decision while tracking down Ray's biological father to get his legal consent.

items.name: Manderlay
items.description: A story of slavery, set in the southern U.S. in the 1930s.

items.name: Cruel Intentions 3
items.description: Two guys at a college prep school make wagers on seducing naive young girls, and then meet their match when they agree to see which one can seduce the most popular and devious girl who has her own agenda to everything.

items.name: Cruel Intentions 2
items.description: Takes place before Cruel Intentions (1999), when Kathryn first meets Sebastian. Explores their sexual attraction to each other and their enjoyment in destroying the lives of their peers.

items.name: Captain Nemo and the Underwater City
items.description: When Captain Nemo saves the passengers of a sinking ship and takes them to his Utopian underwater city he discovers that not all of his guests agree to remain there forever.

items.name: Monkey Kingdom
items.description: Life is an adventure for a young monkey and her son, living among ancient ruins in the jungle. But when her family is forced from their home, she must lead them to safety amidst strange new creatures and surroundings.

items.name: The Big Mouth
items.description: On a San Diego beach, Gerald Clamson fishes out of the water a look-alike frog man who gives him a map to a stash of stolen-diamonds coveted by several crime syndicates.

items.name: Armand
items.description: Armand, a 6-year-old boy, is accused of crossing boundaries against his best friend at elementary school. While no one knows what actually happened between the two boys, the incident triggers a series of events, forcing parents and school staff into a captivating battle of redemption where madness, desire and obsession arise.

items.name: Real Men
items.description: A womanizing CIA agent and an insecure insurance agent are paired together to make sure a deal goes through with aliens for the future of mankind.

items.name: My Favorite Wedding
items.description: Tess is paired with the best man in her best friend's wedding to save it from disaster. But by the time the couple say "I do," Tess realizes that her own longtime boyfriend may not be the right guy for her "to have and to hold" af...

items.name: Guarding Tess
items.description: A former U.S. First Lady wants a particular Secret Service agent to head her bodyguard detail, even though he can't stand her.

items.name: GARY
items.description: Documentary of the music of outsider artist Gary R Forney. Interviews with the artist as well as his other musicians and producers. An inspiring story of never giving up your dream..

items.name: Scared Shitless
items.description: A plumber and his germophobic son are forced to get their hands dirty to save the residents of an apartment building, when a genetically engineered, blood-thirsty creature escapes into the plumbing system.

items.name: Wisdom of Happiness
items.description: A deeply intimate and highly cinematic documentary featuring the Dalai Lama, who, at nearly ninety year of age, offers practical advice for navigating the 21st century's challenges.

items.name: My Dearest Señorita
items.description: A young woman's medical discovery challenges everything she knows about herself, leading her on an unexpected path toward self-acceptance and a love that defies convention.

items.name: V: The Final Battle
items.description: A small group of human resistance fighters fight a desperate guerilla war against the genocidal extra-terrestrials who dominate Earth.

items.name: Accident
items.description: A beautiful Austrian coed attending Oxford University is betrothed to a fellow student, but she ends up getting involved with two unhappily married professors instead.

items.name: Kryptic
items.description: A woman searches for a missing monster hunter, realizing she has an inextricable bond with the creature being pursued.

items.name: Downhill
items.description: Bound by honor, a successful schoolboy takes the blame for his roommate's indiscretion, and it's all downhill from there.

items.name: The Inspector General
items.description: A town's corrupt officials think a fool is actually an investigator in disguise.

items.name: Naples to New York
items.description: Follows two Neapolitan kids as they journey to New York to escape Italy's early postwar poverty.

items.name: Uncommon Valor
items.description: Ten years after his son went M.I.A. in Vietnam, U.S. Marine retired Colonel Jason Rhodes assembles a private rescue team to find Americans held in P.O.W. camps in Laos.

items.name: Stone Cold
items.description: A tough Alabama cop is blackmailed by the FBI into going undercover in a violent Mississippi biker gang.

items.name: The Other Sister
items.description: A mentally challenged young woman seeks independence by obtaining her own apartment and attending college while her family plans her sister's wedding.

items.name: The Seventh Sign
items.description: Abby Quinn is eagerly awaiting childbirth but is haunted by dreams in which she miscarries. When she decides to rent a room to a mysterious stranger, she releases a chain of events that will unleash the end of humanity.

items.name: The Valiant Ones
items.description: The emperor dispatches an officer and a small band of men to deal with pirates.

items.name: Friendly Persuasion
items.description: The pacifist attitude of a Quaker family is tested as a result of the American Civil War.

items.name: The Whistler
items.description: Reeling from their daughter's loss, Nicole and Sebastian come into possession of a secluded Venezuelan farm, unaware of the dark forces they're about to face.

items.name: Garfield: His 9 Lives
items.description: Garfield plays multiple roles including ancient Egyptian royalty, a fairyland kitten, a movie "stunt cat" and more!

items.name: Main Hoon Na
items.description: An army major goes undercover as a college student. His mission is both professional and personal: to protect his general's daughter from a radical militant, and to find his estranged half-brother.

items.name: The Art of War III: Retribution
items.description: A Secret Agent must prevent North Korean terrorist from acquiring a nuclear device.

items.name: Ramy Youssef: In Love
items.description: In his third HBO special, Ramy Youssef approaches a vast spectrum of personal topics, including marriage, AI, and being a dog parent.

items.name: The Cat and the Canary
items.description: Relatives of an eccentric millionaire gather in his spooky mansion on the 20th anniversary of his death for the reading of his will.

items.name: Damaged
items.description: Chicago detective Dan Lawson travels to Scotland to link up with Scottish detective Glen Boyd following the resurgence of a serial killer whose crimes match an unsolved case he investigated 5 years previously.

items.name: Don't Give Up the Ship
items.description: The Navy expects a veteran to pay for the ship he commanded, as they have no record of its return.

items.name: The Face of Love
items.description: A widow falls for a guy who bears a striking resemblance to her late husband.

items.name: Tropicana
items.description: A lonely middle-aged woman divides her time between her monotonous job at the supermarket and taking care of her disabled mother and estranged family members. The mysterious murder of the head cashier at the supermarket, sends her on a journey into the depths of her repressed desire revealing her deep longing for warmth and human connection.

items.name: Kangaroo
items.description: Ex TV personality, Chris Masterman, becomes stranded in an Outback town outside Alice Springs. There, he teams up with 12-year-old Indigenous girl Charlie. The pair form an unlikely friendship and work together to rescue and rehabilitate orphaned joeys in the remote but stunning Outback community—an endeavour that proves to be life-changing for them both.

items.name: Save Me
items.description: An accountant beleaguered by personal and professional problems gets involved with a femme fatale and her mysterious psychiatrist.

items.name: Penny Serenade
items.description: A couple's big dreams give way to a life full of unforeseen sadness and unexpected joy.

items.name: Burner
items.description: Ex-con single mom Kiki rebuilds her life and regains custody of her teen daughter, until her violent drug-dealer ex returns. To protect herself and her daughter, she must eliminate him without getting caught.

items.name: The Last Shift
items.description: Stanley's last shift at his fast food job takes an unexpected turn when he befriends a young African-American work employee.

items.name: Tarzan and His Mate
items.description: The idyllic life of Tarzan and Jane is challenged by men on safari who come seeking ivory, and come seeking Jane as well.

items.name: The Chase
items.description: The citizens of a small Texas town become worried and panicked when a local bad boy escapes prison and heads for his hometown.

items.name: Ballistic
items.description: A mother who works for an ammunition manufacturing company finds out she made the bullet that killed her son.

items.name: Last Ride
items.description: In the winter of 1982, three American boys find themselves stranded in a cable car with a dead body, suspended midair in the mountains of Norway during a rare celestial event.

items.name: Boa vs. Python
items.description: After a genetically-altered python escapes, a scientist is enlisted to help kill it by releasing a giant boa constrictor that he owns.

items.name: The Flamenco Guitar of Yerai Cortés
items.description: A thoughtful exploration of gypsy culture, an intimate portrait of flamenco guitar player Yerai Cortés and a healing family exorcism through music. Antón Álvarez (aka C. Tangana) makes his filmmaking debut with this documentary.

items.name: Predator: Wastelands
items.description: When an alien hunter arrives on Earth, it takes down a gang of warlords and unexpectedly becomes a folk hero to the oppressed locals. Now, with their support, the alien sets its sights on the warlords' ruthless leader.

items.name: Ride On
items.description: A washed-up stuntman and his stunt horse become an overnight social media sensation when their real-life fight with debt collectors goes viral.

items.name: Sniper
items.description: A veteran US Marine sniper is partnered with a rookie sniper as his spotter to take out a politician and a rebel leader in the jungles of Panama.

items.name: Untold: The Shooting at Hawthorne Hill
items.description: A retired Olympic equestrian takes on a new dressage student at his idyllic farm in New Jersey. Over time, tensions mount between the two, leading to 911 calls, cryptic social media posts, and accusations of spying. The feud culminates in a shocking act of violence and a trial that rocked the prestigious and sophisticated world of dressage.

items.name: Bagman
items.description: When a sinister threat from his childhood returns to haunt him, a father desperately struggles against his deepest inner fear. Only this time, the fight isn't for himself; it's for his family.

items.name: The Kid
items.description: The story of a young boy who witnesses Billy the Kid's encounter with Sheriff Pat Garrett.

items.name: Buffaloed
items.description: In the underworld of debt-collecting, homegrown hustler Peg Dahl will do anything to escape Buffalo, NY.

items.name: Justicia artificial
items.description: A judge evaluating AI court software discovers murder and conspiracy when the creator dies. She must confront powerful state interests while her life hangs in balance. A thriller on AI's role in justice.

items.name: Trouble in Paradise
items.description: A gentleman thief and a lady pickpocket join forces to con the owner of a perfume manufacturer, but romantic entanglements and jealousies confuse the scheme.

items.name: Song Without Words
items.description: A street performer who never says a word begins to change lives with his very special act in this tale exploring what it means to be human.

items.name: Once Upon a Time in China
items.description: Legendary martial arts hero Wong Fei-Hung fights against foreign forces' plundering of China. When Aunt Yee arrives back from America, Wong Fei-Hung assumes the role of her protector.

items.name: Sniper 2
items.description: Sgt. Beckett's last mission sends him to a remote war-torn wasteland between Eastern Europe and Asia to assassinate a repressive terrorist leader. Once the job is done, Beckett and his spotter find escaping more difficult than anticipated.

items.name: Year of the Dog
items.description: A secretary's life changes in unexpected ways after her dog dies.

items.name: Pinocchio
items.description: Despite guidance from the Blue Fairy and the love of his father, a wooden puppet's curious spirit leads him into one wild adventure after another.

items.name: Enter the Phoenix
items.description: Hong Kong’s top triad leader Hung appoints his gay son Georgie to be his successor before he dies. But Hung’s loyal right-hand man Cheung mistakes his roommate Sam as Georgie instead.

items.name: Adventures in Zambezia
items.description: A young high-spirited falcon journeys to the famed bird city of Zambezia.

items.name: Once Upon a Time in China V
items.description: Brand new epic adventure set during a tumultuous time in China, when left without a leader, the cavalry is attacked by the powerful allies and pirate bands. A martial arts master, Wong Fei-Hong and Aunt Yee return to do battle aga...

items.name: Goebbels and the Führer
items.description: Nazi propaganda minister Joseph Goebbels is in charge of building public support for the Holocaust and for the war that Hitler is about to start.

items.name: Bernard: Mission Mars
items.description: In order to regain recognition, the most unlucky agent, Backkom Bear, sneaked into the Mars mission, but unexpectedly broke into the mysterious world of Mars and became friends with the Martian monster he wanted to capture. Between the honor of an agent and friendship, he will face an unprecedented test.

items.name: Finding Harry: The Craft Behind the Magic
items.description: An inside look at the epic scale and meticulous care behind Harry Potter (2026).

items.name: Testimony of the Witness
items.description: A groom desperate to fix his performance problem just days before his wedding.

items.name: Sicilian Letters
items.description: A time during Cosa Nostra boss Matteo Messina Denaro's three decades as a fugitive from Italian justice, when he was at the peak of his nefarious powers.

items.name: Legend No. 17
items.description: Biopic of Russian ice hockey legend Valeri Kharlamov from early childhood, rising to the pinnacle of the sport and his untimely death.

items.name: The Ghost and Mrs. Muir
items.description: In 1900, a young widow finds her seaside cottage is haunted and forms a unique relationship with the ghost.

items.name: American Hangman
items.description: 2 men are chained up in a basement. The captor has cameras aimed at them and is streaming it on the internet - turning it into a "trial" on the held, retired judge's last court case. The viewers become the jurors.

items.name: Cutterhead
items.description: Rie visits a tunnel-boring machine being used to construct the Copenhagen Metro. When an accident occurs, she must survive the claustrophobic conditions of an airlock with Ivo and Bharan whilst reconsidering their lives.

items.name: Black's Game
items.description: After being reacquainted with a childhood friend Stebbi joins the drug trade world in order to pay off his debt. Inspired by actual events.

items.name: Music Box
items.description: A lawyer defends her father accused of war crimes, but there is more to the case than she suspects.

items.name: Untold: Jail Blazers
items.description: Volatile players. Criminal charges. National headlines. Portland's championship-caliber NBA team implodes spectacularly in this unflinching documentary.

items.name: Extraction
items.description: A US Black Ops team is sent to a Chechen underground prison to get 'the brain of terrorism' for intel. It doesn't go as planned.

items.name: Grand Prix of Europe
items.description: Edda, a young mouse with big dreams, seizes her chance to race in the Grand Prix disguised as her hero, Ed. She rises to the challenge of outwitting her rival's sabotage and proving that even the smallest racer can make the bigges...

items.name: No One Knows About Persian Cats
items.description: Iranian musicians Negar and Ashkan look for band members to play at a London concert - and the visas that allow them to leave Tehran to do so.

items.name: Keane
items.description: A disheveled man desperately searches New York City for his young daughter.

items.name: The More the Merrier
items.description: During the World War II housing shortage in Washington, two men and a woman share a single apartment and the older man plays Cupid to the other two.

items.name: Chrysalis
items.description: In the near future Paris, a cop is searching for his wife's killer. The trail leads him to a high tech medical clinic where everything is not what it seems.

items.name: Kill Them All and Come Back Alone
items.description: A mercenary and his five-man team of oddball cutthroats are tasked by a treacherous Confederate spy with infiltrating a Union Army fortress and stealing $1 million in gold.

items.name: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
items.description: Burt and Travis battle ass-blasters and graboids in South Africa.

items.name: Sniper 3
items.description: Deadly sniper Tom Beckett is recruited by the CIA to go to Ho Chi Minh City and take out a ruthless drug dealer who turns out to be an old war buddy he thought was dead.

items.name: The Missionary
items.description: In the early 20th century, devout Reverend Charles Fortescue returns to England from his missionary work in Africa and, despite plans to marry his childhood sweetheart, receives a most unusual assignment: minister to the local pro...

items.name: Zu Warriors
items.description: Between the heaven and the Earth exist the Zu's mountain range, where live the immortals of Omei, the highest mountain of Zu, but the kingdom is in danger by Amnesia, a renegade immortal what want to rule Zu and all the world. Whi...

items.name: Boonie Bears: Blast Into the Past
items.description: Boonie bears and bareheaded Qiang blast into primitive times and experience a period of exciting and breathtaking time in a primitive tribe.

items.name: Other
items.description: Alice returns to her childhood home after her mother's death, only to find the house is rigged with surveillance tracking her every move, as a sinister presence lurks, driving her towards a terrifying revelation.

items.name: Refuge
items.description: Four estranged friends reunite on a fishing trip to mend their fractured bonds, only to be torn apart when one, a desperate father, accuses one of them of being connected to his daughter's disappearance.

items.name: The Trench
items.description: June 1916. The British Army is planning a big offensive in the Somme region in France. We follow a platoon of British soldiers as they sit in a forward trench, anxiously awaiting the order to go over the top.

items.name: Under Fire
items.description: At a Mexican border drug deal, dealers Griff and Abbott meet for an exchange. Both unexpectedly flash badges - Griff's FBI, Abbott's DEA - revealing they're unknowingly working the same case.

items.name: Lift Me Up
items.description: A young lady, who recently lost her mother, faces the challenges of high school and her very strict step-father. Through personal growth, and an amazing dedication to dance, she learns to find the peace and happiness of family.

items.name: Lazarus: The Awakening
items.description: A vigilante resurrected from death hunts a drug empire in Jackson, clashing with a kingpin, a reporter, and a city consumed by fentanyl. Justice becomes war.

items.name: The Thieving Magpie
items.description: Maria, who's not as young as she used to be and who helps people older than her, is living from hand to mouth. She can't quite accept her precarious situation and steals a few euros here and there from all those lovely people she looks after with such devotion, and who adore her for it… But after an accusation of abuse of a vulnerable person, Maria winds up in police custody.

items.name: Michael Moore in TrumpLand
items.description: In the weeks before the 2016 general election, Oscar-winning filmmaker Michael Moore performs a pro-Hillary Clinton stand-up show deep in the heart of TrumpLand.

items.name: Bang Bang
items.description: Follows 'Bang Bang' Rozyski, an eccentric retired pugilist obsessed with rectifying the sins of his past.

items.name: The Mortuary Assistant
items.description: Follows Rebecca Owens, a mortuary science graduate who takes a night job at River Fields Mortuary. What begins as a routine job soon turns sinister as she faces terrifying supernatural forces.

items.name: The Flock
items.description: A hyper-vigilant employee of the department of public safety, while training his young female replacement, has to track down a missing girl who he is convinced is connected to a paroled sex offender he is investigating.

items.name: Don't Log Off
items.description: When Sam vanishes mid-video call, her friends race to uncover what happened. As they dig online, they vanish one by one. A sinister force is at play - can they solve the mystery before they're next?

items.name: Dogs of War
items.description: The untold true story of how Dave Tomkins, originally a safe-cracker from London, rose from small-time criminal to international mercenary and arms dealer, enabling death and destruction around the world.

items.name: My Father's Secrets
items.description: Brussels, Belgium, 1959. Michel and Charly Kichka, two Jewish brothers, enjoy a happy childhood with their parents and their two sisters. Henri, their discreet and usually silent father, does not speak at all about his past, so they imagine that as a young man he was an adventurer, a pirate or a treasure hunter.

items.name: 100 Yards
items.description: Follows two bitter rivals as they duel for stewardship of a wushu academy.

items.name: The Red Line
items.description: Three women fall prey to a ruthless phone scam. To settle the score, they'll take on the criminal network that stole their money and their dignity.

items.name: Midnight Movie
items.description: A midnight showing of an early 1970's horror movie turns to chaos when the Killer from the movie comes out of the film to attack those in the theater.

items.name: Blank
items.description: A desperate writer signs up for a fully A.I. operated retreat to cure her writer's block, but when an unforeseen software glitch occurs, she gets trapped inside her unit with an unstable android and no communication with the outsi...

items.name: The Protector
items.description: With the region's last source of freshwater buried under a Native American reservation and evil forces angling for control, a convict fighting for her freedom becomes the unlikely protector of a young boy who may have the power to save it

items.name: Hitpig!
items.description: A bounty hunter pig finds himself trekking the globe with a free-spirited elephant he intended to capture.

items.name: A Hundred Flowers
items.description: Diagnosed with dementia, Yuriko's mind quickly begins to fade. Yet, for her son Izumi, memories of the mother feel as vivid as when he lived them. One in particular, when he believed she had disappeared, haunts him terribly.

items.name: The Accidental Spy
items.description: At a Hong Kong shopping center, Buck Yuen's (Jackie Chan's) intuition warns him. He saves a robbery's loot and gets on television, ends up in Istanbul via South Korea, and accidentally becomes a spy. Fortunately, he knows Kung Fu.

items.name: Mission to Mars
items.description: When the first manned mission to Mars meets with a catastrophic and mysterious disaster after reporting an unidentified structure, a rescue mission is launched to investigate the tragedy and bring back any survivors.

items.name: Boxcar Bertha
items.description: During the Great Depression, a union leader and a young woman become criminals to exact revenge on the management of a railroad.

items.name: Ghost Tropic
items.description: After a long day at work, Khadija falls asleep on the last subway train. When she wakes up at the end of the line, she has no choice but to make her way home on foot.

items.name: Zombie Strippers!
items.description: A zombie epidemic spreads throughout a strip club in Nebraska.

items.name: Zombies 2
items.description: The return of the werewolves on their hunt for the great alpha makes life more difficult for Zed and the zombies during Zed's run for school president as clues point to Addison being the alpha.

items.name: A Force of One
items.description: When the detectives of an undercover police unit are being mysteriously killed by a martial artist, a professional kickboxer is hired to assist them.

items.name: Dark Feed
items.description: A film crew moves into an abandoned psychiatric hospital with a shadowy past to shoot a low budget horror movie.

items.name: The Bone Snatcher
items.description: After miners disappear in the Namib Desert, scientists find their remains and seek to find what killed them.

items.name: Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom
items.description: This documentary traces the life of Lamar Odom, from his rise to NBA fame and marriage to Khloé Kardashian to his near-fatal overdose in a Nevada brothel.

items.name: Mom and Other Loonies in the Family
items.description: The movie presents the stories of four generations of women in Hungary through the 20th century. Despite harsh times of war, revolution and poverty, the family is able to mantain their good humor and strength.

items.name: Cirque du Soleil: Varekai
items.description: The Cirque du Soleil creation telling the story of Icarus, whose wings melt when he flies to close to the run, sending him crashing into the volcanic and mysterious world of Varekai.

items.name: Latency
items.description: When Hana, a professional gamer who suffers from acute agoraphobia, receives new equipment that enhances her game, she begins to wonder if it is reading her mind - or controlling it.

items.name: At the Circus
items.description: The Marx Brothers try to help the owner of a circus recover some stolen funds before he finds himself out of a job.

items.name: The Future Awaits
items.description: In July 1942, during the Vel’ d’Hiv’ Roundup of Jewish families in Paris, 13 year old Tauba Birenbaum and her parents, who are Polish Jews, find refuge in a tiny room for the next 765 days. Living conditions are tough and they fear being discovered at any moment. But while her parents sink further into despair, Tauba’s fighting spirit shines through. She finds joy in every little thing, from a piano drawn on the floor, to the views of Paris through an open window. Despite extreme circumstances, she will keep hope until the liberation of Paris, and take back control of her life.

items.name: Trust
items.description: A Hollywood actress hides in a remote cabin after a scandal, only to find herself betrayed and fighting for survival against someone she once trusted.

items.name: The Cure
items.description: An alcoholic checks into a health spa and his antics promptly throw the establishment into chaos.

items.name: The Adventurer
items.description: The Little Tramp escapes from prison; saves a girl and her mother from drowning; and creates havoc at a swank party.

items.name: Instintos
items.description: Maggie is in her final days of pregnancy, when she and her husband Sean are attacked in their isolated home by two people who decide to wait with them until Monday to empty the family's bank accounts.

items.name: The Vanished
items.description: A husband and wife will stop at nothing to find their missing daughter, who disappeared on a family camping trip. When the police don't have any leads, the duo takes over.

items.name: Lord of the Flies
items.description: Stranded on an island, a group of schoolboys degenerate into savagery.

items.name: Riot
items.description: Cop Jack Stone robs a Russian mob bank to end in the same prison as the mob boss killing Jack's wife. An inmate helps him as does a reporter. Lots of fights.

items.name: Lovesick Fool - Love in the Age of Like
items.description: The adventures of a single guy in L.A. in search of true love.

items.name: Kaddish
items.description: From an early age Yossi Klein received a special education. He was prepared for another Holocaust. So were other children in Boro Park, the largest Orthodox survivor community in America, and this candid portrait of a young Jewish activist coming to terms with his father's traumatic history is as bracing as any fiction. Through his writing and activism, Yossi attempts to carry on the legacy of struggle passed on to him. A portrait emerges of a young man whose world view and personal outlook have been principally shaped by an event that took place before he was born.

items.name: When Nietzsche Wept
items.description: Viennese doctor Josef Breuer meets with philosopher Friedrich Nietzsche to help him deal with his despair.

items.name: Riceboy Sleeps
items.description: Set in the 90s, a Korean single mother raises her young son in the suburbs of Canada determined to provide a better life for him than the one she left behind.

items.name: 33 Photos from the Ghetto
items.description: The film traces two families, one of which is Jewish, who preserved the images for decades but hadn’t brought them to light. 80 years after their creation, the son of the photographer finds the forgotten negatives and launches an investigation. With a team of researchers, archivists, and animators who use near-forensic precision to reconstruct locations and contexts, they trace the circumstances of those tragic days and the lives captured in each frame.

items.name: The Prosecutor
items.description: A poor young man is wrongly charged with drug trafficking after being deceived. An ex-prosecutor investigates the case, uncovers a corrupt lawyer team's scheme, and restores justice despite obstruction from evil forces.

items.name: The Pawnshop
items.description: Charlie competes with his fellow shop assistant. He is fired by the pawnbroker and rehired. He nearly destroys everything in the shop and and himself. He helps capture a burglar. He destroys a client's clock while examining it in detail.

items.name: One A.M.
items.description: A drunken homeowner has a difficult time getting about in his home after arriving home late at night.

items.name: The Rink
items.description: After causing restaurant chaos at work, a bumbling waiter tears up the local roller rink with his skating.

items.name: You Lucky Dog
items.description: Jim Rayborn has for years been doing most of the work of his grim father Clay's farm, yet couldn't convince the patriarch to switch from cattle to sheep because the warmer climate favors shorter grasses. For Jim's mother's funeral...

items.name: The Immigrant
items.description: Charlie is an immigrant who endures a challenging voyage and gets into trouble as soon as he arrives in America.

items.name: Rabbit-Proof Fence
items.description: Three Aboriginal girls journey 1,200 miles home.

items.name: The Last Manhunt
items.description: Based on true events in the early 1900s Wild West, Willie Boy falls in love with Carlota from the Chemehuevi tribe despite being forbidden to be together. A fatal incident forces the young couple to flee the only place they know a...

items.name: How to Make a Doll
items.description: A nerdy, unlucky professor builds beautiful female robots to satisfy his sexual desires.

items.name: Tim Travers and the Time Traveler's Paradox
items.description: A scientist creates a time machine and kills their younger self to see what would happen. And that self-obsessed, misanthropic, mad genius of a scientist is Tim Travers. And the universe was bad enough with only one of him.

items.name: Night on Earth
items.description: An anthology of 5 different cab drivers in 5 American and European cities and their remarkable fares on the same eventful night.

items.name: Knock Off
items.description: A fashion designer must join forces with a C.I.A. agent to combat terrorism.

items.name: Escobank
items.description: A ragtag group of misfits, veterans and ex-cons embark on a perilous journey in the jungles of Colombia to find the buried barrels of cash left behind by legendary drug kingpin Pablo Escobar before his downfall.

items.name: Cats in the Museum
items.description: The cat Vincent and mouse friend escape a flood in a harpsichord, arriving at the Hermitage. Elite guard cats protect the art from mice. When the Mona Lisa arrives, Vincent must stop it being stolen and win over Cleopatra cat.

items.name: The Huntsman
items.description: When an ICU nurse volunteers to help a coma patient accused of murdering six women, he's drawn into a chilling web of lies, obsession, and deadly secrets as a detective races to stop the killer.

items.name: Rings
items.description: A young woman finds herself on the receiving end of a terrifying curse that threatens to take her life in 7 days.

items.name: Look Who's Talking Now
items.description: The dogs can talk at a family of 4, where mom loses her job the same day dad gets a job as pilot for a cute, single boss.

items.name: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
items.description: In order to restore their dying safe haven, the son of Poseidon and his friends embark on a quest to the Sea of Monsters, to find the mythical Golden Fleece, all the while trying to stop an ancient evil from rising.

items.name: Dolly Parton's Coat of Many Colors
items.description: Discover the magic and warmth of Dolly Parton’s Coat of Many Colors, based on the inspiring story of living legend Dolly Parton’s remarkable upbringing in rural Tennessee.

items.name: Reckless
items.description: A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

items.name: Zoom
items.description: Former superhero Jack is called back to work to transform an unlikely group of ragtag kids into superheroes at a private academy.

items.name: Getaway
items.description: Drey meets a rich broken woman named Sha'rell who transforms him into a player named Slick, but after their breakup he loses it all. Now Slick joins the local drug scene only to be exposed to the dangers he was never ready for.

items.name: Bandits
items.description: Two bank robbers fall in love with the girl they've kidnapped.

items.name: Mimic 2
items.description: A human mimicking giant bug survived Mimic (1997) and is killing humans and stalking a woman, who's bug/biology school teacher in NYC.

items.name: Behind the Screen
items.description: Charlie is an overworked labourer at a film studio who helps a young woman find work even while his coworkers strike against his tyrannical boss.

items.name: The Count
items.description: Charlie burns a count's trousers while ironing them and is fired. The tailor finds an invitation to dinner at Miss Moneybags and goes in place of the count. Charlie goes to the kitchen of ...

items.name: The Fireman
items.description: Charlie is a fireman who always does everything wrong. A man talks the Fire Chief into ignoring his burning home (he wants the insurance money) unaware that his daughter (the love of the ...

items.name: The Vagabond
items.description: After passing the hat and taking the donations intended for German street musicians Charlie heads for the country. Here he finds and rescues a girl from a band of gypsies. The girl falls in...

items.name: The Floorwalker
items.description: After causing havoc on the sales floor Charlie goes to the office floor. There he runs into the store inspector (who looks exactly like him) who has just robbed the safe and knocked out the...

items.name: He Went That Way
items.description: A journey of curious tensions and bonds between two and at times three interesting characters all on their own path.

items.name: Hold Back the Dawn
items.description: Stopped in Mexico by U.S. Immigration, Georges Iscovescu hopes to get into the country by marrying a citizen.

items.name: A Burlesque on Carmen
items.description: This is the original two-reel parody of Bizet's Carmen by Chaplin. Darn Hosiery, a Spanish officer, is seduced by the gypsy girl Carmen, leading to disgrace and downfall.

items.name: Caught in a Cabaret
items.description: Charlie is a clumsy waiter in a cheap cabaret and must endure the strict orders from his boss. He meets a pretty girl in the park and pretends to be a fancy ambassador but must contend with the jealousy of her fiancé.

items.name: Hogfather
items.description: It's Hogswatch (equivalent to Christmas) on the Discworld and the Hogfather has gone missing, requiring Death to take his place while his granddaughter Susan endeavors to find out what has happened.

items.name: 3 Ninjas
items.description: Each year, three brothers visit their grandfather for the summer. He is highly skilled in ninjutsu, and for years he has trained the boys in his techniques.

items.name: Viridiana
items.description: Viridiana, a young nun about to take her final vows, pays a visit to her widowed uncle at the request of her Mother Superior.

items.name: Coronation
items.description: The elderly heir of a formerly wealthy and respected Chilean family, Andres, suffers from decadence and solitude. He hires young Estela in order to look after his tiranic and almost crazy grandmother. The differences in class and age don't stop Andres from courting Estela, whose fiancé Mario tries to make some money with the passions of his well-off rival. The suffocating atmosphere of the run-down mansion in the outskirts of Santiago represents the deterioration of the bourgeoisie, and sets the scene for the total collapse of Andres.

items.name: Stolen Time
items.description: John Parker mourns the loss of his brother Pete, while Jack the Madman, driven by anger, seeks revenge. Playing with time travel has consequences. Will time heal all wounds?

items.name: The Fortune Cookie
items.description: A crooked lawyer persuades his brother-in-law to feign a serious injury.

items.name: Dogs at the Opera
items.description: Moscow, early 20th century: Stray dog Samson, fleeing from animal catchers, finds himself in the Bolshoy Theater, where he meets charming Margot, a pet of prima ballerina Anastasia. The plot thickens as the unique tiara that belonged to the Queen of Great Britain and that Anastasia has to wear in the fourth act, is stolen from the dressing room. Without the tiara, the show cannot go on, so Margot and Samson have to save the day to the sounds of the great Georges Bizet.

items.name: The Mother
items.description: A woman has a passionate affair with a man half her age, who is also sleeping with her daughter.

items.name: Robert and the Toymaker
items.description: In Germany, 1941, the Nazis pursue a Toymaker who has acquired a mystical book which gives life to inanimate objects.

items.name: Ari Shaffir: Double Negative
items.description: Comedian Ari Shaffir steps outside of his yamaka to expose the uncomfortable truth that children are trash, and becoming an adult also brings about its own greasy problems.

items.name: Comfort and Joy
items.description: Radio host Alan 'Dickie' Bird witnesses how an icecream van is attacked and destroyed by angry competitors. This leads him into the struggle between two Italian families over the icecream market of Glasgow.

items.name: Oscar Shaw
items.description: A retired cop seeks revenge for his best friend's death, taking justice into his own hands after failing to achieve it during his police career.

items.name: Finnick
items.description: Finnick is a young Finn, who doesn't seem to care about his responsibility of making a home out of his house. Everything changes when a new family comes to his house and Finnick's tricks do not work at all.

items.name: Sympathy for the Devil
items.description: In an urban war zone where everything that moves is a target, Paul tries to live, love and inform.

items.name: Day for Night
items.description: A committed film director struggles to complete his movie while coping with a myriad of crises, personal and professional, among the cast and crew.

items.name: Cairo Station
items.description: A newspaper salesman at the train station in Cairo develops an unhealthy obsession with a woman who sells refreshments.

items.name: The Tomorrow Job
items.description: A team of thieves use a drug that allows them to trade consciousnesses with their future-selves in order to steal tomorrow's secrets.

items.name: Throttle
items.description: Every day, millions of people descend into underground parking garages, get into their cars and drive to the safety of their homes. But tonight, five levels down in a deserted corporate parking structure, financial analyst Tom Wea...

items.name: The Road to El Dorado
items.description: Two swindlers get their hands on a map to the fabled city of gold, El Dorado.

items.name: Sleuth
items.description: On his sprawling country estate, an aging writer matches wits with the struggling actor who has stolen his wife's heart.

items.name: Glass Garden
items.description: Despite her disabled leg, Ph.D. student Jae-yeon is a brilliant researcher with a rare ability to communicate with nature. Having been hurt by her hypocrite colleague and lover, she turns her back on the world and goes deep into t...

items.name: Strange Journey: The Story of Rocky Horror
items.description: A wild journey into the origins of The Rocky Horror Picture Show, the biggest cult film of all time, its impact on popular culture and socio-political resonance to this day.

items.name: Sinbad and the Eye of the Tiger
items.description: Sinbad the Sailor sails to deliver a cursed prince to a dangerous island in the face of deadly opposition from the powerful witch Zenobia, her son and their several monsters.

items.name: The Apostle
items.description: After his happy life spins out of control, a preacher from Texas changes his name, goes to Louisiana and starts preaching on the radio.

items.name: Chris Fleming: Live at The Palace
items.description: From the Cadillac Palace Theatre in Chicago, comedian Chris Fleming bursts onto the screen with a fun and lighthearted blend of skillful storytelling and wild physicality in his first HBO stand-up special. A high-energy performer who seamlessly pivots from one everyday topic to another – from Trader Joe’s to Oreos, NPR, and dog breeds – Fleming bounds across the stage as he shares his unique takes on masculinity, conga lines, and more.

items.name: Texas Rangers
items.description: A ragtag group of youngsters band together after the American Civil War to form the Texas Rangers, a group charged with the dangerous, ruthless duty of cleaning up the West.

items.name: Coyote Ugly
items.description: Aspiring songwriter Violet Sanford, after getting a job at a women-run NYC bar that teases its male patrons, comes out of her shell.

items.name: Friday the 13th
items.description: A group of young adults visit a boarded up campsite named Crystal Lake where they soon encounter the mysterious Jason Voorhees and his deadly intentions.

items.name: Final Destination 5
items.description: Death returns to claim the lucky survivors of a deadly bridge collapse in this fifth frightening installment in the series.

items.name: Friday After Next
items.description: Working as security guards, Craig and Day-Day run into the thief who stole their Christmas presents.

items.name: The Final Destination
items.description: A horrifying premonition saves a young man and his friends from death during a racetrack accident but terrible fates await them nonetheless.

items.name: Circle of Friends
items.description: Three women, who've been friends since childhood, meet at university in Dublin in 1957. Student and boyfriend life begins.

items.name: Grizzly Night
items.description: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happened: On the same night, nine miles apart, there were not one-but two-fatal grizzly bear attacks.

items.name: Lord of the Flies
items.description: Schoolboys marooned on a Pacific island create their own savage civilization.

items.name: Christmas Cupid
items.description: A supernatural comedy in which a ruthless PR executive is forced to reconsider her life choices when her number one client suffers an untimely death during the Christmas season.

items.name: Autumn in the Vineyard
items.description: Two former childhood sweethearts are forced to work side-by-side on a vineyard during a legal dispute.

items.name: Just a Kiss
items.description: A group of thirtysomethings having problems with fidelity gets an opportunity to turn back the clock.

items.name: Taking Earth
items.description: The human race is thrown into chaos as an alien invasion takes control of the planet in an effort to find one boy out of 7 billion people who holds the power to destroy them.

items.name: Mommy's Secret
items.description: When a teenage girl discovers her own mother is behind the recent rash of nearby bank robberies, she's determined to help her come clean.

items.name: The Maid
items.description: An American teenager, who while visiting his estranged dad in England, gets into an emotional relationship with the older foreign maid working there.

items.name: Thieves Highway
items.description: After discovering a plot to haul stolen cattle in the middle of nowhere, a desperate and isolated lawman becomes the only thing standing in-between a group of dangerous rustlers and a clear run to the border.

items.name: Sleepwalker
items.description: A grieving mother is haunted by the tragic loss of her daughter in a car accident that left her abusive husband in a coma. As she battles a surreal descent into darkness, her sleepwalking episodes intensify. Plagued by haunting visions of her husband inside their home, she grapples with the blurred lines between reality and nightmare.

items.name: Harlem Nights
items.description: During the 1930s, a New York City illegal gambling house owner and his associates must deal with strong competition, gangsters, and corrupt cops in order to stay in business.

items.name: Gambit
items.description: An art curator decides to seek revenge on his abusive boss by conning him into buying a fake Monet, but his plan requires the help of an eccentric and unpredictable Texas rodeo queen.

items.name: The Lacemaker
items.description: A reserved young woman moves into an apartment with a young student she met while on vacation.

items.name: The Butcher
items.description: A tragic car accident in the middle of nowhere finds six stranded college students fighting for their lives after making a horrifying discovery in a remote farmhouse in this rural frightener.

items.name: Home Sweet Hell
items.description: Don Champagne seems to have it all, but when his wife Mona learns of his affair with a pretty new salesgirl, she will stop at nothing to maintain their storybook life.

items.name: Hunting Elephants
items.description: In Jerusalem, a bullied teen befriends his grandfather and long lost uncle and soon they decide to solve their financial problems by robbing a bank.

items.name: Bisons
items.description: “Respect for the vanquished”, remarks Steve “is what separates man from beast.” As a champion in Swiss-style wrestling, Steve knows a thing or two about observing codes of combat. But when his family farm faces repossession, he is forced to join hands with his ex-convict brother Joel and enter the lucrative, clandestine world of no-rules fighting.

items.name: Master of the World
items.description: Primitive humans had to adapt to their brutal and savage environment or disappear into oblivion. For Bog, a great warrior, this struggle means conquering the land and gaining supremacy over his rivals.

items.name: Striking The Palace
items.description: Eva, 20, joins Safietou, Djaoua, Violette and Simone, a team of chambermaids at one of Paris’s finest Palace Hotels. She discovers the poor working conditions of these invisible women, who work tirelessly to keep the high standards of these luxurious hotels, where one night can cost their annual salary. Many are not even employed by the hotels directly but by sub-contractors, and are therefore particularly vulnerable. While on strike to fight against subcontracting and to obtain better working conditions, they come up with a colorful idea : having their own “Fashion Week” in front of the hotel!

items.name: She Looks Like Me

Thanks to his conniving cousin Ferhat (Nesim El Ahmadi), Emre becomes convinced that Luna is cheating. When misunderstandings pile up and it turns out that Baris is targeting both Luna and Emre, Mr. and Mrs. Aslan pull out all the stops to save their lives and marriage.

She fatefully encounters Skinner, a young American soldier who has just returned from three tours in the Middle East. While falling in love, they discover the possibility of a better life together than the ones they believed they were destined to live alone.

items.name: Under Siege
items.description: Former Navy SEAL, Casey Ryback, is the only person capable of stopping a group of terrorists led by a rogue former CIA agent who seize the USS Missouri, a U.S. Navy battleship, in an attempt to steal its nuclear arsenal.

As Betty wrestles with this, she also learns the amazing truth about her family and discovers that the not so normal, the magical and the musical are all a part of her fabulously freaky family. It's very freaky, so be freaked freaky ahh deaky peaky neaky seaky peaky poo.

It was a rather strange voyage, with no ocean or sea crossing, not even a lock to pass through... The boat stayed at home and so did my father. But that does not mean there was no adventure...

He is the editor-in-chief of Russia’s only independent newspaper, Novaya Gazeta. Six of his journalists have been murdered, after their reports displeased the state.  In February 2022 Russia invades Ukraine. In early March, using the cover of a documentary film festival, Muratov secretly negotiates free passage for forty journalists with the Latvian government. Then he returns to Moscow to look after his paper and its remaining staff.  To this day, he refuses to leave Moscow, whatever the pressure on him and his team. "Putin stands for death. I stand for life."
