items.description: Foundling Heathcliff is raised by the wealthy Earnshaws in Yorkshire but in later life launches a vendetta against the family.

items.name: Canary
items.description: Daring to seek Earth's history contained in glaciers atop the tallest mountains in the world, Dr. Lonnie Thompson found himself on the frontlines of climate change—his life's work evolving into a salvage mission to recover these priceless historical records before they disappear forever.

items.name: Piece by Piece
items.description: A vibrant journey through the life of Pharrell Williams, told through the lens of Lego animation.

items.name: Thelonious Monk: Straight, No Chaser
items.description: A documentary film about the life of pianist and jazz great Thelonious Sphere Monk. Features live performances by Monk and his band, and interviews with friends and family about the offbeat genius.

items.name: Lili
items.description: An orphaned young woman becomes part of a puppet act and forms a relationship with the anti-social puppeteer.

items.name: Winter in Sokcho
items.description: In the snowy seaside town of Sokcho, 25-year-old Soo-Ha works at a guesthouse. She drifts between her mother’s fish stall and her boyfriend until a French artist’s arrival stirs questions about her identity. As winter deepens, Soo-Ha and the artist form an unspoken connection through food and art.

items.name: Dragon Ball Z: The Return of Cooler
items.description: Cooler has resurrected himself as a robot and is enslaving the people of New Namek. Goku and the gang must help.

items.name: Stone Cold Fox
items.description: In 1986, the defiant Fox breaks out of an abusive commune in search of her family. But when the queenpin kidnaps her little sister and sends a crooked cop after her, Fox has no choice but to infiltrate the very place she escaped.

items.name: Dragon Ball Z: Lord Slug
items.description: When an asteroid nearly destroys Planet Earth, a space ship emerges from the asteroid and lands on Earth. The new terror is Lord Slug, a nomadic alien who plans to destroy all life on Earth...

items.name: Miami Blues
items.description: An ex-con's first act of freedom is moving to Miami where he restarts his old criminal ways with even more potency.

items.name: The Killers
items.description: Hit men arrive in a small New Jersey town to kill an unresisting victim, and insurance investigator Reardon uncovers his past involvement with beautiful, deadly Kitty Collins.

items.name: Joshua
items.description: A black soldier returns from fighting for the Union in the Civil War only to find out that his mother has been murdered by a gang of white thugs. He becomes a bounty hunter, determined to track down and kill the men who killed his mother.

items.name: I'll Be Right There
items.description: Wanda wants to take care of everyone in her life. She barely has time for herself, not that she would know what to do with it anyway.

items.name: The Grey Ones
items.description: Three people find a meteorite and take it home. Over the next few nights, a series of strange and ominous events begins to happen around them.

items.name: Wrong Turn 2: Dead End
items.description: A group of reality show contestants find themselves fighting for their survival against a family of hideously deformed inbred cannibals who plan to ruthlessly butcher them all.

items.name: Wrong Turn 3: Left for Dead
items.description: When their transfer bus crashes in a West Virginia forest, a group of convicts and a corrections officer meet a rafter who is on the run from cannibalistic hillbillies who have murdered her friends.

items.name: The Killer's Game
items.description: When a hitman is diagnosed with a terminal illness, he decides to take a hit out on himself. But when the very hitmen he hired also target his ex-girlfriend, he must fend off an army of assassin colleagues.

items.name: Therese Raquin
items.description: A loose adaptation of Emile Zola's classic tale, "Therese Raquin".

items.name: A Christmas to Treasure
items.description: The passing of a beloved old neighbor reunites six friends for a hometown holiday treasure hunt, where sparks fly once again between brand strategist Austin and his former best friend Everett.

items.name: Night Train
items.description: Jerzy enters a train set for the Baltic coast. He seems to be on the run from something, as does the strange woman with whom he must share a sleeping compartment.

items.name: Shadow of a Doubt
items.description: A teenage girl, overjoyed when her uncle comes to visit the family in their quiet California town, slowly begins to suspect that he is the "Merry Widow" killer sought by the authorities.

items.name: Twist and Shout
items.description: Denmark, 1963: Teenagers Bjørn and Erik are into girls and being in a band helps Bjørn meet Anna. Erik likes Kirsten but she likes Bjørn. Having a mentally ill mom at home also ruins Erik's chances. Anna's pregnancy changes everyt...

items.name: Dog Day
items.description: A criminal shows up at a farmhouse with the law on his heels and several million dollars in his possession.

items.name: Under the Sun
items.description: Rebel forces, influenced by the advice of a witch doctor to attack Kurume, find two "gifted" children with albinism, whose blood will help bring them victory. Can these two kids continue to live their lives and dreams under the sun?

items.name: Sanjuro
items.description: A crafty samurai helps a young man and his fellow clansmen trying to save his uncle, who has been framed and imprisoned by a corrupt superintendent.

items.name: Glengarry Glen Ross
items.description: An examination of the machinations behind the scenes at a real estate office. Unscrupulous salesmen try to hawk dubious real estate to suckers.

items.name: Valiant One
items.description: With tensions between North and South Korea, a US helicopter crashes on the North Korean side. Now the survivors must work together to protect a civilian tech specialist and find their way out without the help of US military support.

items.name: The Snail and the Whale
items.description: A tiny snail goes on an amazing journey by hitching a ride on the tail of a huge humpback whale. Based on the picture book written by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler.

items.name: The Quiet Man
items.description: An Irish-born boxer returns to his homeland to reclaim his family's farm and begins a turbulent romance with a beautiful spitfire.

items.name: Just Breathe
items.description: Nick Bianco sets out to reunite with the love of his life after serving a year in jail for assault, only to discover that she has a new admirer named Chester who also happens to be his parole officer.

items.name: The Wildman of Shaggy Creek
items.description: When a young boy discovers a Bigfoot monster may be lurking in the woods behind his house, he must face his fear to uncover the truth.

items.name: When the Light Breaks
items.description: When the light breaks on a long summer's day in Iceland. From one sunset to another, Una, a young art student, encounters love, friendship, sorrow and beauty.

items.name: Airport
items.description: A bomber on board an airplane, an airport almost closed by snow, and various personal problems of the people involved.

items.name: Eye for an Eye
items.description: Anna, grieving the sudden death of her parents, relocates from New York to a small Florida town to live with the grandmother she has never met. Isolated, vulnerable, and in need of friends, she finds brief solace in the company of two local teens. But when she becomes complicit to their unforgivable act of violence, she finds herself ensnared by Mr. Sandman – the twisted soul of a tormented child who haunts bullies’ dreams before feasting on their eyeballs when they finally wake - Anna must right her wrong before becoming a victim of this gruesome curse.

items.name: Magic Beach
items.description: Ten animators bring Alison Lester's beloved children's book to the screen, crafting a magical mixture of live action and animation that is destined to become a family favourite.

items.name: A Tramway in Jerusalem
items.description: On a tramway that connects several of Jerusalem's neighborhoods from East to West, a mosaic of people from different religious and ethnic backgrounds are brought together.

items.name: Last to Die
items.description: When an introverted chemistry student investigates her brother disappearance in a remote part of Colombia, she encounters mysterious villagers, who will stop at nothing to protect their deadly secret. It seems tonight may be the night for Jane when she and her friends are hunted by a strange, massive,  force known only as The Dux.

items.name: Nobody's Perfect
items.description: "Daijobu 3 Kumi" depicts the interactions between new teacher Shinnosuke Akao, who was born without arms and legs, and the 28 students in his 5th grade class, told from the vantage point of school board member Yusaku Shiraishi

items.name: Kill Me Again
items.description: Charlie, a notorious serial killer known as the Midnight Mangler finds himself trapped, reliving the same violent night over and over. Initially embracing his grisly urges, Charlie soon becomes desperate to escape the endless nightmare.

items.name: Justice League: Crisis on Infinite Earths - Part Three
items.description: Trapped in a pocket universe, surviving Earths face annihilation by the Anti-Monitor. Time shatters, bringing past heroes to aid Justice League against the epitome of evil. Their sacrifice may lead to victory.

items.name: My Friend Irma Goes West
items.description: En route to Hollywood, singer Steve, his partner Seymour and fiancée Jane, Jane's airheaded roommate Irma, and Irma's con artist fiancé Al have a series of misadventures and end up involved with a murderous gang.

items.name: El
items.description: A husband's suave exterior unravels after his marriage, and he unleashes his paranoid and volatile temper on his wife, which escalates to more dangerous and unpredictable tantrums.

items.name: Congo
items.description: When an expedition to the African Congo ends in disaster, a new team is assembled to find out what went wrong.

items.name: Brother Orange
items.description: "Brother Orange" follows the story of Matt Stopera, a BuzzFeed founding editor, whose life takes an unexpected turn when his stolen phone, lost in a New York City bar, becomes the catalyst for a viral BuzzFeed article a year later. The article launched a viral feel-good story about a lasting friendship that transcends language and culture and has captivated the world with over 100 million views on social media, including over 70 million shares on Weibo, and traditional media such as NPR, Rachel Maddow, and Ellen while propelling Matt into instant celebrity status. As their 10-year friendship anniversary nears, this extraordinary true story showcases the power of personal connection between two ordinary people-one American and one Chinese-who look beyond political tensions to form a profound bond.

items.name: The Good Teacher
items.description: When a Literature teacher is confronted with a teenage student's complaint of inappropriate behavior, he is called upon to fight to protect his name, his position in the school, and his longtime gay relationship, which no one knows.

items.name: 14 Peaks: Nothing Is Impossible
items.description: Fearless Nepali mountaineer Nirmal Purja embarks on a seemingly impossible quest to summit all 14 of the world's 8,000-meter peaks in seven months.

items.name: The Second Act
items.description: Florence wants to introduce David, the man she's madly in love with, to her father. But David isn't attracted to her and wants to throw her into the arms of his friend Willy. The characters meet in a restaurant in the middle of no...

items.name: Day of Anger
items.description: A scruffy garbage boy becomes the pupil of a famed gunfighter, and the stage for confrontation is set when the gunman overruns the boy's town through violence and corruption.

items.name: Stream
items.description: The Keenan family's simple weekend getaway truly turns into a vacation to die for, as four deranged killers playing a sadistic game lock down their hotel and compete for the most creative murders of all the guests.

items.name: The Front Room
items.description: It tells the story of a newly pregnant couple who are forced to take in an ailing, estranged stepmother.

items.name: The Phantom of the Opera
items.description: A mad, disfigured composer seeks love with a lovely young opera singer.

items.name: Agent Cody Banks
items.description: A government agent trains Cody Banks in the ways of covert operations that require younger participants.

items.name: A Moroccan Affair
items.description: Follows the Díaz-Aguirre family, whose perfect universe turns upside down after the death of the patriarch, who in his will asks his wife to recover the 'Sardinete', his first fishing boat which is rusting in a Moroccan port.

items.description: A cash-strapped cashier working at a bank embarks on a risky investment scheme and soon gets drawn into the murky world of money laundering.

items.name: The Eye
items.description: A blind girl gets a cornea transplant so that she will be able to see again. She gets more than she bargained for upon realizing she can also see ghosts.

items.name: Taking Off

items.name: Good Boy
items.description: An intergalactic dog pilot from Sirius (the dog star), visits Earth to verify the rumors that dogs have failed to take over the planet.

items.name: No Way Out
items.description: Two hoodlum brothers are brought into a hospital for gunshot wounds, and when one of them dies the other accuses their black doctor of murder.

items.description: Humanoid sea creatures start killing a fishing town's residents, and raping their women. It's up to the townsfolk and a visiting biologist to fight back and fend them off.

items.name: Animal Farm
items.description: The animals of a farm successfully revolt against its human owner, only to slide into a more brutal tyranny amongst themselves.

items.name: Tai Chi Master
items.description: Two friends, ex Shaolin monks, part ways as they brush with the ongoing rebellion against the government. The ambitious one rises up to be a powerful military commander, while his betrayed friend resorts to learn the calm ways of ...

items.name: Brainstorm
items.description: Researchers develop a system where they can jump into people's minds. But when people involved bring their personal problems into the equation, it becomes dangerous - perhaps deadly.

items.name: Dragon Ball Z: Bardock - The Father of Goku
items.description: The tale of Bardock, the father of Goku, and his rebellion against his master the mighty Frieza.

items.name: Wicked: One Wonderful Night
items.description: The stars of Wicked: For Good (2025) and specials guests present at Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles a night of reimagined musical arrangements, cast interviews, behind-the-scenes moments, and a sneak peek of the film.

items.name: Norm of the North: King Sized Adventure
items.description: An archaeologist steals an ancient Chinese artifact, and Norm embarks across the world to recover it.

items.name: The Doberman Gang
items.description: A clever con artist and an animal trainer team up to teach Doberman Pinschers how to rob banks.

items.name: Batman and Harley Quinn
items.description: Batman and Nightwing are forced to team with the Joker's sometimes-girlfriend Harley Quinn to stop a global threat brought about by Poison Ivy and Jason Woodrue, the Floronic Man.

items.name: The Talk of the Town
items.description: An escaped prisoner must prove his innocence to a stuffy law professor with help from a spirited schoolteacher.

items.name: The Retirement Plan
items.description: When Ashley and her young daughter Sarah get caught up in a criminal enterprise that puts their lives at risk, she turns to estranged father Matt, currently living the life of a retired beach bum in the Cayman Islands.

items.name: Dining with the Kapoors
items.description: This special offers a rare glimpse into the Kapoors, Hindi cinema's first family, over an afternoon of conversation, nostalgia and homemade delicacies.

items.name: The Jester 2
items.description: When teen magician Max crosses paths with the sinister Jester on Halloween night, she must outsmart a supernatural killer whose magic is all too real and whose tricks always end up in blood.

items.name: Swingers
items.description: A wannabe actor has a hard time moving on from a break-up, but he is lucky to have supportive friends.

items.name: The Thicket
items.description: When a bounty hunter and a band of unlikely heroes pursue a brutal killer, they find themselves in a deadly no-man's-land known as The Thicket.

items.name: The Flat
items.description: As a documentarian cleans out the flat that belonged to his grandparents--both immigrants from Nazi Germany--he uncovers clues pointing to a complicated, shocking story.

items.name: That's My Boy
items.description: The greatest player in Ridgefield College history uses his influence and reputation to get his only son, a sickly, uncoordinated nerd, on the college football team with comic results.

items.name: Junk Head
items.description: In a distant future, humanity has lost its ability to reproduce. An expedition is sent to an underground city where artificial humanoids are still fertile.

items.name: Severance
items.description: During a team-building retreat in the mountains a group of sales representatives are hunted down one by one.

items.name: The Paloni Show! Halloween Special!
items.description: Follows Leroy, Reggie, and Cheruce Paloni as they host a Halloween Special full of spooky shorts from a group of up-and-coming animators.

items.description: After separating from his wife, fastidious Felix Unger moves in with his divorced poker pal and best friend, slovenly Oscar Madison.

items.description: A US Army lieutenant colonel is tasked with forming an elite commando-style unit from crack Canadian troops and the dregs of the US Army.

items.name: The Most Precious of Cargoes
items.description: During a war that plagues everything around, a lumberjack's wife finds an abandoned baby girl. This meeting transforms the lives of the couple and those whose destinies intertwine with that of the child.

items.name: R.L. Stine's Pumpkinhead
items.description: When his brother disappears and everyone forgets he existed, Sam must unravel the mystery before Finn is gone forever.

items.name: The Rapture
items.description: Lydia, a dedicated midwife, is in the middle of a breakup. At the time, her best friend Salomé tells her she is pregnant. One day, she comes across Milo - a one-night stand - as she is carrying her friend's baby in her arms.

items.name: That's My Boy
items.description: While in his teens, Donny fathered a son, Todd, and raised him as a single parent until Todd's 18th birthday. Now Donny resurfaces just before Todd's wedding after years apart, sending the groom-to-be's world crashing down.

items.name: Lilya 4-Ever
items.description: Sixteen-year-old Lilja and her only friend, the young boy Volodja, live in Russia, fantasizing about a better life. One day, Lilja falls in love with Andrej, who is going to Sweden, and invites Lilja to come along and start a new ...

items.name: Asterix the Gaul
items.description: Asterix, the most cunning warrior of a village resisting the Roman occupation of Gaul, must save their magic potion-brewing druid when he is kidnapped by an ambitious Centurion.

items.name: An Inconvenient Truth
items.description: Filmmaker Davis Guggenheim follows Al Gore on the lecture circuit, as the former presidential candidate campaigns to raise public awareness of the dangers of global warming and calls for immediate action to curb its destructive ef...

items.name: Charm City Kings
items.description: Fourteen-year-old Mouse desperately wants to join the Midnight Clique, an infamous group of Baltimore dirt-bike riders who rule the summertime streets.

items.name: A Sudden Case of Christmas
items.description: An American couple takes their 10-year-old daughter to her grandfather's hotel in Italy to tell her that they are separating. Hoping to bring them back together, she asks to celebrate one last Christmas together, although it's Aug...

items.name: Niki
items.description: French-American artist Niki de Saint-Phalle, from the age of 23, is a model and an aspiring actor who is married and has a two year old daughter. Together, they flee the U.S. during the oppressive McCarthy era and come to France, where they experience a short-lived euphoria. Soon, distant and frightening memories begin to emerge in Niki’s mind. Her vocation as an artist will be her salvation.

items.name: Three Friends
items.description: Joan is no longer in love with Victor, but it pains her to feel she is being dishonest with him. Alice, her best friend, reassures her: She herself doesn’t feel passionate about her partner Eric and yet their relationship is smooth sailing. She has no idea he is having an affair with Rebecca, their mutual friend. When Joan finally decides to leave Victor and he disappears, the lives of the three friends and their relationships are turned upside down.

items.name: Revealed: Surviving Malka Leifer
items.description: In 2008, allegations emerged that Malka Leifer, the headmistress of the girls' campus of an ultra-Orthodox Jewish school in Melbourne's inner south-east, had committed grievous crimes against three young students under her care, sisters Dassi Erlich, Nicole Meyer and Elly Sapper. It was the catalyst for a reckoning; but before police investigations could get underway, Leifer fled overseas under the cloak of darkness with the assistance of the school. Thus began an extradition battle that would last for the better part of a decade, and a broader quest for justice that revealed a web of international intrigue, legal loopholes and political corruption as well as a deeper culture of silence around sexual abuse.

items.name: Beauties of the Night
items.description: A young composer has vivid dreams of the past that reflect, yet conflict with his waking life.

items.name: The Arbor
items.description: Portrayal of the late Bradford playwright Andrea Dunbar.

items.name: Secrets of the Spy Whale
items.description: In April 2019, a seemingly tame beluga whale approaches a Norwegian fishing boat seeking help. It is wearing a harness fitted with a camera mount. When the words 'Equipment St Petersburg' are discovered printed on the buckle, speculation breaks out that he has been engaged in some kind of sinister undercover activity.  This documentary explores the mystery of the strange whale and asks where he came from, who trained him and why, and what he was doing in a critically important part of the Arctic, close to Russian waters. With exclusive interviews and access to unseen footage, the film explores the secret world of marine mammal training and international espionage, and sheds new light on the true identity of Hvaldimir, the 'Spy Whale'.

items.name: Diggers
items.description: A story about a tight-knit group of friends, who try to maintain their small-town way of life in the face of enormous changes in 1970s Long Island.

items.name: The Hollow
items.description: After the local ghost story is told to a pre-Halloween crowd, the eve's full of pranks and teenagers disappear at the graveyard. It continues on Halloween. Is the legend true?

items.description: A Mexican official and his American wife are targeted in a Texas border town by the crime family he's trying to put behind bars for drug trafficking, as his concern grows over the tactics of the local detective whose cooperation h...

items.description: A TV repair man must care for the newborn triplets of his former hometown sweetheart, now a famous movie star, so her career will not suffer.

items.name: No Direction Home: Bob Dylan

items.description: When deaf-mute Singer moves to a new town to be near his hospitalized friend, he makes an indelible impression on the lives of those around him.

items.description: 11-year-old Mildred's world is turned upside down when her estranged father, the washed-up magician Strawn Wise, comes to look after her and agrees to take her camping to find a mythological beast known as the Canterbury Panther.

items.name: The Killing Floor
items.description: A literary agent moves into a penthouse apartment. Soon after the move, he receives crime scene photographs that seem to have taken place in his new apartment. Next he receives a series of stalker videotapes that document his ever...

items.name: Thrive
items.description: Follows athletes as they recount their rollercoaster experience after sustaining a traumatic brain injury and the treatments that helped their brains heal.

items.name: Airport '77
items.description: Art thieves hijack a 747, hit fog and crash into the ocean, trapping them and the passengers under one hundred feet of water.

items.name: Blind River
items.description: Claire Lewis, a blind woman, is overly cautious with her six-year-old daughter Briar. When Briar goes missing Christmas day, Claire faces her worst nightmare and sets out in darkness to find her.

items.name: Hell House LLC Origins: The Carmichael Manor
items.description: A group of cold case investigators stay at the Carmichael Manor. After four nights, the group was never heard from again. What is discovered on their footage is even more disturbing than anything found on the Hell House tapes.

items.name: Cuckoo
items.description: A 17-year-old is forced to move with her family to a resort where things are not what they seem.

items.name: Midas Man

items.name: End of Days
items.description: A disillusioned former detective protects a young woman predestined to conceive the Antichrist, fighting through a conspiracy of rogue Vatican knights and satanic cultists to prevent the apocalypse at the turn of the millennium.

items.name: Stelios
items.description: The touching story of a child from a Pontic refugee family who managed to survive and thrive against all odds, thanks to his immense talent and resilience in the face of social and personal challenges. Music, love, family, friends, fishing, creativity, people of the night, hardcore fans, and intense conflicts come together to create the mosaic of his life. This film is a tribute to legendary singer, Stelios Kazantzidis, whose voice touched the hearts of all Greeks around the world. A film for those who loved him and those who wish to discover him.

items.name: Lethal Weapon 3
items.description: Martin Riggs and Roger Murtaugh pursue a former LAPD officer who uses his knowledge of police procedure and policies to steal and sell confiscated guns and ammunition to local street gangs.

items.name: Silver Bullet
items.description: In a small town, brutal killings start to plague the close-knit community. Marty Coslaw, a paraplegic boy, is convinced the murders are the doings of a werewolf.

They are spending time together with Sophia’s father, at the family summer house on a tiny unspoiled island in the Gulf of Finland. All three are coming to terms with the recent death of Sophia’s mother in very different ways.

items.description: It tells the story of Antoine who chose to stay at home to take care of his children after his dismissal. The roles have been reversed for 2 years, and his energy is starting to diminish in the face of his family's demands.

items.name: Spermageddon
items.description: Inside the body of a teenager on the verge of losing his virginity, sperm embark on a mad race toward the egg.

items.name: Oasis
items.description: An irresponsible and childish ex-con befriends a girl with cerebral palsy and develops a progressively stronger bond with her.

items.name: Fisherman's Friends: One and All
items.description: Following the success of their first album, the Fisherman's Friends struggle to adjust to their new-found fame and work towards a second album.

items.name: Mighty Express: A Mighty Christmas
items.description: The Mighty Express welcomes a new train and speeds into a snowstorm to deliver Santa’s presents and save Christmas for all the kids in Tracksville.

items.name: The Flood
items.description: Everything is complicated in Yoni's life. He's almost 13, real gifted, but physically undeveloped and struggles daily to grow up before his threatening up-coming Bar Mitzva.

items.name: Utopia
items.description: Soldier investigates wife's disappearance, infiltrates facility believing she's trafficked. Discovers facility is futuristic fantasy park blurring reality and illusion, complicating his search for truth about her fate.

items.name: The Killers
items.description: Surprised that their contract victim didn't try to run away from them, two professional hit men try to find out who hired them and why.

items.name: Cellar Door
items.description: Looking for a fresh start after a miscarriage, a couple find themselves being gifted the house of their dreams with one caveat - they can never open the cellar door. Whether they can live without knowing triggers shocking conseque...

items.name: Canary Black
items.description: It follows Avery Graves as she is blackmailed by terrorists into betraying her own country to save her kidnapped husband.

items.name: House of Chains
items.description: It follows a troubled married couple as they imprison their six children due to their intense religious ideology.

items.name: Song of the South
items.description: The kindly story-teller Uncle Remus tells a young boy stories about trickster Br'er Rabbit, who outwits Br'er Fox and slow-witted Br'er Bear.

items.name: Sneaks
items.description: When his sister is stolen by a shady collector, a pampered, custom sneaker must leave his velvet-lined box and navigate the streets of New York City with a ragtag group of streetwise footwear to bring her home.

items.name: Spiders on a Plane
items.description: A group of young travellers discover their dream vacation has turned into a nightmare when an infestation of top-secret deadly spiders escapes mid-flight. When the pilots are killed by the aggressive arachnids, the group must fend for themselves against the relentless swarm and their monstrous "mother" spider, measuring a massive 5 feet.

items.name: Wild Diamond
items.description: Liane, 19 years old, daring and fiery, lives with her mother and little sister under the dusty sun of Fréjus in the South of France. Obsessed with beauty and the need to become “someone”, she sees reality TV as her opportunity to be loved... Fate smiles upon her when she auditions for “Miracle Island”.

items.name: Next to Her
items.description: Rachel, 27, is raising her mentally challenged sister Gabby, 24, all by herself. When the social worker finds out she leaves her sister alone in the house while at work, she is forced to place her in a day-care center. For the first time in her life she shares the upbringing of her dear sister with someone else, her daily routine collapses and the huge void, left by her sister's absence, makes room for a man in Rachel's life. That man, Zohar, tears another crack in the symbiotic relationship of the two sisters. Rachel hangs on to his love as if it was a life belt. But her inability to lead a normal, intimate and emotional relationship with anyone but her sister, forces them into a twisted threesome, where boundaries between love, sacrifice, nurturing and torturing - are broken.

items.name: All the Lost Ones
items.description: A future civil war is sparked by government-imposed measures due to climate change. Nia, her sister Penny, and her boyfriend Ethan are hiding out when a militia leader and his followers arrive on their doorstep.

items.name: The Successor
items.description: Follows a newly-announced artistic director of a famous fashion house, who after getting his expectations high, starts experiencing chest pain and discovers that he may have inherited much worse than his estranged father's weak he...

items.name: The Braid
items.description: Three women, Smita, Giulia and Sarah, are from different parts of the world and have never met, but are bound by something intimate and unique.

items.name: Walking with the Tall Whites
items.description: A look at the life of Charles J. Hall who claims to have worked with Tall White Aliens in Nevada

items.name: The Pod Generation
items.description: In a not-so-distant future, tech giant Pegazus offers couples the opportunity to share their pregnancies via detachable artificial wombs or pods. And so begins Rachel and Alvy's wild ride to parenthood in this brave new world.

items.name: La petite vadrouille
items.description: Justine, her husband and their gang of friends come up with a solution to their money problems: organize a fake romantic cruise for Franck, a major investor, who is looking to seduce a woman.

items.name: N'avoue jamais
items.description: A former French general married for 50 years learns that his wife cheated on him 4 decades ago. He is resolved to avenge his honor and, surrounded by his wife and their 3 children, he goes hunting for the culprit on the Côte-d'Azur.

items.name: Enigma
items.description: Two legends contested their identities as women in the court of public opinion: April Ashley, who was immortalized as a trailblazer by embracing her transgender history; and Amanda Lear, who has consciously denied and obfuscated her history for decades. Their divergent paths reveal disparate but intertwined legacies.

items.name: I'll Always Know What You Did Last Summer
items.description: A group of teenagers in Colorado find themselves being stalked and killed one by one by a mysterious figure with a hook, exactly one year after they covered up a friend's accidental death.

items.name: Life After Fighting
items.description: A martial arts instructor is confronted with the disappearance of two of his students, leading him into a direct confrontation with a group of international child traffickers.

items.name: Here Now
items.description: Sophie is a twenty-year-old American who has lived her life in isolation, cut off from the world. While on vacation in Palermo with her sister, she meets Giulio and his group of Sicilian friends during her final 24 hours before returning to California. Eager to break free from her sheltered past, Sophie embarks on a whirlwind romance with Giulio.

items.name: Zabriskie Point
items.description: At a time of chronic civil unrest in late 1960s America, a young revolutionary suspected of murder steals a plane and meets a girl.

items.name: Encanto at the Hollywood Bowl
items.description: A musical celebrating the world, characters, and songs of Disney Animation's "Encanto."

items.name: The Beautiful Summer
items.description: Ginia, seventeen, experiences the ecstasy and turmoil that characterize the mysterious journey into adulthood. Meeting with Amelia confronts her with new and shocking emotions. But only by recognizing this love, she can be herself.

items.name: Last County
items.description: An alcoholic woman with a marriage on the rocks finds an unlikely ally in a wounded drug mule when the two of them are forced to defend her home from a violent siege of corrupt small town cops.

items.name: Blade: The Iron Cross
items.description: In 1945 a psychic war journalist gains a telekinetic link to a murderous puppet and uses its help to sabotage a top secret Nazi experiment that involves using a Death Ray to transform people into zombies.

items.name: Guardians of Time
items.description: Four cousins discover a secret passage in their family mansion leading to Keoherus, a mysterious realm. Trapped in this strange land, they face the Time Guardian, dark forces, and fearsome beasts while searching for a way back home.

items.name: Leave
items.description: A young woman tries to find her origins after having been abandoned as an infant at a cemetery wrapped in a cloth with satanic symbols, but as she gets closer to answers a malevolent spirit is telling her to leave.

items.name: Take My Hand
items.description: At the peak of her career in London, an Australian woman is diagnosed with MS. After losing her job and the death of her husband, she moves home with her three sons, where a chance encounter with a childhood sweetheart changes her...

items.name: Silver Haze
items.description: Fifteen years after she got burnt when the pub where she slept as a child caught fire, Franky (23) seeks revenge because she still hasn't found any answers.

items.name: The Sum of All Fears
items.description: CIA analyst Jack Ryan must stop the plans of a Neo-Nazi faction that threatens to incite a catastrophic conflict between the United States and Russia by detonating a nuclear weapon at a football game in Baltimore, Maryland.

items.name: Depravity
items.description: A group of tenants, suspecting that their neighbor could be is a serial killer, stumble upon an art heist worth millions.

items.name: I'm Your Venus
items.description: A documentary following the unsolved murder of Venus Xtravaganza, star of the legendary film "Paris Is Burning," as Venus' two families — biological and ballroom — come together to seek answers and celebrate her legacy.

items.name: The Westerner
items.description: Judge Roy Bean, a self-appointed hanging judge in Vinegarroon, Texas, befriends saddle tramp Cole Harden, who opposes Bean's policy against homesteaders.

items.name: Cradle 2 the Grave
items.description: A jewel thief's daughter is kidnapped after he steals a collection of prized black diamonds, which aren't at all what they seem.

items.name: First Born
items.description: A pregnant couple buys a mansion and moves out of NYC. Strange things start happening to the C-sectioned, anxious, new mom.

items.name: The Cow
items.description: An old villager deeply in love with his cow goes to the capital for a while. While he's there, the cow dies and now the villagers are afraid of his possible reaction to it when he returns.

items.name: The Loner
items.description: A cop is looking for the killer of his friend.

items.name: Charlie Brown's Christmas Tales
items.description: The Peanuts gang have more misadventures at Christmas time.

items.name: The Triangle
items.description: Time Travel Action/Adventure that will change the history of the world forever.

items.name: The End We Start From
items.description: A woman tries to find her way home with her newborn while an environmental crisis submerges London in floodwaters.

items.name: Hounds of War
items.description: After a mission goes wrong, only one of a group of mercenaries is left alive to take revenge for his brothers.

items.name: Frankenweenie
items.description: A young boy sets out to revive his dead pet using the monstrous power of science.

items.name: Cassino in Ischia
items.description: The next generation of action heroes push Nic Cassino off his perch. He goes to Italy to work with struggling Italian directors on the first-ever "Neo-Realist" action movie in an effort to revitalize his career.

items.name: Funeral in Berlin
items.description: Sent to East Berlin to retrieve a Communist defector, British spy Harry Palmer suspects the situation is not what his superiors believe it to be.

items.name: Guru
items.description: A villager, Gurukant Desai, arrives in Bombay 1958, and rises from its streets to become the GURU, the biggest tycoon in Indian history.

items.name: Graveyard Shift
items.description: In a very old textile mill with a serious rat infestation, deadly accidents start happening, but the corrupt foreman continues to put his workers in danger, until they discover a horrifying secret deep in the basement.

items.name: Georgia Rule
items.description: A troubled young woman is sent to live with her grandmother for the summer, while hiding a secret that could potentially tear her family apart.

items.name: Grace Is Gone
items.description: Upon hearing his wife was killed in the Iraq war, a father takes his two daughters on a road trip.

items.name: Erik the Viking
items.description: Erik the Viking and his men travel across the sea to find Valhalla to ask the gods to end the Age of Ragnarok.

items.name: Graduation
items.description: Four best friends plot to rob a bank during their high school graduation ceremony in order to help out one of the teen's sick relatives.

items.name: Horton Hears a Who!
items.description: In this story, Horton discovers there is a microscopic community of intelligent beings called the Who's living on a plant that only he can hear. Recognising the dangers they face, he resolves to keep them safe. However, the other animals around him think Horton has gone crazy thinking that there are such beings.

items.name: Palindromes
items.description: Aviva is thirteen, awkward and sensitive. Her mother Joyce is warm and loving, as is her father, Steve, a regular guy who does have a fierce temper from time to time. The film revolves around her family, friends and neighbors.

items.name: A King Like Me
items.description: Follows members of the Zulu Club, New Orleans’ first Black Mardi Gras, as they work to bring the Zulu parade back to the streets for Mardi Gras Day 2022, in the face of a global pandemic, hurricane Ida and the loss of members due to COVID and gun violence.

items.name: The Silent Hour
items.description: A detective with hearing loss and a deaf witness to a murder must lean on each other to outsmart killers they can't hear coming when cornered in an abandoned apartment block.

items.name: Uproar
items.description: A 17 year-old student is forced to get off the fence he has actively sat on all his life to stand up for himself, his whanau (family) and his future in this heartwarming story of identity.

items.name: K.G.F: Chapter 1
items.description: In the 1970s, a gangster named Rocky goes undercover as a slave to assassinate the owner of a notorious gold mine known as the Kolar Gold Fields.

items.name: Gracie's Choice
items.description: For as long as she can remember, 16 year-old Gracie has been raising her four siblings, each of whom has a different, absent father and their mother is on the fast track to self-destruction. When these children's lives are about to be pulled apart, Gracie will have to do the impossible and make the ultimate sacrifices to keep her family together.

items.name: Florida
items.description: Although he's now eighty years old, Claude Lherminier is still as imposing as he ever was. His moments of forgetfulness and confusion are becoming increasingly more frequent, but he stubbornly refuses to admit that anything is wrong.

items.name: Cocorico
items.description: The daughter of the Bouvier-Sauvage family of aristocrats is in love with the son of a Peugeot dealer. When the children announce their marriage, the aristocratic family does not agree.

items.name: Dead Man's Letters
items.description: In the aftermath of nuclear holocaust, a group of intellectuals crave to find hope in the pale and colorless new world. Among them, a history teacher tries to contact via letters his missing son.

items.name: Love You Charlie
items.description: A nerdy director and his crazy crew are filming for a reality show a glittery singer who stays for a week at the house of Charlie, the head of a brutal crime family. Charlie drags them into their dark and deadly world.

items.name: My Son
items.description: Edmond Murray searches for answers deep in the Highlands after receiving a frantic call from his ex-wife that their seven-year-old son went missing from a campsite.

items.name: Late Marriage
items.description: Zaza is a 31-year old Israeli bachelor, handsome and intelligent, and his family wants to see him married. But tradition dictates that Zaza has to choose a young virgin. She must be beautiful and from a good family, preferably ric...

items.name: Sisters
items.description: A small-time reporter tries to convince the police that she saw a murder in the apartment across from hers.

items.name: Millers in Marriage
items.description: A tale of three middle-aged married couples coming to grips with universal questions about marriage and fidelity, professional success and failure, and the challenge of finding a second act.

items.name: Take a Chance on Me
items.description: An unlikely friendship forms between a troubled young woman and an uptight court judge.

items.name: Crossing Delancey
items.description: A Manhattan single meets a man through her Jewish grandmother's matchmaker.

items.name: Lost on a Mountain in Maine
items.description: A 12-year-old boy, separated from his family by a fast-moving storm, must fight to stay alive during his nine-day adventure lost in the backwoods of Maine.

items.name: Stephanie Daley
items.description: Pregnant forensic psychologist Lydie Crane is hired to learn the truth behind the case of 16-year-old Stephanie Daley, who is accused of concealing her pregnancy and murdering her infant.

items.name: Elevation
items.description: A single father and two women venture from the safety of their homes to face monstrous creatures to save the life of a young boy.

items.name: The American Society of Magical Negroes
items.description: A young man is recruited into a secret society of magical black people who dedicate their lives to a cause of utmost importance: making white people's lives easier.

items.name: Marcello Mio
items.description: Pressured from all sides by the figure of her father, Chiara Mastroianni decides to bring him back to life through her own self. She goes by the name of Marcello, dresses like him and asks to now be considered an actor, not an actress. The people around her believe this to be a temporary joke, but Chiara is determined not to give up her new identity…

items.name: Til Death Do Us Part
items.description: After bailing on her wedding, a former bride-to-be must fight off her ex-groom and seven angry killer groomsmen in order to survive the night.

items.name: Surviving Ohio State
items.description: Delves into the sexual abuse scandal surrounding athletics doctor Richard Strauss, whose two-decade tenure at The Ohio State University saw the abuse of hundreds of students, and the ongoing quest for justice and accountability by his survivors.

items.name: Genie
items.description: The film is a fairy-tale comedy about a workaholic man who enlists the help of a magical genie to help win his family back before Christmas.

items.name: Tin Soldier
items.description: A former agent is recruited by the government for a dangerous mission that will force him to confront a past he would rather forget.

items.name: The Girl in the Pool
items.description: A well-to-do family man is forced to struggle through a surprise birthday party moments after hiding the murdered corpse of his mistress.

items.name: Hole in the Moon
items.description: A new immigrant, Tzelnik, arrives at the port of Jaffa. He goes to live in the Negev desert where he opens a kiosk in the middle of nowhere. Mizrachi comes along and opens a competing business across the way. The two make a living...

items.name: Buddymoon
items.description: When a former child actor is dumped by his fiancé days before the wedding, his excitable German best man takes him on the honeymoon instead: a backcountry trek in the remote mountains of Oregon.

items.name: Garfield on the Town
items.description: Garfield escapes from the car on a trip to the vet and finds the place where he grew up.

items.name: Reawakening
items.description: A couple whose daughter aged 14 went missing and then reappears after a decade.

items.name: Money Talks
items.description: Sought by police and criminals, a small-time hustler makes a deal with a TV newsman for protection.

items.name: Bio-Dome
items.description: Moronic best friends get themselves locked inside the Bio-Dome, a science experiment, along with a group of environmental scientists for one year.

items.name: Bittersweet
items.description: The sudden arrival and prophecies of a fortune teller unexpectedly throws a wrench into the lives of three couples.

items.name: Starting Out in the Evening
items.description: An ambitious graduate student convinces a writer that her thesis can resurrect his career.

items.name: Spring Breakdown
items.description: Three women vacation together at a popular travel destination for college co-eds on spring break.

items.name: Sublime
items.description: A man gets a colonoscopy. He wakes up in a hospital bed after a wrong operation. He's confused/scared and thinks back at talks at his 40th birthday party about hospital errors, scams etc.

items.name: Siren
items.description: Strange goings on ensue, when a few friends on a sailboat find an island with a beautiful lone female inhabitant.

items.name: There's Still Tomorrow
items.description: In this moving comedic drama set in postwar Rome, a working-class wife and mother dreams of a better future. Winner of 6 Italian Academy Awards.

items.name: Shadow Puppets
items.description: Eight strangers with no memories find themselves trapped in an abandoned facility. As they desperately try to find answers and escape, their own Shadows attempt to consume them from the darkness.

items.name: The Night Caller
items.description: Commissaire Letellier and Inspector Moissac are tracking Minos, a serial killer whose victims are women.

items.name: Someone to Run With
items.description: Through the streets of Jerusalem two teenagers' stories will unite to tell the summer adventure of their lives. Tamar is an amazingly talented but very quiet and insecure girl, who leaves behind her home and all she knows, changin...

items.name: Garfield Goes Hollywood
items.description: Jon, Garfield and Odie audition for the talent show "Pet Search" in hopes of winning the $1000 prize and a chance at the finals in Hollywood.

items.name: Our Friend
items.description: After receiving life-altering news, a couple finds unexpected support from their best friend, who puts his own life on hold and moves into their family home, bringing an impact much greater and more profound than anyone could have...

items.name: Across 110th Street
items.description: Two New York City cops go after amateur crooks who are trying to rip off the Mafia and start a gang war.

items.name: Summoned
items.description: Laura becomes concerned when fellow members of a former jury begin dying.

items.name: Saving Winston
items.description: When a troubled teen is forced to leave a self-destructive lifestyle, she discovers an abandoned horse along her journey to redemption. Will temptation from the dark shadows of her past lead her astray or will her newfound love of...

items.name: Still Crazy
items.description: Fame, fortune and fornication drove the British rock band in the '70s until a divine end. 20 years later, Strange Fruit reunites and goes on a tour with ups and downs on the continent.

items.name: The Burglars
items.description: In 1970s Athens a group of professional burglars plans an emerald heist from the home of a gem collector, but corrupt Greek police inspector Abel Zacharia is on their trail.

items.name: Sur un arbre perché
items.description: A politician picks up a couple of hitch hikers on the road. After a scary driving accident the car ends up on a tree above the sea.

items.name: Easy Street
items.description: A reformed tramp becomes a police constable who must fight a huge thug who dominates an inner city street.

items.name: Tom Thumb
items.description: A boy (Russ Tamblyn), no bigger than a thumb, manages to outwit two thieves (Terry-Thomas and Peter Sellers) determined to make a fortune from him.

items.name: Secret Agents
items.description: Moles threaten to foil a team of secret agents' plan.

items.name: Beezel
items.description: Over 60 years, three guests of a cursed home discover an eternal witch who lives beneath it with an insatiable thirst for living souls.

items.name: Mike Birbiglia: The Good Life
items.description: Drugs. Marriage. Kid's parties. Mike Birbiglia re-evaluates life as a son - and as a father - in this hilarious and deeply personal comedy special.

items.name: South Park: The Streaming Wars Part 2
items.description: A drought has brought the town of South Park to the brink of disaster.

items.name: Hummus Full Trailer
items.description: A satirical crime, comedy of errors that involves three trailers that have been smuggled into Israel. A mistake in the harbor brings together Arabs, Orthodox Jews and a gay couple that must join forces in order to solve the mishap.

items.name: The Story of Ruth
items.description: Inspired by the scriptural tale. Moabitess priestess Ruth is drawn both to a Judean man and to his talk of a forgiving God. After tragedy strikes, she begins a new life in Bethlehem.

items.name: Dark Victory
items.description: A young socialite is diagnosed with an inoperable brain tumor, and must decide whether or not she'll meet her final days with dignity.

items.name: The Ridiculous 6
items.description: An outlaw who was raised by Native Americans discovers that he has five half-brothers. Together the men go on a mission to find their wayward, deadbeat dad.

items.name: A Charlie Brown Thanksgiving
items.description: Peppermint Patty invites herself and her friends over to Charlie Brown's for Thanksgiving, and with Linus, Snoopy, and Woodstock, he attempts to throw together a Thanksgiving dinner.

items.name: Ed Kemper
items.description: Based on actual events of American serial killer Edmund Kemper, who murdered his grandparents at age 15 and, after being paroled for that crime, killed eight women in 1972 and 1973 including his own mother.

items.name: Under Therapy
items.description: Three couples are summoned by their psychologist for group therapy which pushes them to wash increasingly dirty linen in public.

items.name: Happiness Is a Warm Blanket, Charlie Brown
items.description: Linus is pushed to his limits when he learns Grandma is coming to visit and plans on ridding him of his childish security blanket.

items.name: The Lady from Shanghai
items.description: Fascinated by a gorgeous woman, a seaman joins a bizarre yachting cruise and ends up mired in a complex murder plot.

items.name: Weekend in Taipei
items.description: A former DEA agent and a former undercover operative revisit their romance during a fateful weekend in Taipei, unaware of the dangerous consequences of their past.

items.name: One Million Babes BC
items.description: It is the 3rd setting of the bright orange orb in the sky. Ogg, the leader of a wildly band of prehistoric people have chosen Nila to be sacrificed in order to appease sky Gods.

items.name: Agents
items.description: When a priceless artifact is stolen, two agents team up to retrieve it from a wealthy criminal mastermind. With everything against them, they'll take the explosive action to the land, sea, and air.

items.name: The Presence
items.description: A woman travels to an isolated cabin she begins to think she is losing her mind when her boyfriend comes to stay.

items.name: It's Spring Training, Charlie Brown
items.description: As springtime rolls around, Charlie Brown's team is performing the usual hopeless task of getting in shape for the new season. To improve the team's morale, Charlie Brown manages to find a potential team sponsor who agrees to provide uniforms, provided that the team wins the first game of the season. However, considering the usual competence of the team, including new members like Leland who is too young to even tie his shoes, the challenge seems impossible.

items.name: Coup de Chance
items.description: Two young people's bond leads to marital infidelity and ultimately crime.

items.name: The Temple Woods Gang
items.description: A retired military man lives in the Temple Woods housing project. Just as he’s burying his mother, his neighbour Bébé, who belongs to a gang of robbers from the area, is preparing to rob the convoy of a wealthy Arab prince.

items.name: Die Alone
items.description: Tells the story of a young man who has amnesia. He bands together with a rugged survivalist in a zombie-like outbreak to find his girlfriend.

items.name: A Boy Named Charlie Brown
items.description: Charlie Brown makes his way to the national spelling bee finals.

items.name: Things Will Be Different
items.description: In order to escape police after a robbery, two estranged siblings lie low in a farmhouse that hides them away in a different time. There they reckon with a mysterious force that pushes their familial bonds to unnatural breaking po...

items.name: The Confession
items.description: A high-ranking official is forced to confess to high treason.

items.name: Every Little Thing
items.description: Amid the glamour of Hollywood, Los Angeles, a woman finds herself on a transformative journey as she nurtures wounded hummingbirds, unraveling a visually captivating and magical tale of love, fragility, healing, and the delicate beauty in tiny acts of greatness.

items.name: Amelia
items.description: A look at the life of legendary American pilot Amelia Earhart, who disappeared while flying over the Pacific Ocean in 1937 in an attempt to make a flight around the world.

items.name: Walking Tall: The Payback
items.description: A man goes back to his hometown that is now overrun with crime and single-handedly takes justice into his own hands.

items.name: The Quilters
items.description: Follow the daily lives of several quilters inside the sewing room at South Central Correctional Center, a Level 5 maximum-security prison in a small town two hours south of St. Louis, MO. From design to completion, the men reveal their struggles, triumphs, and sense of pride in creating something beautiful in this windowless, sacred space deep within the prison walls.

items.name: Joe's Apartment
items.description: A nice guy has just moved to New York and discovers that he must share his run-down apartment with a couple thousand singing, dancing cockroaches.

items.name: Untold: The Fall of Favre
items.description: This eye-opening documentary delves into Brett Favre's controversial career, the dark side of sports stardom, and the scandals that marred his legacy.

items.name: Aningaaq
items.description: Short film connected to the movie Gravity (2013). It shows the conversation of Dr. Ryan Stone with someone on earth, but this time from the other side of the line, an Inuit fisherman in a frozen desert.

items.name: You're in Love, Charlie Brown
items.description: With the school year coming to a close, Charlie Brown is trying to work up the courage to meet his dream girl, whom he only knows as "The Little Red Haired Girl." However, he's too nervous to go meet her upfront and all his attempts to impress her at school backfire disastrously. His friends, Linus and Peppermint Patty, try to help, but only aggravate the situation, while Charlie Brown desperately tries to find a solution to this romantic conundrum.

items.name: Hellboy: The Crooked Man
items.description: Hellboy and a rookie B.P.R.D. agent in the 1950s are sent to the Appalachians, where they discover a remote community dominated by witches and led by the sinister local demon, the Crooked Man.

items.name: A Chump at Oxford
items.description: As a reward for capturing a bank robber, Stan and Ollie get scholarships to Oxford, but are met with resentment by other students.

items.name: The Sacrifice Game
items.description: It's bad enough that boarding school students Samantha and Clara can't go home for the holidays, but things take a deadly turn when a murderous gang arrives on their doorstep - just in time for Christmas.

items.name: Brats
items.description: Laurel and Hardy's bid for a quiet evening of checkers and pool is constantly interrupted by their squabbling brats little Ollie and little Stanley.

items.name: Lost and Found
items.description: A magical tale of friendship and loneliness, which tells the story of a little boy who one day finds a penguin on his doorstep. Although at first he is unsure what to do, the boy becomes ...

items.name: Patient Seven
items.description: A renowned psychiatrist has selected six mental patients to interview as part of the research for his new book. As he begins his unorthodox methods the question becomes, who really belongs in Spring Valley Mental Hospital?

items.name: Enemies, A Love Story
items.description: A ghostwriter finds himself romantically involved with his current wife, a married woman and his long-vanished wife.

items.name: First Case
items.description: Nora, 26, is a graduate and still lives with her parents. While Nora has no field experience, she finds herself in charge of a 19-year-old boy, accused of having murdered a girl from his residence. From her first police custody to the follow-up of the instruction, Nora discovers the cruelty of the world around her, in her intimate and professional life. Soon, carried away by the frenzy of her new life, she multiplies the errors.

items.name: Karol G: Tomorrow Was Beautiful
items.description: Karol G pulls back the curtain on her rise to stardom while navigating a sold-out stadium tour, creating new music and releasing a new album.

items.name: Soul Mates
items.description: Follows Allison and Jason, two unsuspecting strangers who must find their way out of a nightmarish maze where they were forced to get into as part of a twisted new dating service created to help them find their Soul Mate.

items.name: Magic Journey to Africa
items.description: A young girl named Jana takes a magical journey to Africa.

items.name: The Flight of the Eagle
items.description: The Swedish 19th century engineer Salomon August Andrée sets out to become the first man on the north pole. His idea is to launch a polar expedition using a hydrogen balloon, together with two friends. The balloon, "The Eagle", takes off from Svalbard in 1897, but the three men are never heard from again.

items.name: Walking Tall: Lone Justice
items.description: After cleaning up his town, the retired Sheriff, Nick Prescott, tries to make a fresh start in Dallas, as key witnesses against a drug kingpin start dying. Now, he is one man against all. Can he protect his family and make it in one piece?

items.name: Panda Bear in Africa
items.description: A panda travels from China to Africa, facing hippos, hyenas, gorillas. He rescues his kidnapped dragon friend, makes new friends, and protects their jungle home.

items.name: Elli and the Ghostly Ghost Train
items.description: When a homeless little ghost knocks on the door to the eccentric residents of a Ghost Train on the lookout for a place to belong, she accidentally attracts the attention from the "outsideworld" and must team up with the motley cre...

items.name: For Your Consideration
items.description: Three actors learn that their respective performances in the film "Home for Purim," a drama set in the mid-1940s American South, are generating award-season buzz.

items.name: Lords of London
items.description: A London gangster must confront his ruthless father's past in order to alter the gritty, abusive path that his life is spiraling down after a shakedown goes awry.

items.name: Contract Killers
items.description: A CIA assassin attempts to break out of the contract killing business to try to lead a normal life.

items.name: Left in Darkness
items.description: A young woman, whose mother died giving birth to her, is facing eternal life in either Heaven or Hell. She must make the choice who to listen to, her guardian angel, whom she met when she was a child, or the evil ones.

items.name: Midnight Clear
items.description: Faith Comes in Unexpected Places. Based on the story by the New York Times Best-Selling Author of the Left Behind Series, Jerry B. Jenkins.

items.name: Racing with the Moon
items.description: In 1942 California, two young men await induction into the U.S. Marines and say goodbye to their girlfriends.

items.name: Lockdown
items.description: Avery returns to college as a competitive swimmer after getting his life back on track. But his life takes another unexpected turn when he and his two friends (Bonds, Casseus) are wrongly accused of murder and end up in prison.

items.name: It's Christmastime Again, Charlie Brown
items.description: The Peanuts gang prepares for the holidays in their own unique ways.

items.name: Locked Down
items.description: Danny, a respected cop, is setup after an investigation goes wrong. While laying low in his new jail cell, Danny is forced to get involved in the inmates underground cage fighting circuit. With the help of Irving, a former mixed m...

items.name: Mulberry St
items.description: A deadly infection breaks out in Manhattan, causing humans to develop into blood-thirsty rat creatures.

items.name: Star Trek: Section 31
items.description: In Star Trek: Section 31, Emperor Philippa Georgiou joins a secret division of Starfleet tasked with protecting the United Federation of Planets, and must face the sins of her past.

items.name: Hukkle
items.description: Using almost no dialogue, the film follows a number of residents (both human and animal) of a small rural community in Hungary - an old man with hiccups, a shepherdess and her sheep, an old woman who may or may not be up to no goo...

items.name: Culprit
items.description: In the small town of Huntsville, Texas, there is an unsolved murder of a nine-year-old girl. A convicted ex-con, Jack, has been released from prison after new DNA evidence proved he was not present at the scene of the crime. But when another little girl is brutally murdered after Jack's release, the town points their fingers at the ex-con. As Jack works to free his name, new suspects emerge in a town trying hard to keep secrets buried.

items.name: Evilenko
items.description: A disgraced schoolteacher in Kyiv becomes a brutal, unfeeling serial killer. Based on the crimes of Andrei Chikatilo.

items.name: The Return of the King
items.description: Two Hobbits struggle to destroy the Ring in Mount Doom while their friends desperately fight evil Lord Sauron's forces in a final battle.

items.name: The Ladies Man
items.description: A clueless, recently-single graduate unwittingly takes a job as a servant in a mansion inhabited by dozens of young women.

items.name: Cube Zero
items.description: A young programmer whose job is to watch over the reality-warping Cube defies orders to rescue an innocent mother trapped in one of its rooms.

items.name: The Pink Panther
items.description: Bumbling Inspector Clouseau must solve the murder of a famous soccer coach and find out who stole the infamous Pink Panther diamond.

items.name: I Do (but I Don't)
items.description: Lauren is a divorced wedding-planner who falls for the groom-to-be.

items.name: Black Christmas
items.description: On Christmas Eve, an escaped maniac returns to his childhood home, which is now a sorority house, and begins to murder the sorority sisters one by one.

items.name: Aftermath
items.description: A returning war veteran, stricken with PTSD, unwittingly gets trapped with his teenage sister on Boston's Tobin Memorial Bridge as a heavily weaponized group of ex-military revolutionists take everyone hostage.

items.name: Ghosts of Mars
items.description: In 2176, a Martian police unit is sent to pick up a highly dangerous criminal at a remote mining post. Upon arrival, the cops find that the post has become a charnel house.

items.name: Winter Spring Summer or Fall
items.description: Remi and Barnes, two very different teenagers, meet by chance in the winter of their senior year, then spend four days together over the course of a year that will change their lives forever.

items.name: London
items.description: At a drug laden party in a New York loft, a young man tries to win back his ex-girlfriend.

items.name: In the Bedroom
items.description: A New England couple's college-aged son dates an older woman who has two small children and an unwelcome ex-husband.

items.name: Minions & More 2
items.description: Catch animated shorts like "Phil's Dance Party" and "Binky Nelson Unpacified" in this compilation from the company behind the "Despicable Me" franchise.

items.name: No Man's Land
items.description: They got off the last train at Abbesses, a metro station in Montmartre, Paris. 9 tired men and a drag queen skip the lengthy stairs and take the elevator. The door closes, but jams. The station closes down for the night. They're stuck. Between the ages of 17 and 70, from different backgrounds and social classes, they have little in common, other than their gender. They try to work together to unlock the door, to get help. And fail. As a group, as individuals, as a conversation. But a long night is ahead of them, confined and bored, anxious and indifferent, submissive and aggressive, forgotten and found - to break free, to grow up, to discover what it is to be a man in the 21 century.

items.name: Never Let Go
items.description: A family that has been haunted by an evil spirit for years. Their safety and their surroundings come into question when one of the children questions if the evil is real.

items.name: Minions & More 1
items.description: This collection of Minions shorts from the "Despicable Me" franchise includes mini-movies like "Training Wheels," "Puppy" and "Yellow Is the New Black."

items.name: My Heart Puppy
items.description: Min-soo is about to get married when his fiancée suddenly admits that she is allergic to dogs. Now the guy's best friend, the golden retriever Rooney, needs a new family. With the help of his cousin and social media, Min-soo starts looking for a new home for Rooney.

items.name: Suddenly, Last Summer
items.description: A surgeon is assigned the case of a young woman whose aunt wants her lobotomized to cover up a family secret.

items.name: Chris D'Elia: Incorrigible
items.description: Stand-up comedian Chris D'Elia covers everything from grown-up babies, to evil dating and an NFL with real giants, lions and bears, oh my!

items.name: Gregory's Girl
items.description: Gregory is a normal teen who is infatuated with a classmate. He must work to win her affection.

items.name: Untold: Shooting Guards
items.description: What really went down between Gilbert Arenas and Javaris Crittenton? This exposé unpacks how a gambling dispute led to guns drawn in an NBA locker room.

items.name: The Prince and the Pauper
items.description: A poor boy named Tom Canty and the Prince of Wales exchange identities but events force the pair to experience each other's lives as well.

items.name: Veer Zaara
items.description: An Indian Air Force pilot rescues a Pakistani girl stranded in India. Years later, a lawyer seeks to unravel the truth behind the pilot's mysterious imprisonment in Pakistan for over two decades, during which he remained silent.

items.name: Amar Singh Chamkila
items.description: Follows the life of pop star duo Amar Singh Chamkila and Amarjot Kaur, whose songs that were social commentaries or devotionals became massive hits in the 80's.

items.name: The Tasting
items.description: Jacques is divorced and runs a small wine shop, on the verge of bankruptcy. Hortense, determined not to end up single and involved in the association, walks into his store one day and decides to sign up for a tasting workshop.

items.name: A World Apart
items.description: Elementary school teacher Michele Cortese is about to start a whole new life. After 40 years of teaching in the metropolitan Roman jungle, he had to move to a village in Central Italy, to teach in a tiny school with just a few children aged 7-10. Struggling to overcome his urban inadequacy, he finds a friendly face in vice-principal Agnese and gradually manages to fit in, thanks to her and their spirited pupils. As everything seems to be falling into place, unwelcome news comes through: the school has failed to meet its student quota for the next year and will soon be shut for good.

items.name: Brett Goldstein: The Second Best Night of Your Life
items.description: Brett Goldstein's debut stand-up special covers relationships and sex, with Ted Lasso references and possible musical moments.

items.name: Chief of Station
items.description: After learning that the death of his wife was not an accident, a former CIA Station Chief is forced back into the espionage underworld, teaming up with an adversary to unravel a conspiracy that challenges everything he thought he ...

items.name: Adiós Buenos Aires
items.description: Buenos Aires, November 2001. Argentina is embroiled in crisis, with the Peso plunging deeper and deeper. Julio Färber, the charismatic bandoneon player of the 'Vecinos de Pompeya', a five-piece working-class tango band, is trying to keep his head above water, but every month he is earning less and less from their gigs as well as from the traditional shoe shop he inherited from his father. At the very moment he takes the decision to leave his beloved Buenos Aires forever, it clearly appears that life is conspiring against him: overnight, the government freezes all bank accounts in the whole country, preventing Julio from purchasing the flight tickets and sparking violent protests throughout the town. And Mariela, a witty young woman and feisty cab driver, bumps into his car at full speed, damaging Julio's last possession of value before stealing his heart.

items.name: Open Wide
items.description: John Mew thinks we're all ugly. And modern living is to blame. For decades he's waged a lonely war against orthodontics and that teenage rite of passage - braces. With his son now taking up the fight, Mew's fringe theories suddenly find an enthusiastic audience online.

items.name: The Three Caballeros
items.description: Donald receives his birthday gifts, which include traditional gifts and information about Brazil (hosted by Zé Carioca) and Mexico (by Panchito, a Mexican Charro Rooster).

items.name: Kanal
items.description: In 1944, during the Warsaw uprising against the Nazis, Polish Lieutenant Zadra and his resistance fighters use Warsaw's sewer system to escape the German encirclement.

items.name: School of Magical Animals 2
items.description: The students of the school of magical animals want to perform a musical for the school's anniversary. Will the rehearsals end in chaos or will the class pull together? And what's up with the strange holes on the school grounds?

items.name: The Pawnbroker
items.description: A widowed Jewish pawnbroker in Harlem, survivor of Nazi persecution in his native Germany, loses all faith in his fellow man until he realizes too late the tragedy of his actions.

items.name: Strangers
items.description: A frustrated woman encounters a mysterious hitman. Their romance leads to vigilante killings of criminals. As she delves deeper, she questions her partner's true nature and their hidden motives.

items.name: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: Something New
items.description: When Sally's fiancé doesn't appear, her best friend Aurora asks Arthur to assist her look for him. Soon a body is found, everyone assumes it is Sally's tardy groom, but when it turns out to be someone else, he becomes the main sus...

items.name: The Grudge 2
items.description: Three interwoven stories about a terrible curse. A young woman encounters a malevolent supernatural force while searching for her missing sister in Tokyo; a mean high school prank goes horribly wrong; a woman with a deadly secret ...

items.name: Everything Is Illuminated
items.description: A young Jewish American man, with the help of an eccentric local, endeavors to find the woman who saved his grandfather during World War II in a Ukrainian village that was ultimately razed by the Nazis.

items.name: Waterloo Bridge
items.description: Myra and Roy meet and fall in love on Waterloo Bridge during an air raid. Their love will be one of the war's unspoken casualties.

items.name: A Generation
